[h1]Review zu Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI[/h1]

[b]Meine Güte ist das ein Meisterwerk![/b]
Sid Meier´s Civilization VI wurde bisher sehr [i]kontrovers[/i] aufgenommen.
Hauptsächlich wird stets auf die negativen Änderungen Bezug genommen. Aber irgendwie nicht auch auf die positiven Seiten von Civ 6. Und das finde ich nicht wirklich gerecht, geschweige denn objektiv.
Natürlich gibt es vorab zu erwähnen, dass das Spiel diverse Daten sammelt. Privatsphäre sieht anders aus, aber seien wir mal ehrlich. Wer die EULA nicht liest, den wird das wohl kaum gestört haben. Treu dem Motto: "Unwissenheit ist ein Segen". Dazu gehöre auch ich. Ich habe erst im Nachhinein davon gehört. Hier mal der ausschlaggebende Referenzpunkt:

[i]"The information we collect may include personal information such as your first and/or last name, e-mail address, phone number, photo, mailing address, geolocation, or payment information. In addition, we may collect your age, gender, date of birth, zip code, hardware configuration, console ID, software products played, survey data, purchases, IP address and the systems you have played on. We may combine the information with your personal information and across other computers or devices that you may use."[/i]

Mich persönlich stört das jetzt nicht wirklich. In unserer dermaßen vernetzten Welt ist es beinahe unmöglich seine Daten effektiv zu schützen. Mehr habe ich dazu nicht zu sagen, auch aufgrund meiner Unwissenheit zu diesem Thema.

Was das Spiel selbst betrifft, so bin ich wirklich positiv überrascht, über einige der Neuerungen. Aber andererseits auch enttäuscht über so einige Änderungen gegenüber Civ 5.
Weshalb ich es für sinnvoll erachte eine Auflistung der Änderungen von Civ 5 zu Civ 6 zu nennen. Einige der Änderungen werde ich in eine Pro-, Contra-, sowie Prontraliste unterteilen. Jene Aufspaltung dieser Liste spiegelt meine persönliche Meinung zu den jeweiligen Änderungen dar. Wie folgt:

So, genug geredet! Auf gehts zur Pro-Contra-Liste!

[u][b]Pro:[/b][/u]

+ Civ 6 ist deutlich besser optimiert worden als Civ 5
+ Zitate bei der Zukunftstechnologie unterscheiden sich nun und rezitieren nicht mehr dauerhaft George W. Bush´s:
"Ich denke, wir stimmen darin überein, dass die Vergangenheit, vergangen ist."
+ Die Musik ist richtig, richtig gut!
+ Man hat keine Atomwaffen mehr, die man mühselig ständig von Transportmittel zu Transportmittel bringen muss, sondern hat ein insgesamtes Arsenal auf das alle nuklearen Einheiten von wo auch immer Zugriff haben
+ KI besetzt keine einzelnen Inseln mehr, da sich das ressourcentechnisch sowieso nicht lohnen würde
+ Ein simpler Bau von, sagen wir einer Atombombe, verbraucht nicht mehr eins an Uran, oder der jeweiligen Ressource, um gebaut zu werden. Kurz: Man kann so viele Atombomben bauen wie man möchte, sofern das Gold reicht
+ Man muss nicht mehr einen Spielstand laden der gemoddet wurde, um Mods nutzen zu können. Inzwischen reicht ein vom Spiel gegebener Einzelspielerslot aus und man kann dann dort mit oder ohne Mods spielen
+ Flugzeugträger können nun allein selbstständig angreifen
+ Es gibt keine nervigen Fallschirmjägertrupps mehr
+ Bei Alliierten sieht man jetzt alles auf deren Landfläche (Gebäude, Einheiten)
+ Man kann Schiffe benennen
+ Man kann Schiffe zu Armadas zusammenführen und Landeinheiten zu Armeen vereinigen
+ Händlerkarawanen können nun von Land und zu Wasser manövrieren, ohne zwei seperate Einheiten dafür zu verwenden
+ Man kann nun Geländeflächen mit anderen Städten tauschen (wenn ich mich nicht irre, dann war das im Vorgänger nicht möglich)
+ Es gibt nicht mehr 4 unterschiedliche BeraterInnen, sondern nur noch eine Beraterin, die synchronisiert worden ist, und sonst nur noch Empfehlungen, welche Dinge man als nächstes produziert

[u][b]Contra:[/b][/u]

- Animierte NPCs sehen lächerlich aus. Die Augen sind bei einigen viel zu groß und generell wirken die comicmäßiger
- Im Ladebildschirm wird keine geografische Ansicht der jeweiligen Zivilisation angezeigt. Es war immer lehrreich zu sehen wo einige einstigen Reiche früher gelegen waren
- Kriegserklärungen werden nur noch im Handelsfenster gezeigt und nicht mehr die vollwertigere Option, dass man beispielsweise auch noch 10 Runden zur Vorbereitung haben könnte
- Frisch erschaffte Marineeinheiten gewähren nicht mehr sofortige Beförderungen, sodass man sie nicht umgehend spezialisieren kann
- Automatisierung von Bautrupps ist nicht mehr möglich
- Es gibt keine futuristischen Einheiten mehr, wie die Xcom-Trupps, oder den Riesenkillerroboter
- Allgemein sind die spielbaren Herrscher mir deutlich weniger bekannt. Ein König Barbarossa ist halt weniger bekannt als ein Bismarck
- Interface und Text ist an mancher Stelle viel zu klein geraten. Vielleicht sind meine Augen auch schlechter geworden
- Große Persönlichkeiten sind deutlich weniger nützlich, dafür gibts aber auch einen Mod
- Wunder verbrauchen jetzt ein hexagonales Feld
- Es gibt keine dauerhafte Produktionsänderung auf Gold, Wissenschaft etc. sondern nur noch für gewisse Bezirke eine gewisse Anzahl von Runden lang. Daraus resultiert, dass man die Produktion von eigentlich komplett fertig konstruierten Städten ständig überwachen muss. Dafür gibts allerdings auch einen Mod
- Das Spiel merkt es sich nicht, dass ich bei der Produktionsliste gewisse Reiter ausgeblendet habe, sodass ich die immer wieder neu schließen muss. Das nervt
- Das Aussehen der Vanillaoberfläche war eine weitere Kontroverse. Glücklicherweise gibt es dafür Mods:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1702339134

[u][b]Prontra:[/b][/u]

+- Text hat sich mal überlappt
+- Übersetzung ist nicht konsequent umgesetzt worden
+- Hexagonfelder sind schlechter zu erkennen
+- Straßen sind deutlich schlechter zu erkennen
+- Es gibt keine fortschrittlicheren Eisenbahngleise mehr, als Alternative zur Straße
+- Deaktivierung der Bewegungs- und Kampfanimationen zeigt sie immer noch, jedoch deutlich schneller. Mir hat das sofortige Überspringen aus dem Vorgänger mehr gelegen
+- Statt Zufriedenheit gibt es nun Annehmlichkeit. Das Problem, dass ich mit Annehmlichkeit habe ist, dass es deutlich schlechter telegrafiert wird, wie viel Annehmlichkeit ich insgesamt habe. Das wird nicht mehr, wie in Civ 5 oben auf einem Balken angezeigt, sondern ist in irgendwelchen Menüs versteckt

Dann gibt es noch so einige Dinge, die mir einfach anderweitig aufgefallen sind:

[list]
    [*]Synchronsprecher sind mittelmäßig. Ich kringel mich immer noch vor Lachen, wie die Sprecherin der "Beraterin" Ressourcen ausspricht
    [*]Firmenintros sind nicht vorspulbar
    [*]Musik wird bei fortschrittlicheren Spielständen wohl aufgrund der Komplexität der Berechnung der KI für die nächste Runde kurz unterbrochen
    [*]Man kriegt beim Explodieren einer Atombombe Ohrenkrebs. Wohl um einige Spieler davon abzuhalten etwas Spaß zu haben, ABER DAS HÄLT MICH NICHT AUF!
[/list]

Ich bin mir ziemlich sicher, dass ich einige Änderungen/Neuerungen ausgelassen habe, aber das waren so die Ausschlaggebendsten.
Letztendlich kann ich Civ 6 wirklich empfehlen. Die meisten Contrapunkte lassen sich auch via Mods lösen. Ist zwar etwas besorgniserregend wenn die Modcommunity ein Spiel wieder angenehmer machen muss, aber wenigstens besteht diese Möglichkeit. 59,99€ ist vielleicht etwas teuer und sowieso sollte man sich das Spiel erst nach reifer Überlegung wirklich zulegen.

Ich danke fürs Lesen und wünsche sehr viel Spaß beim Spielen! ;-)

Самый красивый на свете рогалик с крепким геймплеем, потрясающей озвучкой и музыкой и забавными, трогательными диалогами (высочайший уровень всех этих пяти компонентов давно является визитной карточкой студии Supergiant Games). Игра разбита на две равные, постоянно чередующиеся части. Одна — это собственно сами забеги, где ты кружишь с монстрами в смертельном танце в попытках вырваться из подземного царства на поверхность. Другая — милая болтовня и развитие отношений с очаровательными жителями Аида и обустройство дома, как полезное, так и косметическое (т.е. почти как в Stardew Valley и симуляторах свиданий). 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2234527998

Обе части равно хороши. Отзывчивость управления и динамика боя не уступает Dead Cells (эталону из палаты мер и весов), игра довольно щедрая (в отличие от большинства других рогаликов) и, после того как прокачаешь все перманентные апгрейды, не очень-то и сложная (по рогаликовым меркам). В помощь тем, кто не слишком жалует аркады, авторы выкатили режим бога, который сделан куда лучше, чем в Celeste: он не накладывает никаких штрафов (ни к достижениям, ни к чему), а просто даёт 20% сопротивления к урону, который растёт на 2% с каждой смертью (до потолка в 80%, т.е. снижает весь урон в пять раз). Я кстати рекомендовал бы его включить сразу, если только вы не соулз-спортсмен (вот ещё соотв. тред [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/comments/itaxq1/judging_personal_limits_or_when_do_i_know_that_i/]на реддите[/url]). Он поможет сберечь [url=https://i.imgur.com/cBryFRJ.jpg]нервы[/url] и немного ускорит [url=https://twitter.com/spaghoner/status/1312512626975358978]прогресс[/url]. С другой стороны, смерти здесь тоже сюжетно важны: игра комментирует практически все ваши действия — выбранное оружие, дары богов, амулеты, рыбалку, а после того, как вы неминуемо умрёте, специальный герой даёт саркастические советы:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2231497274

Главная проблема игры, как это бывает, прямо проистекает из её достоинств. Сюжетную часть необходимо заранее распланировать по времени, и, учитывая, что в рогалики люди играют подолгу, авторы заложили сюда диалогов часов на 100-120 геймплея. Вся игра разбита на три неравных акта (скорее, цикла), у каждого из них есть свой финал, и каждый раз вам даётся очень ловкая, хитроумная причина играть дальше. При этом я скорее согласен с той критикой, что в игре не хватает контента. Здесь всего четыре этажа с боссом в конце каждого. Боссы первого этажа ещё немного меняются, а дальше вариативность всё ниже. В специальном пакте (с фирменными усложняющими игру переключателями) всех боссов, нескольких мини-боссов и элитных врагов можно качественно усилить, и на этом всё. Поначалу открывающееся оружие даёт некоторое разнообразие, но оно не идёт ни в какое сравнение с разными героями в Diablo-жанре или Slay the Spire (где собрано по сути множество разных игр в одной). Разные навыки тоже не очень-то сильно меняют геймплей. За 100 часов я встретил лишь два билда, которые радикально ушли в сторону: это дуо-дар, позволяющий призывать бога [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2239581843]каждые несколько секунд[/url] и лук Геры/меч Посейдона, которые переводят фокус с атаки на бросок. Во всех остальных случаях лучшая, самая быстрая и стабильная тактика — безумно мельтешить по экрану атакой-рывком и вкладываться в урон по известному принципу "враги не могут тебя бить, если они мертвы". 

Хуже всего, что сюжетные линии (и основные, и романтические, и мини-квесты) разбросаны по всему массиву диалогов случайным образом. У многих есть куча скрытых условий, где тебе нужно поговорить сначала с тем, потом с этим, потом с другим (да ещё и надев определённую вещь), и только потом быть может ты продвинешься дальше. И если вы настроены на 100% завершение игры, то это займёт необоснованно долгое время. Pros:
+The game looks beautiful, that is if you have a decent enough system to run it.
+The voice acting is actually good and draws deeper you into the story.
+The story up to the point I have played has been really engaging and entertaining with plenty of varied missions.
+The enemies, both human and zombie actually pose a threat rather than just used as mere punching bags, thus making the game difficult in a good way.
+Along with the story the side missions are all varied and equally as entertaining.
+The first person animations imho are really fluid and rival most fps games out right now such as farcry 4.
+The parkour/freerunning is great allowing for you to make a quick get away if swarmed by enemies.
+The gunplay actually feels good.
+Night time is terrifying when trying to sneak by the "super" infected it makes the game really tense.

Cons:
-Even with my rather mid to high end system (GTX 770, I5 3740 @ 4.4Hz, 8GB Ram) with textures on high there is terrible stuttering and frame skipping when initiating a cutscene, sometimes even frezzing the game for several seconds. **Solution is to just turn textures to medium (could be due to VRAM but not sure)

-Techland still needs to work on facial animations because even though its a slight improvement over the Dead Island games its still not great and they look rather stiff.

Even though this game has gotten a lot of low scores from several big gaming sites (which of course I dont agree with) I can not recommend this game enough to any one who likes action/adventure games where exploration is fun and rewarding and the combat is weighty and brutal, with the freedom of climbing or running anywhere you please. Overall this game is great and dispite the oversaturation of zombie games in the market, Dying light still impresses and is my favorite zombie/survival game to date.

If you are one of those snowflakes that can't stand being killed all of the time playing multiplayer on a public server where you will be bullied by the dominant tribe, don't buy Ark or any other similar survival game. If you like a game that is totally open world, where you can set the pace of play, the goals, a world that you can view in all of its glorious first person 3-D beauty, and love to try out different things, then Ark is for you. You do have the option of either hosting or setting up a server for you and your friends to play under your own rules and goals free from the griefers of the public servers.

What is Ark Survival Evolved?

As a player, you have awakened into a strange world, actually, an alien lifeboat in space, populated by artifically created creatures from Earth's past. A world where you can use its resources and its creatures to aid you in your survival.

Syatem requirements;

If you want to enjoy the Ark experience in all of its glory, you will need a high end gaming computer. The Min. specs are just that, low settings and low frame rates where your system can easily freeze up or crash from running out of memory. You will want an I-7 processor with at least 16G ram, preferringly 32G ram, and at least a GTX 1070 graphic card in order t run the game in 1080p on epic settings. And, have at least 150G of hard drive space available, especially if you want to run the official DLCs and any mods.

A welkthrough for the first time player

	First of all, get familiar with how the game mechanics work in single player using your, keyboard, mouse, game controller. Or, expect to suffer abuse, be killed a lot while, and get totally discouraged while you are trying to figure out how things work while playing on a public server.

	Of the five official maps, The Island and Ragnarok are the easiest with the Scorched Earth mod the hardest. The safest starting locations are South Zone One on The Island, Tropical 2 on Ragnarok, North Tropical on The Center, South Zone One on Scorched Earth, or The Portal on Aberration. You may spawn by dilos which you can outrun. Basic resources are plentiful. It is recommended that you avoid Scorched Earth and Aberration for now due to the brutal conditions you will face as a new player in those map.

	All first time players will have a chance to create their character to design and shape as they wish. Regardless of how they craft them, all characters start with the same stats in the game. You can them level them up on the game as you see fit.

	Game Play. Constant running will make you tired as well as use up food and water faster. Cold will use up food faster, heat will use up water faster. If you spawn near a dilo or raptor, run. Get behind something or run by some herbivore which it may take an interest in, allowing you to escape.

	If you are killed, you will be reborn naked, but will retain your crafting skills. You can reclaim your stuff from your body if you can do so safely. If you have been eaten, a bag will be left with your stuff. You have fifteen minutes to reclaim it or it will be lost forever.

I would recommend that you have the game difficulity set at 0.2 until you have gained some experience in how things work. Later, you can raise it to 1.0 which will give you higher level creatures and better items in the loot crates the aliens will drop for your use.

	To start out in the game once you have spawned in;
1. Grab a rock. In Ragnarok, you can get wood and thatch from the litter on the beach area. Otherwise, punch a tree or driftwood with your fist to get at least 1 wood and 10 thatch. Punching will cause you to lose health but there is no other choice until you can craft tools.
2. Go into crafting and craft the pick. Place it in hot bar 1.
3. Go hit a boulder with the pick to get flint. Go hit a tree to get more wood and thatch. Pick some bushes to get some berries and fiber.
4. As you will have leveled up by now, apply the level to health or weight. Select the hatchet and spears from the Engrams list and craft a hatchet. Place it in hot bar 2.
5. Chop a tree to get mostly wood. Use the pick for thatch and flint. Craft at least three spears and place them in hot bar 3. You now have some means for defense against the carnavores.
6. In Ragnarok, there are crates along the shore near the Blue Obelisk and other areas. One can obtain some good items early by smashing them open with the hatchet.
7. Place mejoberries in hot bar 0. Why? To prevent more important items being stolen from you by the Pegomastax which will sneak up and steal things. Stolen berries may passive tame one for you.
8. Craft a torch and place it in hot bar 6. You can still pick stones and bushes while using a torch.
9. Go kill some Dodos for their meat and hide. Gather more stone, wood, thatch, and fiber. Eat berries for food but save the Narcos for taming as they will put you to sleep. Likewise, the Stimms will give you energy and counteract poisonous bites but make you very thirsty.
10. At the next level up, get the campfire, shirt and pants, craft the clothes and put them on. Find a sheltered spot where your back is protected from surprise attacks and place the campfire down. Place wood and the meat in it and light the fire.
11. A Waterskin will store water for your use when you are away from a water source, but they leak. You can refill them by standing in water and use item, or place in the hot bar and press that number. They can also be refilled when it rains.
12. You may use the spear for fishing. Just be aware of sharks, mantas, and predator fish.
13. As it is likely getting dark by now, use the torch for light and warmth as you go gathering more materials for a shelter. You should have a level up soon to get thatch foundation and walls. A shelter will give additional protection from excessive heat or cold and the dangerous Troodon.
14. As soon as you can, get the storage box. Place extra items in it so you are not being overburdened.
15. Get a sleeping bag but don't craft it for now. You need the engram for the Simple Bed which you will craft and place in your shelter. This will give you a place to be reborn if your character gets killed. Sleeping bags are portable but they are a one time use item. You will soon have plenty from the supply drops you can access in the game.
16. There are going to be many more items then you will ever have engram points for selecting. Spend them on items that are most useful. At this stage of the game, mortise and pestle, narc, spark powder, gunpowder, standing torch, bow arrow, and  the tranc arrows. Get the Bola. It is most useful for stopping an attacking raptor or for immobilizing a creature from a Parasaur size and smaller for taming.
17. The raft will allow for safe? transport for resources and safer locations. You can place structures on them and ferry your tames to safer locations. Just watch out for swimming sarcos, alligators, which can attack your tames on the raft, alpha sharks, or Leeds, a giant fish that will attack a raft on sight. 
18. Your first pets for tames can be some dodos for an egg farm, spitters that you knock out with the slingshot and use as guard dogs or hunting, a parasaur for transport, and later, a Trike for berry harvesting. Get low level ones for now, they are easier to tame. Your first flying transport a pteradon. Wait until you can craft saddles for them before attempting a tame.

	You are now well on your way to being a survivor of the Ark. Play cautiously and watch your six. And, always prepared for the unexpected.

Before this game I got and quite enjoyed such recent "oldschool isometric RPGs" as Pillars of Eternity, Divinity Original Sin, Wasteland 2, Age of Decadence and Tyranny. They had their ups and downs, but Numenera is regrettably the worst of them. In some ancient past I revered Planescape as much as the next guy. Don't remember much details now though, so no comparison here.

Nonexistant gameplay leaves you with what tries to be an ineractive book. Though full of interesting ideas, the writing is actually bad. This is not a book, this is a simulator of a journalist in a madhouse: Hello there, what's your name, from which dimension you think you came today, which one of your split personalities is causing problems you think? Ok, yeah, the next one please, hello, what's your name. 

The game is ridiculously easy: three types of easily restockable resources will get you through every dialog check and battle in no time, you just keep minimal reasonable balance when upgrading your characters, no real planning needed.

Interface is fine, but with overwhelmingly enormous infodumps why not make these super helpful hyperlinks like in Tyranny. And yeah, you have this large placeholder in the bottom interface panel, where logically you expect to see your dialog partner portrait, but it just stays empty every single time. 

Characters and situations are often interesting but resolve too mundane, sideqests are mechanically short and primitive. I find it depressing that characters often have rich and tasty backgrounds but don't do much in actual game. Main quest is really great, for me it's the best thing there is in this game.

I have only finished the first large hub, it's 1/3 of the game I figure, so I cannot really tell about reactivity - have not seen much of it yet though.

Tides mechanics are funny not in a good way: they are supposed to change NPC reactions in dialogs, but I have no idea if it really happens. Seems you need second playthrough to evaluate this mechanics.

There is this 'use environment' mechanics in fights, but I did not bother, simple attacks solved all 5 or so fights.

Visuals are bad, Wasteland 2 was much better (when it was finally done properly), leave alone the gorgeous beautiful Divinity Original Sin. Art design may appeal to some, but it left me cold (though I expect second hub Bloom to be better). Thanks for Linux support though, love to have it.

I'll update the review when I finish the game. But from where I stand now you can do much better reading Gene Wolfe's "The Book of the new Sun" cycle than playing this game, it will scratch your itch, I guarantee you.

Bon bon bon, Fallout 4, après avoir fini 3-4 fois le jeu j'pense que je peux m'y mettre

Malgré la controverse qu'il as pu subir, moi j'ai été vraiment agréablement surpris par cet opus, j'avais jamais enormément accroché aux autres Fallout avant celui-ci, mais là j'ai pris une claque, ça explique sûrement les heures que j'ai mis dedans (et c'est pas fini) 

Bon ! C'est parti :
Les points positifs :

- Le jeu est beau♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥br>
- C'est un jeu Bethesda, c'est forcément bon
- L'histoire en elle même, est vraiment très bonne, j'ai été vraiment pris dedans
- Les Compagnons qui peuvent vous accompagner sont vraiment attachants
- Un pionnier en matière de système d'installation de mods integrés
- Des milliers et des milliers de mods disponibles sur le Nexus
- Les quêtes secondaires sont même pas chiantes, dingue nan ?
- Un univers post-nucléaire vraiment stylé, il est bien géré, pas très cohérent parfois mais on sent vraiment la désolation dans le paysage
- Une création de personnage pas dégueu, beaucoup plus poussée que les autres Fallout ou même les Elders Scrolls
- Votre personnage parle, et ça c'est stylé, j'en attend autant dans le prochain TES
- Y'as une option de dialogue "Sarcastique" presque tout le temps, et c'est vachement fun
- Les dialogues sont plutôt cool, certes à un certains point on se contente de lire la phrase et de la passer avant qu'ils aient finis de parler mais, j'aime bien perso

- Vous devez gérer des communautés, faire en sorte qu'ils aient à manger, à boire, de la protection des lits etc.. concept qui passe par un menu de construction, un peu foireux certes, mais les mods peuvent largement l'aider à s'améliorer
- Vous pouvez ajouter des accessoires a vos armes etc...
- Il y a un mode de difficulté Survie plutôt sympa, dans lequel vous devez boire, manger, vous pouvez choper des maladies, pas de voyages rapides etc..
- Les temps de chargements sont pas trop longs, et au pire achetez des SSD et faites pas chier
- La bande son du jeu, mama mia, la musique des radios est ultra stylée et super immersive
- Certaines décisions du jeu sont difficiles à prendre, vous comprenez pourquoi j'ai recommencé 4 fois le jeu ? ;-)
- ça reste assez fidèle aux précédents opus au niveau des faits historiques etc

Bon, ça me fais mal au coeur mais les voilà
Les points négatifs :

- ça rame un peu parfois, surtout dans les grandes villes
- C'est un jeu Bethesda, c'est forcément bugué
- votre personnage est un peu naïf parfois 
- L'arsenal du jeu, sans mods est un peu léger, c'est dommage.
- 
- On passe vraiment beaucoup de temps à marcher quand on as pas encore découvert certains endroits de la carte
- Comme dans Skyrim, vous êtes un peu le chien de tout le Commonwealth

Voilà voilà, j'pourraisencore développer certains points mais je pense que c'est suffisant pour vous faire comprendre que j'aime beaucoup ce jeu :D

对于快餐游戏统治绝大多数人的时代，以撒这款游戏属于一开始你并不想去玩，通过看别人玩或朋友推荐了解到这款游戏。我也一样，那个时候虽然玩的是盗版，而且第一代游戏24帧不到，并不像现在优化这么好，游戏难度很高，但是从陆夫人那里看到了鬼畜硫磺火这个操作，凭借这个技巧我也能通关了。通关一次还不是结束，通关只是给你一个线索，需要收集线索而得到游戏的不同种结局。以撒的结合重生版本入的正，通过大学期间的锻炼（每次吃饭前等室友时开一把），因为记不住那么多道具，就去问好基友、找攻略，然后干脆对照着道具介绍玩，依旧是那么菜。直到陆夫人举办了flag杯，发现了陈哥，学到了好多（记笔记）。从陈哥直播与视频里，学习了手残党也能通关的技巧，这个时候我才踏上了搜集全成就的旅程。直到第一次全成就，更新了骨哥，再次全成就以后，发现这个游戏并不会因为全成就而结束。每一局都有每一局的世界线，同一张图可能有多种世界线。而且各种各样的彩蛋，daily run，创意工坊等等，使游戏的可玩性一直保持在高水平。当今社会，因为很多人没有大把的空闲时间，那些一局十几分钟二十分钟的游戏才会火。快餐游戏适合当今社会发展的节奏。不过作为单机，能随时暂停也是相对于网游的优势，并且谁会为了难度这么高的游戏死上百次上千次呢？

Having played the previous game in the series (XCom Enemy Within), I was quite excited for XCOM 2. And it starts off brilliantly - great graphics, an intriguing story and a great vision of a conquered Earth. It's a great sci-fi tale that brings to mind Half Life 2 - the entire world has been conquered by aliens and the humans are being told its for their own good.

There are some interesting changes to the 4 soldier classes, including their abilities, which mixes the game up a little. In general, like its predecessor, it is an engaging and potentially quite addictive title.

However, there is one problem with it - the difficulty. You will read a lot of reviews saying that the difficulty level is just fine or is even easy. The problem is, those people are all XCOM pros who can finish the game on Commander difficulty with Iron Man on. I was decent at XCOM 1, but XCOM 2 beats me like a red headed step child. And it simply isn't fun because of that.

So unfun in fact, that only a few hours I'm not playing it anymore. It is just too hard, it isn't my cup of tea. I don't want to endlessly reload to get a good roll and actually survive. It takes ages to finish a single mission in this game because it is so hard and you will be forced to reload all the time.

There is an interview with the lead designer in which he claims that, late in the development cycle, they decided to increase the difficulty of the game without proper testing. Whoops. Increased it far too much and now I personally find the game irritating, despite how good it is otherwise.

Highly recommended.

Conclusion: The story is stellar and intriguing with characters that are extremely memorable. The gameplay is strategic (although sometimes spammy and cheesy enemies). PAYDAY - игра в жанре шутер, повествует о приключениях банды грабителей. Я бы сказал, что присутствует и РПГ система, так как от вашей прокачки напрямую зависит ваш скилл - без билда вы тут ничего не сможете сделать. Вам предстоит выбрать из большого множества оружий (начиная стандартными пистолетами и винтовками, заканчивая двумя миниганами), выбрать стиль игры (вы можете быть как силовиком, принимая весь урон и убивая врагов, так и техником, выполняя основную часть задания). Согласитесь, место в игре имеет командная игра.
Вот тут плавно переходим к первому пункту. Коммьюнити. Я бы не назвал его токсичным или плохим, но редко вас не кикнут из лобби, если вы будете заходить к рандомам, или хотя бы объяснят причину кика. Поэтому мой вам совет: играйте с друзьями. Вообще, любая МП игра лучше с друзьями. Так как здесь нужна командная работа, то вам придется играть сообща. Согласитесь, это сложно сделать с первым встречным человеком.
Техническая составляющая и графика. Объединил, потому что не ситаю это важным в данной игре. Ну, вы разве хотите увидеть графон в пэйдее? Тогда, учитывая количество объектов на карте, сюда и зайти будет сложно. А так неплохо: оптимизация отличная, графика приемлемая, а вот баги есть, да и читеров пропускает только так (при использовании софта всё, что вам сделают - напишут над вами "ЧИТЕР").
Контент. Спорная ситуация. С одной стороны, в игре тонны оружия, модификаций на них, перков, персонажей и ограблений. С другой, за большинство выше перечисленного надо платить. Не рекомендую ни в коем случае (хех), но вы можете скачать DLC анлокер и забыть о данной проблеме навсегда. Правда, игроки будут относиться к вам плохо. Лично я взял все дополнения на скидках меньше, чем за 400-500 рублей. Тут уж вам решать.
Продолжая тему контента хотелось бы отметить то, что ограбления могут быть и бредовыми, и реально заставлять задуматься (продумать план, снаряжение, пути отхода). Оружие имеет свои характеристики, а скиллы вкачиваться тысячами разных вариантов, что создаёт множество разных вариантов игры. Короче говоря, тут есть чем заняться не на одну сотню часов.
В конце отметил бы некоторые минусы: хоть под общим впечатлением минусы иногда не заметны, но именно здесь всё же кусается цена, ибо без скидок платить такие деньги за игру более, чем 5-летней давности - ну, такое. Микротранзакции вызвали большой спор, мол, в игре и так много дополнений, приносящих доход, а теперь тут ещё и скины? Это, конечно, сугубо личное, но я за минус не считаю.
В конце 2018 года я бы не советовал к покупке, ибо сейчас много других похожих проектов от OVERKILL. Но, ради ознакомления, приобрести данную игру вполне можно на скидках, благо, что они бывают нередко. Итог: 7 из 10. Снизил за цену и за отличный античит.

This game was a lot better than I expected. I'm not a big fan of horror, and the standard "walk through this creepy house and get attacked by ghouls" level design didn't initially appeal to me. But there's enough flexibility in how you approach the game that I still enjoyed it immensely. The skill system allowed me to build the perfect stealth/sniper setup (which is not only my favorite way to approach any FPS, but is also very helpful in alleviating some of the stress of the zombie/horror genre). The limited number of joinable factions (compared to Skyrim) allows for much better integration of the faction storyline into the main quest, making it feel like you really are building your own story. And that story is pretty solidly built itself, presenting complicated philosophical questions about the nature of life and the purpose of scientific advancement, which is what good sci-fi is really about.

The only downside I can think of is the companion system. In a game that does such a good job combining the alliances you forge with the central conflict, the companions themselves feel very underdeveloped. Maybe I've been spoiled by games like Dragon Age: Origins, but the companions in this game were so unconnected to the events in the world around them that they just broke the immersion a bit whenever I dealt with them. Luckily, with the Lone Wanderer perk, I didn't have to do that very often at all.

The mechanics are decently sound and you'll get a good 20 hours of enjoyment or more from the game. 

My main problem is with the loot and the weapons in the game. None of what you get really has a big impact or feels impressive...It almost feels as if you're swinging a stick at zombies for the entire game. There aren't multiple types of guns or even interesting weapons for the most part. You get pistols, rifles, a really terrible shotgun, knives, hammers, swords, throwing weapons and a few other things. That might sound impressive, except they're all nearly the same in how they handle and the damage they do. The durability system is confusing in that you break your weapons so quickly and once they're out of repair charges you might as well just toss them. What really disappointed me was how lame the air drops were. At the beginning you would bust your ass to try and get one and find nothing but an item for xp and maybe some med kits or flares. Even with all of the negatives, I still did enjoy this game and I feel like it has a lot of potential depending on what they do with it. I wouldn't recommend this game at full price, but if you can get it for $20 or less I would buy it.

Dark Souls 1 harika bir oyun. DS serisinde bana göre en başarılı oyun. Nostaljiyi sevince marjinal oluyorum kafasında da değilim. Gerçekten bölüm dizaynlarından tutun, harika atrmosferi ve hikayesiyle beni kendine bağlamış bir oyun. O halde neden " Not Recommended " verdim ?

Dark Souls ilk pcye çıktığında 30 fps 720p'ye sabitlenmiş, çok kalitesiz pc portuyla çıkmıştı. Buna rağmen oyun 2 milyon kopya sattı. Oyuncular FromSoftware'e " Bu ne amına koyayim ?" şeklinde tepki gösterdiler ve patch beklemeye başladılar. FromSoftware ise patch getirmek yerine özür dileyip ne yapıcaklarını bilmediklerini açıkladılar, çünkü pcde adamların tecrübeleri sıfır. Olaya modçular yetişti. Yanılmıyorsam oyunun çıkışından sadece bir kaç saat sonra "dsfix" denilen bir mod getirildi. Bu mod oyunu 60 fps 1080p yapıyor, oyunun grafik ayarlarına yeni ayarlamalar ekleyip bir sürü saçma sapan bug ve glitchleri temizliyordu. 

Dark Souls'un online sistemi de pert durumdaydı. Bu yüzden " Wulf's Dark Souls Connectivity Mod " denilen bir mod çıkarıldı. Bu mod oyunun online sistemini düzeltip kullanılabilir bir hale getiriyordu.

Bu olaylardan 6 yıl sonra ise Dark Souls Remastered çıktı. Peki ya Remastered'ın normal dsfix ve Connectivity Mod yüklü Dark Souls'tan farkı neydi ? Daha önce çıkan her türlü hiç bir mod ile uyumlu olmaması, Blacksmith Vamos'un yanına bonfire eklemeleri ve 40(20) dolar bir fiyat etiketine sahip olması.


İngilizce'si olanlar için InfernoPlus Remastered'ın neden bok gibi olduğunu anlatmış. İzlemenizi öneririm. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aTEnHd0anr4

I've been playing oxygen not included for a couple months, and here is what I have to say.

[h1]Game Overview[/h1]
Oxygen Not Included is a Base-Building Simulation/Managment game where you have 3 Starting "Duplicants" or Inhabitants of a floating peice of space rock and you have to harvest the asteroid's resources to survive. You collect different resources with the Multi-Tool that all duplicants come pre-equipped with. You start with a limited amout of things you're able to build but they quickly are increased with the game's research mechanic. You have to keep the stress and germ levels of your duplicants in check constantly, or else the can die.
[I]That was a very vauge and simplified explaination. There is a lot more that goes into it.[/i]

[h1]Pros[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game's prioritzation mechanic is very helpful. It saved me from tearing my hair out countless times while screaming at my montior "DO THAT INSTEAD OF THIS!!!!".
[*]The job assignment mechainc was a very well implemented. 
[*]The ablity to research is also cool. It really makes you think about what you WHAT vs Need.
[*]The rooms feature is very helpful. It gives a boost depending on what is in the room.
[h1]Cons[/h1]
[*]If your base gets really big, your framerate could suffer.
[*]Sometimes duplicants can get trapped in wierd areas.
[*]Other random bugs a peppered throughout,as the game is still in development. They aren't a deal-breaker for most people, though.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
This game is worth its price tag. It is a fun game to sink your teeth into and get invested into. There is hours on top of hours of Replay Value. It is challenging to the average player at first but once you get the hang of it, it is a great game.  It gets my honest recomendation to anyone with some spare time.

The moth-mystics, brilliant, curious, and small, played in the ancient light of carefree dreams, knowing nothing of the distictions suffered elsewhere. Their light, pure and true, illuminated their consciousness as well as the caverns in which they dwelt among incense, musky throw rugs, and illusions. 

     However, as with all worlds in stasis, contrast must come. And so came the wyrm into that illustrious depth. Through the cystal mines he fell. Through the luscious ferns and hollow stone he descended. Descended to die. For he knew death was near, and perhaps he wished to leave a lasting imprint on a world travelled for hundreds of lifetimes. Or perhaps he was scared, running childlike toward the closest nest which resembled a womb. When the wyrm found the quietest edge of the land, he could push no further, and passed into ashes, forever falling lovely and amazing.  From this pale ash rose one destined to be a king, for the humble specter of that great creature contained its own light, yet one apart from that among which the moths did gaily play. And so from this great passing, contrast came into existence. 

     Now two lights. Two worlds. A burst of awareness where previously there was none. And the mystics accepted this new light, finding its presence gracious, and all declared it was good. With newfound vigor, the king and the ancients toiled side by side with the newly awakened local species to erect upon this dust strewn altar the greatest kingdom of bugs not found in any history book, save this one. Those crystal mines, once split into cracks in the wake of the wyrm's dying vibrations, now open and opulent, spilling upon spires and verdant gardens of stone and innovation upon innovation. The kingdom grew mighty and immense, and they made great allies in the powerful creatures known as the stags. Upon these great steeds they did push all the way toward the limits, but daring no further than the resting place of the ashen almighty. Over time, some enemies too were made, but those battles were no match for the prowess and intelligence of the pale king, and a deal soon was struck, benefitting all sides in mutual aid, and benevolence was the law of the land.  The greater creatures in the nests deep below would be kept at bay, and some say the mantis still guards the door to this day. From this agreement a forbidden love was born. A traitorous tribe, a grey lover, and a flower to signify their bond. Perhaps one with both the courage and compassion for such a task will come along to deliver the flower. And maybe, just maybe, the lover still lives to recieve the gift.  

Can any story of light, though, exist without also being a story of darkness? For without recognizing their folly, the mystics looked away from their light for too long, and it began to reach out. Forsaken, the ancient light took on new form, as it spread through the neural pathways of these dank hollow channels. First a distant inkling, like an unidentified itch. Then expanding until there is no distiction between waking and dream. And finally degrading the body to an unrecognizably grotesque form. All thought illuminated by the ancient light, yearning to be what it once was. The fingers and the palm slipping off with the last strength of grip, as if to say “hear me. I was here long before your kind, and it is only for your sake I appear to you now. I beg of you. I am humbled here. Forgotten. Ignored. Let not this cycle be the last, for many have come to pass in these lands, yet never have I myself known fear. Come back to me, my children, and all will be good.”  And this yearning spread like a plague throughout the kingdom, gaining malice as it grew, infecting every mind until it could be denied no longer. 

The king had seen his coming demise in this ancient power, just as the wyrm had known so long ago, and so he sought to contain the ancient light. To stifle it that his rule and his subjects may remain in their own stasis just a bit longer. And to this end great experiments were underaken. Great studies conducted deep in the acidic pools where the organic and the architectural have undergone organic symbiosis and are indistinct as entities. A vessel. A vessel strong enough to contain an ancient light so powerful it could tranform the minds and the very beings of every living creature within its reach could only be one of pure darkness, and so pure darkness they sought to create. And they did. It was at this time the kingdom first employed the skills of the race known as Weavers. It is said they had the ability to weave our dreams into reality, to weave into being, and therefore out of being, according to their whim. They existed in isolation, far from the opulence of the king, for they saw a greater purpose, and their minds worked tenfold for every other bug in the kingdom. So as is common, their intelligence became their isolation, in spite of a yearning left behind for the comfort of companionship. For they were decieved regarding the purpose of their craft, and after they completed their employment, fled forever from the reaches of that land. 

After many failures tossed aside; after countless hours and innumerable resources; just as the kingdom was pushed to the edge of insanity and disparity, the king deemed the vessel known as the Hollow Knight worthy of containing the ancient light.  The ritual, however, could not be taken lightly, and great sacrifices were made. Three great bugs must be put to eternal slumber, for the only safe place to contain such a light would be within the dreamscape from whence it came. This much they trusted to be true, for fear alone does breed respect. The first to volunteer was also the first to falter. None knew better than the teacher the immensity of this project, yet none also knew better the folly of inevitability. And so the teacher was put to dream, and the first seal was cast upon the vessel. The second did not need to volunteer, for this one was bound through justice and reverence. For service, they do sleep, and the holder of the second bond dreams eternal. The final dreamer was neither a tribute nor a dignitary, but rather a matron, and for her service a bargain was struck. A female child to continue the bloodline. Many parts put into one. And so a second being was created. The vessel and the child. With this pact, the final dreamer was put to sleep, and the final seal was bound. 

For many generations the kingdom existed as such. A strict caste ruling came into existence. The larger and more skilled bugs were sentried to protect the wealthy bugs, who slowly lost their minds to the infection, albeit more slowly than some less fortunate. Over time though, the darkness created during that period of desperate regal experimentation began to seep throughout the kingdom. Some of these failed experiments still wander in the deepest places within theses hallowed halls, as if a standing memorial to decisions which could have gone otherwise. Some seek to enforce the order of the king, imprisoning the lower castes in a manic, unregistered fasion. Some others are simply driven mad by their lack of purpose. A great black phallus began to spew filth. The plague slowly ruined the city, and only the female child remained as watcher. Some fortunate bugs made it to the surface, where they found and inhabited a small functioning village. A few travellers still roam the caverns, but those depths are overrun by those who have lost their minds to that yearning infection. 

Then one small creature wandered into the ruins. This creature seemed to know every inch of this place, and was driven by a calling from deep within ancient dreams. Had the Hollow Knight returned to set right the failures of a distant monarch? Would it seek the perpetuation of this forsaken place, or would it seek to break the seals?

Subnautica - отличный пример приключенческой "выживалки", где практически всё сделано правильно. Эмоции переполняют, поэтому в кратце скажу.

Плюсы:
- геймплей и всё, что связано с выживанием и гриндом. Игра грамотно расставляет приоритеты. Некоторые места она Вам подскажет, где-то игрок сам должен приложить силы, чтобы продвинуться дальше по сюжету. Но никакого помешательства и гринда ради накрутки часов. Игра не успевает надоесть и всегда по мере прохождения приподносит что-то новое.
- множество биомов, подкрепленных различной живностью.. и ужасом. Пусть игра не является хоррором, но Вы будете бояться, Вам будет страшно! Когда будете спускаться в бездну и услышите звуки "морского ада", Вы будете мечтать убраться с этой планеты. Странное чувство, когда тебе нравится игра, но ты очень хочешь её пройти, просто потому что тебе/герою страшно от того, что творится в пучинах бесконечного океана.
- лор. Удивительно, но пусть не сразу, но в игре присутствует отличная история. Подается она понемногу, но в конце игры выстраивается единая сюжетная линия, которая охватывает годы.

Единственный минус - оптимизация. На каком бы ПК Вы не играли, игра будет подтормаживать. Будь то изменение биома, или выплывание на поверхность, или падение FPS после разворачивания игры. Виноваты разработчики или нет, но скорее всего дело в несовершенстве движка Unity.

Subnautica строга рекомендуется любителем survival и исследований. Я давное так не радовался каждому новому исследованию или чертежу. Игра обладает удивительной душевностью и её невозможно не полюбить.

-Zofia y Jessie te llegan a agradar, los personajes que van apareciendo a lo largo de la historia estan muy bien logrados, graficamente es expcecional muy smooth, nunca tuve un problema de compatibilidad, solamente al vincular bethesda link, a veces se me cortaba internet y tenia que volver a logear, mas alla de todo esto no tuve ningun otro tipo de problemas.

-El mayor punto negativo es el agregado inncesario de barras de vida estilo, los enemigos son esponjas, un simple soldado con 3 disparos en la cabeza no los matas, cuando en otros wolfenstein 1 era necesario para hacerla explotar de un solo disparo o matarlo con la pistola en sigilo, tenes que ir subiendo de nivel para poder ir matando a los soldados de cada area.

-Las misiones son repetitivas: matar al comandante X, salvar a los rehenes, poner un microfono en sala de conferencias, todo esto gracias a que para llegar a la altura de las misiones de campaña necesitas subir de nivel, ademas se vuelve muy molesto el no poder encontrar el camino correcto, si, no se si es problema mio o el mapa que pusieron es completamente inutil.

-Las mejoras de armas de wolfenstein me parece excelente no entiendo cual fue la razon por la que decidieron agregar la necesidad de conseguir una moneda dentro del juego para comprar las mejoras, tal vez por los skins que agregaron y otras pavadas que me parece muy bien para la personalizacion del personaje, pero podes comprar lingotes de oro con dinero real para hacer todo este proceso mas rapido esta es la verdadera razon, totalmente innecesario.

-El multijugador, personalmente juego solo, me gusta ir con blazko a los tiros pero a veces prefiero ir en sigilo matandolos uno a uno, aca perdes esto, tenes la opcion de jugar con amigos obvio, con otra gente que hacen lo que quieren o con una IA que tambien hace lo que quiere.

-Un detalle que puede parecer una minimo pero realmente es muy molesto, por mas que jueges offline no tenes pausa al elegir misiones, mejorar el personaje o las armas ni al presionar ESC.

Una decepcion, en algun momento cuando su precio baje probablemente lo compre solo para darme el gusto de conocer la historia, pero el precio que tiene no esta a la altura de lo que promete.

Características
Rocket League é um jogo competitivo que foca no gameplay e skill dos jogadores, assim como outros jogos competitivos, você precisa investir uma quantidade de tempo para conseguir tirar melhor proveito das capacidades competitivas dele. Não se desanime nas primeiras horas/dias se ver que você não consegue fazer tudo aquilo que seus oponentes fazem ou o que vê no youtube, tudo isso você alcança com treino ou experiência.

Gameplay
Diferente de tudo que já vi, traz mecânicas inovadoras de controle e sempre surgem novas formas de reinventar a jogabilidade. Há a possibilidade de se jogar com o teclado ou com o controle, e as estatísticas para esses usos parecem ser bem divididas, aparentemente metade dos jogadores usam um ou outro. No entanto, se você sentiu muita dificuldade com o teclado, pode experimentar o controle que você provavelmente vai se achar.

Performance
Rocket League é um jogo que vai de leve ao pesado, e isso depende MUITO da sua máquina. Tenha certeza de ver direitinho os requerimentos mínimos e comparar com a sua máquina. Por se tratar de um jogo competitivo, todo tipo de lag, tanto de memória, quanto de conexão, vão impactar o seu desempenho no jogo diretamente, e por isso talvez eu não recomende caso você tenha um computador mais básico (sem placa de vídeo dedicada, principalmente).

Conclusão
De um modo geral, é um jogo que tem um potencial muito grande de proporcionar muitas horas de diversão para você (veja quantas eu tenho haha), não há nenhum aspecto pay-to-win, todos os itens comercializáveis são puramente visuais. A física do jogo embora seja questionada por muitos, é aprimorada constantemente em busca de impedir que se torne um problema ao jogador, e na minha opinião, atualmente ela não apresenta nenhum tipo de impecilho para o jogador.

The only reason to compare this game to CS:GO is for the importance of utility, strategy, and the core competitive game mode: Bomb.  Both games are very different in what kind of skills you need.  In Rainbow, aim is not at all as important as positioning, patience, and game sense.  The most important parts of this game are learning maps, knowing where to be when, and using the game's incredibly complex map-destruction aspects to your advantage.  The game is fun for both competitive and casual plays (since the casual game-mode isn't stupid like CS's).  The operator mechanics in the game add a certain mastery to each strategy but as they add more operators, too many do the same thing or just cancel out others, which adds unneeded redundancy to the game.  I would recommend this game to anyone who likes tactical slow-paced and team oriented shooters.  Rainbow is one of the best games to either chill with friends, or strive to get to the ever-growing competitive/pro scene.  I definitely recommend this game.

I was totally unfamiliar with this world before purchasing this game 3 years ago and finishing the Bloody Baron storyline was my first sign that this game was not screwing around, that no matter what you decide sometimes there is no lesser evil. Evil is just evil. 

The main story isn't all either, this depth of storytelling carries over into side quests to create a fully fleshed out world that can take hundreds of hours just for one full completion. It has some graphical hitches from time to time, but the world is quite beautiful. From breathtaking sunsets to the fairytale realm of Toussaint.

[h1][b]DOOM 2016 - полноценное ли оправдание ожиданий?[/b][/h1]

[i]Обо всём по порядку. И впервую очередь хотелось бы затронуть именно внутриигровую кампанию. Ведь она безоговорочно оправдала все мои ожидания. 

Дикий экшон под взрывную музыку - то, что обязательно должно присутствовать в DOOM. Кромсать демонов одно удовольствие и не надоедает в течение всего прохождения. Звуковое сопровождение не ограничивается одним тяжелым саундтреком. На некоторых уровнях играет что-то по типу церковной музыки. Примерный аналог можно услышать в меню того же Дарк Соулс III.

Насчет геймплея в кампании DOOM сомневаться не стоит. Имея приличный оружейный ассортимент (от простого пистолета до старого доброго BFG-9000), гасим толпы демонов, оставляя повсюду нескончаемое море крови. Как я и сказал, это не даст вам заскучать ни на секунду. Каждое оружие можно модифицировать за найденные на уровнях модификаторы, что дает дополнительный режим огня. В любой момент переключайтесь между режимами, вносив разнообразие в бой. Режимы огня можно улучшать, выполняя приписанные к ним челенджи. 
Костюм ГГ так же не остался без возможности прокачки. Прокачка порадовала своей обширностью, что позволяет сделать из вас настоящую машину для уничтожения демонов. Способ восстановления здоровья и брони остался классическим. Поднимаем аптечки и регенераторы брони с трупов демонов или же просто лежащие на земле. Игра заметно стимулирует убивать демонов врукопашную, что вознаграждается выпадением аммо и хилок. В игре это называется как "Зверские убийства." Демоны оглушаются, когда у них остается совсем малое кол-во здоровья. И в этот момент вы можете выполнить то самое зверское убийство. Причем имеется множество вариантов. Можно свернуть шею, выполнив убийство сзади. Выполнить подсечку, подойдя сзади и прицелившись в ногу. В прыжке, размазав голову об землю и т.д. Зверские убийства выглядят очень зрелищно, что невольно хочется выполнять их раз за разом.
Для любителей пасхалок в игру запихнули много различных плюшек. Остылки к разным фильмам и играм вероятно очень порадуют вас.

По мультиплееру я не могу сказать однозначно. Я ожидал, что наконец выйдет годный ФПС мультиплеер, способный заменить мне КоД, но, увы... Месиво, конечно, здесь присутсвует, которое, кстати, прерывается лишь окончанием раунда. Ведь во время матча идет нескончаемая мясорубка. С одной стороны - это не может не радовать, но с другой - врага совсем невозможно зачастую контроливать. В большинстве случаев получается, что ты убиваешь топлы со спины, либо аналогично расстреливают тебя. В основном народ можно встретить на гейммодах: ТДМ, превосходство и тропа войны. Остальные будто вовсе не играются.
Но чем действительно может похвастаться сетевая игра - это кастомизация. У нее огромные масштабы для тех, кому нравится прорабатывать своего персонажа до мелочей. По мере прокачки анлокаются варианты кастомизации тела, левой и правой рук, ног и шлема. Куча вариантов цветовых раскрасок вашей брони, причем по желанию можно выбрать материал (глянец или матовый). Аналогично кастомизация распростроняется и на оружие. Его можно раскрашивать в несколько слоев и накладывать различные узоры. 
Разработчики пообещали в дальнейшем усовершенствовать сетевую игру, что дает надежды увидеть что-то эпичненькое и интересное в будущем.

Можно еще затронуть раздел SnapMap, который придется по душе творческим геймерам. Огромные просторы для создания игровых карт и режимов. В игре уже можно встретить немало созданных карт, наглядно показывающие что можно выполнить в этом разделе.[/i]

Поначалу, эта игра может затянуть вас на несколько дней, ведь ты не замечаешь тех или иных ошибок. Но позже, через какое-то время тебя начнёт сводить с ума надоевший геймплей, тупорылые боты и одни и те же карты. Но несмотря на всё это, Ravenfield подойдёт для тех, кому надо убить время или отдохнуть от тех же онлайн-шутеров, постреляв в ИИ.

ДАЛЕЕ: Раньше разработчик пилил действительно годные обновления: поэтому я очень ждал выход режима "Conquest". В итоге: режим меня разочаровал (На данной стадии игры). Вы скажете "Чувак, игру делает ОДИН человек, прояви терпение". Я уже пытался терпеть все вышеперечисленные нюансы ЭТОГО творения - но рано или поздно терпение кончается у всех.

А что насчёт БОТОВ? А с ними здесь происходит какая-то муть: вражеские боты могут убить тебя за считанные секунды, в то время как союзники неспособны НИ захватить флаг, НИ защитить его, НИ уничтожить танк или БТР, который приехал на точку (Я лично видел, как боты бегали вокруг танка, "пытаясь" взорвать его, но в итоге они просто на него залезали до тех пор, пока тот их всех не убьёт).

ИТОГ: Игра получила популярность только благодаря ЮТУБЕРАМ, а не какой-то рекламы на сайтах (например), а за это время она успела несколько раз пробить дно! Кто-то ещё говорит, что "У ИГРЫ ЕСТЬ ПАТЕНЦЫАЛ!", но лично мне так не кажется.

Стоит ли вам покупать игру или нет - это ВАШЕ РЕШЕНИЕ. Но лично я вот что скажу: если вы хотите сэкономить деньги и время, проведённое в этом шлаке - лучше пройдите мимо, и посмотрите что-нибудь другое. Но НИКАК НЕ ЭТО!

Excelente juego, maravilloso, gráficos hermosos y con mods queda aún más precioso.
Me he jugado toda la saga de The Witcher desde el 1 al 2 y esta entrega fue a la que le he dedicado más tiempo y con  mucha razón.

[h1]Puntos positivos desde mi punto de vista:[/h1]
- [b]Posibilidad de pasar misiones de alto nivel si eres bueno en el juego:[/b] Mientras exploraba Velen, Novigrado o Skellege, es normal encontrarse con misiones secundarias de alto nivel donde los enemigos pueden acabarte de un golpe, pero esto no hace imposible que puedas acabar con ellos y poder completar la misión a pesar de tu nivel y esto hace que el combate con ese o esos enemigos sea más intenso y épico, sobre todo cuando logras acabar con ellos sin que te hayan dado ningún golpe.

- [b]Mundos vivos y libres de explorar como quieras:[/b] la cantidad de puntos de interés que puedes explorar es gigante y aunque si la zona de las Islas Skellege explorarlas al 100% es tedioso porque el barco es lento y si las Sirenas te lo rompen quedas varado en el mar debes volver a tierra firme nadando o si eres listo como yo ah, instalando el mod de Fast-Traveler podrás volver rápidamente a tierra.

- [b]Misiones Secundarias vivas que afectan la zona o historia:[/b] Me encanta que cada misión secundaria sea tan importante o algunas sean incluso mejor que las principales, cada una con su historia, su profundidad, incluso los contratos de brujo te cuentan una historia que te hace pensar si cobrarles mucho o nada según su situación. Además que hay varias misiones secundarias que afectan tu rumbo por el mundo, como en Velen o la reina de Skellege.

- [b]Varios Finales:[/b] El juego trae por lo que tengo entendido 3 finales principales, esto lo hace más rejugable y dan ganas de querer ver que hubiese pasado si tomaba esta decisión.

- [b]Expansiones:[/b] Las expansiones son maravillosas, Hearts of Stone la encontré bastante interesante, sobre todo con la aparición de nuestra amiga 7w7 del primer juego y ahora mismo estoy jugando la segunda expansión del nuevo mundo de Toussaint de Blood and Wine y es una zona que ya me tiene interesado haciendo todas las misiones secundarias.

[h1]Puntos negativos desde mi punto de vista:[/h1]
- [b]Imposibilidad de hacer viajes rápidos mientras no sea en un cartel de viaje rápido:[/b] Quedar en medio del mar en Skellege porque unas Sirenas destrozaron tu barco no es muy divertido que digamos.

- [b]Algunos bugs visuales en el mar:[/b] Zonas en el mar que no se ven objetos pero igual tu barco sufre daños o ver cajas flotando, etc. Bugs mínimos pero que puede fastidiar a más de uno.

- [b]Muertes random por caer de zonas no muy altas:[/b] Esto me jodía bastante y quedaba re WTF cuando ocurría.

- [b]Desgaste de armaduras y espadas:[/b] Esto molesta un montón porque si estas en medio de un combate épico, te deja mal tener que pausar el juego para ir al inventario y reparar tus armaduras mientras estás en medio de un combate.

[h1]En conclusión:[/h1]
- Es un juego que recomiendo bastante si te gusta el RPG, sin dudas es uno de mis juegos favoritos de la saga junto al primero, aunque si bien sus puntos negativos hace algo tedioso el juego en algunas ocasiones, existe una comunidad que le da solución a los puntos negativos con mods con los cuales puedes mejorar tu experiencia de juego, las horas que le puedes invertir al juego explorando su mundo son muchas, pero valdrá la pena.

[h1]Ahora Recomendaciones:[/h1]
- Instalar mods como Fast Traveler, Map Markers, All quest on Map, No fall damage, mejoran mucho la experiencia de juego.

- Comprar y "leer" libros (si quieres los lees, pero ábrelos) esto para desbloquear puntos de interés o entradas de bestias para el bestiario (esto ha sido esencial desde el primer juego).

- Crea elixires y aceites con el loot que te entregan los enemigos al matarlos para así utilizarlos en combates más complicados a futuro.

- Utiliza aceites, los aceites son esenciales contra cada bestia y para saber que aceite utilizar puedes revisar el bestiario.

- Hablar con los dueños de posadas para pedirles que te cuenten rumores, siempre puedes obtener información útil o misiones secundarias con ellos.

Mi experiencia con este juego ha sido muy buena. El juego base (The Island) te da muchas horas de juego, hay una cantidad enorme de animales que domesticar y a los que enfrentarte y pasa lo mismo con los objetos que puedes fabricar. El mapa es muy grande por lo que necesitarás mucho tiempo para explorarlo entero. El juego te permite hacer bases y otras construcciones muy personalizables, lo que hace que esa rama del juego sea muy interesante.
El multijugador es mucho más entretenido ya que ademas de tener que sobrevivir, te tendrás que enfrentar a otros jugadores y evitar que ataquen tu base poniendo defensas.

El contenido de la Workshop es muy extenso y agrega un montón más de contenido al juego.

En cuanto a los DLCs recomiendo comprarlos cuanto más baratos mejor porque, aunque me parezcan muy buenos (con buenos biomas, animales distintos y nuevos objetos), los he llegado a ver por 20€ y me parece excesivo.

En mi opinión, lo mejor es comprar el season pack, pero si quieres comprar uno o dos DLCs solamente esta es la mejor opción para comprar de mejor a peor (en mi opinion):
-Extinction (Muy buen mapa, bosses muy buenos y animales interesantes)
-Genesis 1 (5 mapas más pequeños pero mejor ambientados, funciones nuevas)
-Aberration (Mapa muy complicado pero muy bonito, con animales interesantes también)
-Scorched Earth (Mapa también un poco complicado y con algún animal destacado como el Wyvern)

El juego aún siendo muy bueno y recomendable tiene algunos puntos negativos como por ejemplo ciertas dificultades al buscar servidores o ciertos bugs que, aún habiendo corregido la mayoría, siguen existiendo. 

También he de decir que para jugar se necesita un ordenador bastante potente.

My best round was me sitting in a house in the center of the safe zone with a shotgun for 90% of the round. Oh sure that 10 seconds of smug satisfaction of a sudden shotgun kill was ok, but it was the most boring thing I could have done, yet I was rewarded the most points just because I was one of the last people alive.

Alternatively I could have run around trying to kill other people, which would have resulted in a faster, slightly more interesting game (if I didn't get headshotted by someone I didn't know existed) for half the points I got from sitting still for 30 minutes if I 'm REALLY lucky.

The only mode that I actually felt like I had fun in was squad just because I could coordinate with my friends.

On top of everything it's an unoptimized machine hog. My first round consisted of me hearing the game while staring at a loading screen. When it finally loaded I was already kicked out of the plane and killed by someone else. These issues seemed to get better as I loaded the game repeatedly but regardless I could never get a round where I felt like the game was working fine. Multiple times I was killed while the game was loading something because it froze my computer.

Look, if you like running around for 20 minutes to find supplies only to die in a fight that lasts less than 5 seconds, if you really just get a hard on for that kind of realism, then this game is fine. But for me, I've played a lot of FPS/TPS games and the satisfaction you get in this game is so seldom and fleeting I can't imagine why anyone would want to slog through the grind of finding supplies each time you restart.

While some things haven't changed since Fallout 3, there are some new features that make this game an improved version of its older brother.  The new crafting system is one of the best new features of the Fallout franchise. I had loads of fun scavenging and crafting guns and armor. Not to mention taking care of my settlement. (Can't these people plant food by their own? ;) ). Of course the new speech system gives your character a life of its own, making you feel like more than just a passive observer. 
The plot line was good but perhaps not the best. Maybe because I have expected something a bit more moving at the end, but still, I did feel a catharsis going through the end. This game is loaded with homages and Easter eggs of sci-fi books and movies which makes it worthwhile anyway. My only real issue with the gameplay was the repeated quests which at some point become really annoying. There is a look that never ends which makes you feel like you keep having an unfinished business. At one point I just ignored most of them and continued playing the main quest.
Bottom line: 
This is the game Fallout fans have been waiting for, Bethesda has delivered the job, giving us the respect we deserves as gamers.

罗马2作为本睾丸第二个玩的全站，自然在我心中占了不小的分量，首先将军在罗马2中将是一个非常重要的角色。前作里 面，你可以在一小支通过升级的军队里面挑选将军。现在部队除非有将军领导，否者不能移动，而且将军的数量也被限制，根据你的帝国的等级。随着时间的过去， 被将领领导的军队还能够获得厉害的军团传统。这是一个重大转变,影响从军队如何构造地区如何操作战略地图。领土以省份的形式呈现，如果你能占领该省份的所 有城市，则可以发布重要的谕令（可以快速的产出粮食——面对食物短缺的麻烦）。现在城市建筑可以影响到全省。在罗马建造一个高级的军事训练建筑，你可以在 意大利的任何区域都能招募到高级军种。新的单位通过将领在野外召集，而不用千里迢迢的从军营赶来。
这是一个非常重大的改革，基本奠定了以后阿提拉以及最新的战锤的基本大纲，军队 更加多样化，要归功于军队多样化的姿态。可以让他们以“急行军”指令快速行军，建造野外军营通过指令“筑营”，或者是在战略地图上设下埋伏。这样有利于玩 家更好的控制大片区域。同盟将会更加值得建立，可以每回合给你交保护费，还可以在地图上指定开战位置，让他们作为仆从军加入战斗。
舍去了幕府2那糟糕的外交系统，增加了对应可以使用的辅助军团，各势力兵力差距明显，战术更多样化。----评分90。。下面来看看优缺点增减分
   
   1：新奇的将军系统，没有将军部队就不能移动，奠定了以后全站的基础。+4分

   2：新的外交系统，舍弃了幕府2垃圾般的外交，取而代之独立对盟友/敌人的外交力度。+5分

   3：各势力兵种差距明显，每个势力都有侧重点，还多了辅助兵团，征服一个地方可以增招辅助兵协助作战，方针和矛盾对骑兵的压制力度更加强大。+3分

   4：实行一省多城，多个城市独立计算，但是可以在省内任何一个城池招募本省城市建筑下的士兵，分主城支城。+4分

   5：动作完美，比如如果军队正遭受弓箭袭击，他们会举起盾牌，箭矢纷纷落下，让他们看起来就像一群刺猬一样。他们击溃对手后， 会爆发欢呼。你也可以看到逃跑的部队的疲惫姿态。+3分

   6：对地形和天气侧重点增强，还多了急行军这种战略意义的行军手段。+2分

   
                                                                        下面来说说缺点


   1：AI无比愚蠢，经常会小规模或者攻城战对准一个你防守力度投入兵力极大的防御地方进行炮灰式的攻击。-3分

   2：极其糟糕的内政系统，家族影响力固然好，但是一旦你的军队失利，会导致你的政敌威望大大增加，导致很多时候任命将领都是自己家族的人，不管其他家族的人优秀不优秀。-4分

   3：敌人的军队感觉永远杀不光，每次都能逃跑一小部分然后到处搞破坏。-2分

   4：战舰感觉完全就是近身肉搏的，很少用进入射程就开始射箭的。-2分

   5：本体很多内容没有，太过于依靠DLC，如果没猛犬DLC，很多势力没很强力的破甲单位。-3分



                                                          最后来一句结尾


       蠢罗马，智商低，永远打不出亚平宁；迦太基，真可惜，地盘破碎人人欺。伊比利亚标枪雨，步行游牧惹不起。北上高卢凯尔特，阿维尼尔常崛起。隔海死宅爱希尼，偏安一隅无人理。蛮中之蛮日耳曼，棒子敲遍天下敌。基佬成群马其顿，伙伴骑兵难匹敌。命悬一线皮大王，巴尔干的RBQ。全面残废斯巴达，不肛基友难贸易。没有城墙叙拉古，阿基米德要气醒。半岛一霸帕加马，经常杀到东方地。科尔基斯疯瑞星，见谁咬谁牙齿利。辛梅里亚重装弓，不怕游牧来冲锋。不伦不类是本都，东方希腊分不清。帕提亚，铁甲骑，团结东方众小弟；亚美尼亚好翻译，罗马太君这边请。西徐亚，多弓骑，马勒泰格冲锋骑；还有一系默抹泪，没有特色存在低。背井离乡加拉太，忘却誓言无后期，海外游子小红帽，异军突起偏远地。昔日霸主塞琉古，一朝跌落沦为妓。妹控天堂托勒密，安逸无边是埃及。

You essentially have to get your survivors, the last remnants of humanity and organise them into the last city. You write new laws, create religions, keep up hopes and keep down discontent. You need the heater running at all times so you have to get coal, but you also need wood and steel for other buildings. 

nothing prepared me for this though, never have I been on the edge of my seat like that in a game. And when the angry mobs got tired of my despotic ways they took me outside and executed me....and I loved every minute of it.

This game is an absolute masterpiece of the genre and deserves at least a couple of playthroughs by everyone.

Do you find yourself downloading an SNES emulator to every one of your computers just so that you can play the Megaman X series? Well then, this is the perfect game for you! Honestly, this game has tight controls and the gameplay is fantastic. Collecting upgrades throughout the game, stealing enemy powers and just straight up keeping your buster charged 99% of the time, this game oozes Megaman X out of it's asshole in a very good way. It's worth noting, however, that this game does a very good job of not being EXACTLY Megaman X. It has some roguelike traits that keep the game very entertaining. No lives. When you die, you lose absolutely everything. While playing the game you collect some currency which can be used on the ship you end up in everytime you die to purchase upgrades and stuff. Some of the upgrades even dare to change some of the core mechanics of the game itself. Dope Shyt. HIGHLY, HIGHLY, HIGHLY, recommended to anyone who misses the Megaman series.

app_name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
review:
Skyrim è una fidanzata crudele, fredda, alle volte sadica, che ti tratta male, ti ignora, si dimentica il tuo compleanno, sminuisce i tuoi successi.
Però è bella come il sole, quando vai in giro ti godi una vista mozzafiato, ha la voce di una fata.
Peccato che quando parla ha la complessità della tria, la profondità intellettuale della pagine gialle e la stabilità di uno schizofrenico.

Questo gioco rivive grazie alle mod, che vanno a tappare i buchi di una produzione tutt'altro che perfetta. Il titolo è stato SEMPRE acclamato in modo esagerato, con recensioni che ignoravano totalmente i problemi immensi di cui il titolo soffriva, perdonando ingenuità e chiare mancanze.
D'altra parte, Skyrim è un gioco unico, dall'ambientazione stupenda, una colonna sonora sublime, un motore grafico instabile ma elastico abbastanza da lasciare spazio a mod tanto ben fatte da lasciar estrefatti, un gameplay incredibilmente sbilanciato e superficiale che viene a sua volta rimodellato dalal community con sistemi e meccaniche talmente complesse da renderlo quasi perfetto, con animazioni legnose e mal gestite, un doppiaggio alle volte adeguato, altre volte atroce.
La mappa di gioco presenta un'ambientazione straordinaria, incredibilmente evocativa, ma il level design lascia a desiderare, con alcuni dungeon a dir poco orrendi. La ripetizione degli stessi moduli, sopratutto quelli abitativi, è fin troppo lampante. Il sistema economico è uno scherzo, il crafting è decente, migliorato dalle mod fino a renderlo eccezionale.

Insomma, senza le mod questo titolo sarebbe costellato da alti e bassi da capogiro, tanto da renderlo al massimo discreto. 

Il lavoro fatto dalla community lo ha reso uno dei titoli più longevi della storia dei videogames, una pietra miliare della passione dei giocatori. Questo titolo sembra creato più per ispirare che per intrattenere e per quanto chiunque possa trovarci una miriade di difetti e bug, pochi riusciranno ad odiarlo a tal punto da abbandonarlo rapidamente.

Se cercate un rpg con una trama solida, personaggi ben fatti e carismatici, quest complesse e strutturate, Skyrim NON fa per voi. Se però volete un ambientazione stupenda e siete pronti a moddare il gioco allo stremo, sarete ricompensati con un'esperienza straordinaria e soddisfacente.

Considerate che con poco impegno, potete tramutare Skyrim in un Soulslike in tutto e per tutto. Oppure in Super mario...

"Planet Coaster® - the future of coaster park simulation games has arrived! Surprise, delight and thrill incredible crowds as you build your coaster park empire - let your imagination run wild, and share your success with the world." 

Following the years-long drought of park-management simulators in the gaming world, with money-grabby titles such as roller coaster tycoon world and RCT-mobile, Planet Coaster aimed to be the savior, the shining light in the darkness. And it was... The game created by Frontier, the original creators of the fan-favorite classic RCT3, are back with their own franchise of a park-management simulator, but the question is, does this game really qualify as a "park-management simulator"?

I know you have already read the thousands of reviews there are for this game so there really is no need for me to bring up all the great things about this game, the graphics, soundtrack, rides, guests, realism to an extent, overall creative ability that it unlocks for so many builders. I will however bring up the two negatives that still really do hinder this games ability to be the next great park-management simulator, that is: the management aspect of it, and the optimization. 

Now of course optimization really is entirely based on what sort of hardware you are running, obviously the person with the 10k PC with 4 1080ti's and an i7 will rarely see dips below 60+ fps with 8,000 guests, and conversely the poor sap trying to play on his laptop with intel graphics on low will never be able to see his park grow past 100 guests or else risk having his computer be fried. This game like Frontier's last developed game, RCT3, suffers from bad omptimization to an extent. Once the level of detail and the number of guests in your park rises to a certain extent the game just shits the bed. It seems like a common trend in the gaming world today to not fully optimize and polish your product, especially for full-games like this. It is sad but it isn't the end of the world becuase the game is still playable (albiet at sub 30 fps) and enjoyable even past that point. Cranking up the graphics and taking pictures of your finished park is one of the greatest feelings for any builder and this game is no exception. My biggest gripe with this game instead comes from the lack of management aspects.

It seems that this game since early development was made with a focus on looking pretty and allowing players freedom to build whatever they want, not so much so as a park management simulator. As someone who has played the original roller coaster tycoons for the majority of my childhood, I can say that this game really is lacking in management and difficulty. Its just too easy to make money in this game which makes it less fun to play, build, and maintain your own park.  

Overall I would still recommend this game over any of the new alternatives that came out recently, especially if you enjoy building fully-themed parks that look amazing, but if are a die-hard coaster building fan I would suggest saving your money and picking up RCT1 or 2 to relieve that park management itch.

Une fois de plus, Valve frappe extrêmement fort.

Cet opus de la cultissime saga "Half-Life" se situe entre le 1er et le 2ème épisode, on y incarne Alyx qui doit sauver son père, Eli, capturé par le Cartel.

Je ne vous ferais pas l'affront de dévoiler quoi que ce soit vis à vis de ce jeu, car clairement il est rempli de séquences mémorables et d'idées de game-design géniales qu'il ne faudrait en aucun cas spoiler.

La seule chose que je vais dire : c'est que ce jeu redéfinit les codes du jeu d'aventure en VR, il est très classique, voire "traditionnel" dans son concept de base (fps linéaire et scénarisé) mais brille particulièrement grâce à l'harmonie entre ses différents éléments.

Le gameplay, par exemple, est particulièrement bien ficelé, malgré le fait que ce soit un simple shooter, ce jeu récompense particulièrement l'exploration, et est rempli de petits easter eggs, le feeling des armes à feu est très bon (bien qu'on ait malheureusement très peu d'armes à notre disposition, au final). Les gunfights sont intenses, le bestiaire varié, et la sensation d'être "là" est réelle, jamais je n'ai autant été immergé dans un jeu de ma vie. Attention cependant, il peut être particulièrement physique de temps à autres (il faut s'accroupir très régulièrement).

Pour ce qui est de la mise en scène, Valve en a parcouru du chemin, et c'est désormais une référence en terme d'immersion que nous avons là. Les "cinématiques actives" comme j'aime les appeler (c'est à dire une cinématique où nous sommes physiquement présent, et nous pouvons interagir) fonctionnent à merveille, et j'ai été surpris de constater que je jouais le jeu, sans même le savoir. J'ETAIS Alyx Vance.

La bande son, comme celle de tout Half Life, fait son job et est très efficace. Elle ne marquera pas les esprits, mais elle a le mérite d'être là.

Graphiquement, ce jeu est, à ce jour, le plus beau jeu VR que j'ai pu voir de mon existence. Le source Engine 2 est hallucinant, tant par sa physique que l'animation des objets et des personnages.


Pour résumer, si vous avez un casque, achetez-le sans hésiter.
Si vous n'avez pas de casque, achetez un casque, puis achetez le.

Je l'ai fait via l'Oculus Quest (et donc via l'Oculus Link), et pas de bug notables, hormis des crashs intempestifs (qui sont à priori dus à la dernière mise à jour du logiciel Oculus). Ma carte graphique est une GTX 1080 et le jeu tournait à la perfection en ultra.

Un chef d'oeuvre, et une grande révolution pour le jeu vidéo en VR. J'espère que Valve continuera sur sa lancée et nous sortira d'autres projets de cette envergure.

If you made it as far as to looking at the reviews of this game, I can clearly tell you: Buy it.

It's a rogue-like with a simple quest: Escape hell. Can you do it after a few hours of playing? Probably. But the real question to ask is: In how many ways can you do it? And if I say alot, I truly mean alot. At first, you will find the obvious synergies. Having one god as your main pillar and build it from there. But you soon realize that you have to adapt because that strategy doesn't work this time. Then you start trying out new tricks the game presents to you. You find new synergies every game and with all of the five weapons, there is almost boundless ways to shape your run.

In addition, rogue-likes tend to have almost no focus on everything other than the gameplay. But the developer of other hits such as Bastion really went the extra mile. Even after my 36 hours of gameplay, most voicelines are new. There is a small cool sidestory that will keep you going even more than the grapping gameplay itself. And the few songs I heard so far are fantastic. 

There are a few things you should keep in mind though. First, it is an early access game. The game does have a tempoary (and very good) ending, but the true ending is yet to be released. They have hit all the milestones they have set for themselves and I am sure that they will keep their promise to deliver a complete game once it releases this year. In addition, you will probably encounter a few bugs. In my 36 hours of gameplay, I had 1 bug that almost lost me the run and 1 bug you could play around. 

All in all, I can fully recomment the game.
