Super Spiel!
Als langjähriger Monster Hutner Fan bin ich sehr begeistert.
Super Grafik, vor allem wenn man es mit den Vorhergehenden Teilen vergleicht.
Verstehe 90% der negativen Reviews nicht.
Bei mir läufts selbst auf nem Laptop mit GTX 870M, i7-4700HQ(Quad mit 2,4GHz) und 8gb RAM auf niedrig flüssig.
Bei viel Effekten, z.B. Blitz Element auf Waffen mit 4 Leuten, sind die Frame Einbrüche gut erkennbar, was aber bei der Graka auch zu erwarten ist.
Trotzdem ist es perfekt spieltbar und sieht immer noch gut aus.
Spiele selber mit einem PS4 Controller und es funktioniert super. Steuerung schön einstellbar, so dass ich wie auf der PSP damals spielen kann, was mich sehr freut.

Zum Spiel:

Die neuen Monster sind intressant und die Karten sind einfach der Hammer. Kein Laden zwischen Gebieten (Generell niedrige Ladezeiten) und flüssiges bewegen über das komplexe Terrain, welches einem diverse Arten der interaktion bietet.
Das Hinzufügen von permanentem Schleifstein sowie Spitzhacke und Netz sind ein Wahrgewordener Traum.
Genau so dass sich Käfer, Kraut, Honig und Co im vorbeigehen einsammeln lassen.
Das Gameplay ist einfach extrem flüssig, was sich auf den sehr großen dynamsichen Karten extrem gut anfühlt.
Beim Schmied gibt es nun Waffenbäume, mehr muss ich nicht sagen dazu.

Schade ist, dass es einige Klassiker bzw alte Monstergattungen nicht mit ins Spiel geschafft haben, wie z.B. die Hermitauren.
Aktuell ist der Multiplayer noch etwas instabil, was das Spielen mit Freunden etwas erschwert, aber nicht unmöglich macht.

Fazit:

Das Spiel ist super und vor allem alten Monster Hunter Veteranan sehr ans Herz zu legen.
Das ganze Rumgeheule kann ich mir nur damit erklären wie verwöhnt die Leute heut zu Tage doch sind.

古墓重启的那一代那是惊天地泣鬼神啊，口碑销量双赢。虽说有点恐怖色彩但剧情走一遍下来我还是喜欢的不行。在劳拉被同行德雷克全面压制的时代古墓9真是打了个翻身仗。结果崛起出来之后，玩着玩着总是嘀咕，这和前作好像啊。这剧情完全是一个套路啊？！不就是多了点新工具然后换了个地点把故事又讲了一遍吗？？又是一个与世隔绝的村子，又是灵魂驱动的不死军团，又是一个不是知道什么鬼的上古神器。

不过晶体这次变聪明了，开头的部分简直是全作最好玩的地方！可能制作组也指望前两个小时套住大部分玩家吧，免得又来一群人退款~但抱怨是抱怨，晶体还是把该改的都改了，改加的都加了，态度还是好的。虽说有点雷同，但依然是一个很棒的作品。

这次还取消了前作饱受批评的多人，双人生存还是后来dlc加的，说实话还是挺无聊。但探险队确实让游戏时间大大延长。

Death Stranding isn't just a game. It's an experience, where you need to set your mind to the rules this game gives you. This game might look weird in eyes of many reviewers and in trailers, but unless you try and play this game, you won't know what it really is. It is really hard to describe what this game is about. Great story with meaning? Sure, but not only. Gameplay is very pleasing, even though it looks like you just deliver packages from point A to B. I thought that way myself too. But there are many more things into it. The most innovative thing for me is the bridge link system. You don't play with others, but you can place things like ladders, ropes to climb or just leave some useful tools in storages for other couriers. The currency in this game is like, so people can like those activities. When you get likes and put more and more things into the world, the more constructions of other players will show up on the map. It really looks like simulated community that rebuilds certain area after the apocalypse has begun. And also you can feel like you are part of something good.

A very enjoyable stealth shooter game.

Although the game has no mechanics that are particularly flashy, unique or varied what it does have is very solid. The stealth system is well done and the computer enemies have diverse intelligence; responding relatively logically to what happens to them. The fact that players have a pistol, rifle and sub machine gun at all times allows for a lot of choice and adaption while playing. As players can swap on the fly between precise long range sniping, medium and close range assault, and potentially close range stealth shooting. There are a decent amount of explosives and the like put into the environment to allow for players to be more strategic, and a decent amount of various explosives and tactical items players can use as traps.

The missions are relatively straight forward but the maps are quite fleshed out and visually diverse, with there being multiple side objectives which give players reason to explore the whole map. Because the maps are so large at times, and the enemy layouts are split up, it allows players to approach each division of enemies as if it was a fresh start. Meaning if players end up alerting a whole section of enemies and fight them all straight up with no stealth, the other sections of enemies won't be alerted and so players can choose to attack them differently if they feel like it. The consequences of getting caught or fighting out in the open do not leak through the whole map. 

The game is also very forgiving with its heads up display. The target reticle will go red when aimed at an enemy even if you can't see them because you're in a bush or something. The empty lung mechanic basically telling players what the drop off of their rifle shot will be so they can aim without having to account for realistic bullet dropping. The mini map displays the locations of all enemies in the area at all times, and players can tag enemies using their binoculars so they can see them literally at all times. This is great for making the gameplay relatively casual in that players do not need to be extremely cautious and paranoid wherever they go. Players are told where everything is so they can fight and enjoy the game without having to worry about tagging every enemy in the map from a distance, checking their corners for any signs of movement at all times, getting shot in the back out of nowhere.

Even on medium graphics the game both looks great and runs great, being very well optimized for the computer. The game also having a decent level up system with perks, weapon masteries, and weapon unlocks.


Main problem with the game is throwing things. The transitions for throwing things while behind cover are very awkward and glitchy at times. The visual line guiding the throwing path of a projectile also is inaccurate as it doesn't take into account projectiles bigger then a stone. So, the line can pass over something completely and signify that the throw will reach its destination, but if the player is throwing something like a stick grenade it will not actually pass over that thing if the line is too close to any obstructions. Because the line is much thinner then the thing you are throwing so it can pass over and through things some projectiles can't. Even though the game says that throw is fine and will reach its destination.

There's also little emphasis or story, exposition, looting or detailed exploration however, it's all just about shooting enemies. There is enough plot to make it feel like there is some kind of reason and context to why the player is doing what they are doing, but that's all it is really for. Although fundamentally it is still yet another trivialization of war and human atrocities by turning them into a game.

It's great to just play for the raw shooting experience, but only that.

Acabei de terminar o jogo e...o resumo que posso dar é: SIMPLESMENTE FANTÁSTICO.
A hat in time me levou a um passeio pelo agradável túnel do tempo, para uma época simples, onde eu jogava Super Mario 64 sentado no chão a tarde toda. Esse jogo de plataforma possui fases extremamente memoráveis,repletas de personagens carismáticos que te fazem querer platinar o jogo sem nem hesitar. A história, por mais que simples, acaba sendo bem simples de compreender e te prende para saber o desfecho simplesmente incrível. A jogabilidade se altera conforme as fases e as habilidades dos chapéus que adquire ao longo do jogo. E a música... é aqui onde o jogo mais brilha, as músicas se encaixam perfeitamente com cada fase do jogo, além de serem muito agradáveis de se ouvir (não foi a toa que enquanto jogava, eu ficava cantarolando no ritmo de várias... UHAUSHAUHUAH).
Uma coisa que eu não cheguei a gostar tanto foi o fato de terem poucas fases, mesmo com as duas DLCs, ainda fiquei com aquele gostinho de "quero mais", mas ao mesmo tempo, acho que se fossem muuuuitas fases, o jogo ficaria muito monótono.
Como conclusão, posso dizer que a hat in time é um jogo de plataforma que resgata e muito a sensação de muitas pessoas mais velhas que viveram a época de ouro dos jogos de plataforma, assim como pode ser uma boa opção para quem nunca esteve neste universo. O jogo também tem um modo coop local e online (se comprar a DLC Nyakuza Metro), que por incrível que pareça, me proporcionou algumas experiências um tanto quanto divertidas durante a jogatina, devido aos encontros com outras pessoas desconhecidas jogando...AUHAUHAUHAUAUH.

Es un buen juego que me genera una sensación de amor/odio, porque tiene cosas geniales y cosas imperdonables para un título de este tipo. Así que en lugar de hacer una review con puntuación como de costumbre, voy a dar puntos a favor y en contra:

A favor:
- Muchas localizaciones y contexto histórico congruente, aunque la trama sea fantástica. Hay mucho trabajo de tratar de reproducir el Egipto del siglo I.
- Gráficos espectaculares
- Mapa enorme, con muchos puntos para perderte explorando
- Muchas horas de juego, más que sus predecesores, que se quedaban cortos
- Mejor combate que sus predecesores

En contra:
- El movimiento de escalar y de sigilo es más torpe. Han mejorado el combate, pero el personaje a veces hace cosas raras que estropean la experiencia
- La IA de los enemigos es muy pobre para un juego triple A.
- Profundidad del loot. Siendo un juego que puedes exprimir durante 100 horas si visitas todo, pierde mucho que el loot de tesoros y zonas solo sean armas y poco más. Debería tener más complejidad.
- Desbalanceo de niveles: a menos que elijas el balanceo automático de nivel de enemigos, subes demasiado rápido de nivel si haces secundarias y exploras, por lo que incluso en dificultad máxima el juego es demasiado fácil

Conclusión: lo recomiendo, pero por los pelos

Historia: 6/10. La historia principal está guay, pero las secundarias son muy simples. Larga duración.
Gráficos: 9/10. Lo mejor del juego, los paisajes de Egipto son brutales. La opción de simplemente pasear y explorar enriquece mucho el juego.
Jugabilidad: 4.5/10. El combate aunque lo han mejorado, sigue siendo torpe. El movimiento estropea mucho la experiencia. Lo tengo que suspender en este apartado.
Total: 6.5/10. Merece la pena comprarlo en rebajas y darle una oportunidad.

[h1]There's two types of people in the world: [/h1]
[b] [olist]
    [1]People who [i]hunt[/i].
    [2]People who [i]hide[/i].
[/olist] [/b]

This game will help you find out what type of person you are. 
Fight or flight instincts really kick you in the teeth playing this game, 
especially when you're 15 minutes in the midst of a battle royale skirmish;
where you either fight to be the last man standing 
[i]or[/i] fly to a dark hole to quietly die.

I think my heart rate even elevates in nearly every game i've played and I haven't had this feeling playing a First Person Shooter in a [u]long time[/u]. I've sunk 30 hours into it and learned quite a bit, about the game, about myself and about whether or not this was a worthwhile purchase.

The gunplay is snappy and sound design for this game is amazing regarding the guns & footsteps.
There are some bugs that exist and should be a given, considering this is an early access title.
Currently in early access there is a slight desync, shots will register 90% of the time, your reloads will have to continue until magazines are inserted (this can happen for two or more times initially), there are only a few bugs but,
 I'd say it's in a very [i]playable[/i] state.

The gun attachment system is great and allows a person to always hunt for the next best attachment/body armor/equipment upgrade. It's great fun to just find gear and ultimately test it out on unsuspecting foe or in the heat of the battle... you may even test armor durability. Your armor degrades when it takes damage and there are great little mechanics like this that really make this game seem fleshed out.

Where this game really shines is bringing you and your squad together in a frantic way that pushes you to coordinate movement, divide up loot, and when sh!t hits the fan -- you can find out what type of gun fighter you are. 
Bring a mic to the battle and your A game, you really can't play this game w/o at least a grunt yes/no.

Buy this game, sink a few hours into it solo/duo. Figure out the mechanics and meta.
Loot to your hearts content. Kill or be killed.

Make friends, squad up and you'll really have some fun.
Maybe your hands will get sweaty, vomiting mom's spaghetti 
and you'll have as much of a blast as I have so far playing this 
chasing that ever elusive chicken dinner.

Dead Cells is a Souls-like platformer with Roguelike elements, such as perma-death. 

The good:
- Fun gameplay! There are lots of weapons to try and also to unlock. There are melee and ranged weapons as well as shields. Weapons are ranked as well, so you'll find more powerful versions of the weapons you use as you go along. Combat depends on the weapon, but is generally smooth. Yes, there's a dodge button.

- Story! The game gives you a reason to fight and keep going. You'll read diary entries, meet prisoners and generally get an impression of what's happening from the world around you.

- Enemy variety! There are quite a few different enemies and they have different attack patterns. Learning these patterns is part of the fun. It's easy to dodge the same enemies but when you've got different types all attacking you at once, it puts what you've learned to the test.

- Upgrades! You can improve your weapons and stats. Weapons have different colours (Red, Green or Purple). Purple ones tend to favour stealthier kills, while red lends itself to a more aggressive style of play. Green boosts your survival skills. You'll pick power scrolls up along the way and choose which colour to upgrade, but with diminishing returns. A good idea is to collect one type, such as purple, then get a HP boost from the green later on. You can also spend cells on weapon adjustments and upgrades.

- Randomly generated levels! This one is a bit weak because the levels do have a samey-ness to them (such as at the start and exit), but there's enough change in the environment to keep each playthrough slightly different.

- Replayability! You can try different builds and, once you finish the game, you can increase the difficulty and unlock additional areas to get rewards and progress.

- Graphics! I don't normally like generic 2D pixel games, but this one does look good.

The bad:

- The game is unforgiving especially to new players. You're going to die a lot while still having no idea what to do with the weapons and equipment you get. There isn't much in the way of hand holding. Thankfully, it's not a massive problem and a little perseverance will get you to the fun part.

- When you die, you restart. Doesn't matter if you die just before a boss. On the plus side, there are permanent upgrades you keep. This includes weapons but you can get an upgrade to give you random weapons at the start. These weapons are drawn from your pool of already unlocked weapons.

- Weapons are random. If you have a build in mind, it may take a few runs to find a collection of items and weapons you like. The game does drop blueprints so you can unlock more items and weapons, but you're at the whim of RNGesus. Unlocking the items takes cells.

- Shields don't seem like an attractive option at the start, not with a dodge button at your disposal. I've killed the final boss a few times without a shield. It's much quicker to learn how to dodge and attack than to spend time learning how to parry an attack. Most enemies have to charge their attacks before they strike. Having to learn the attack patterns and parry at the right time just seems so much slower when you could instead toss traps, shoot explosive arrows or crit enemies with the Impaler in a fraction of the time. Perhaps shields work well on higher difficulties, but they seem pretty weak when you're new to the game.

- The game can be finished really quickly. This is a tricky one because they actually have something that is fun to play, but your second and third playthroughs are going to be faster and you'll notice there's not much between you and the final boss. The reason it feels like there's more is because you have to start from scratch when you die. I don't count this as the worst problem with the game because there are always little secrets to uncover in each level, but the game is artificially lengthened by it's difficulty and it's almost as if the first thing it wants to do is halt or remove your progress, even when you're doing well. The ending was a bit disappointing because of this.

Overall, I'd recommend it. Despite the flaws, it's genuinely fun and dying just makes you want to dust yourself off and get back into the fray. The random weapons can be annoying when you're getting bad drops but they do force you to change your strategy, which makes the game different from one playthrough to the next. The weapon variety means you can tackle the same enemies in different ways instead of falling into similar combat patterns. After a while you learn that two or three different enemies in a small space is far worse than fighting a boss, which is a little ironic, but not necessarily a bad thing.

8/10 - it would be a great game to add to your collection!

For those of you who have played Insurgency: this is essentially Insurgency in WW2 setting and with greater emphasis on teamwork, more limited class roles(e.g. machinegunners can only have machineguns as their primary weapon) and fire support. The latter can be really annoying too - being on the receiving end of an airstrike isn't all that entertaining. On the other hand, watching your enemies run around while being blow to pieces with artillery is quite priceless.

For those of you who haven't, this is an an online team-based realistic WW2 infantry FPS with medium-scale combat(maps are larger han on COD but smaller than in Battlefield). It is tactical, tense and could be unforgiving to newcomers. It only has like 500-1000 people online at a time, but surprisingly this is more than enough, especially if you ostly play co-op, which only requires 3+ people for adequate play.

It runs on Source engine and is not much of a looker, but otherwise it plays well and can prove to be a lot of fun if this sort of realistic FPS sounds like something up your alley.

Stardew Valley is a pinnacle of indie achievement. One man, one mission, and he made this. I have never been this impressed in an indie dev, ESPECIALLY considering he did this as a project to teach himself to code.

Just like Harvest Moon, you inherit a farm from your grandfather. The place, obviously, needs work. So you get to work cutting trees, trimming hedges, cutting grass and breaking pesky rocks. With enough resources, you can start building different facilities, from barns for cows and sheep to coops for chickens and ducks and a stable for a horse. You can plant virtually anywhere on your farm, growing a multitude of crops and selling them for cash, or changing them into jams and wine for even more money. 

Enter the mines to find precious gems, battle monsters with your favorite weapon, and even gift things to the bachelor or bachelorette of your choice to woo them into marriage. Have kids.

Unlock many, many things via the bundles and watch the town grow, or join the shady Joja corporation and buy your way to the top.

Buy hats. You like hats.

There's so much to do. The music is top notch, the pixel art graphics are sublime, and the gameplay itself is incredible.

If you've ever liked Harvest Moon, buy this game and watch your free time dissappear. And then some.

Indie games are both a curse and a blessing. On one hand, many of them are mediocre, unpolished, with a weird concept and the wrong execution. But on the other hand, you find exquisite master pieces that are soo enjoyable and realise their full potential soo damn well that makes you feel like you owe money to the developer(s).

That's Papers, Please in a nutshell. At first, the game scares you due to the oldschool graphics. There is a fine line between vintage and flat out outdated. But with this game, because you'll get soo engaged from the get go, you quickly realise the graphics are part of the charm.

Incredibly fun and well executed. The learning curve is appropriate and the difficulty increases at the right pace. The mini-story of your main character is exalted by the fact there are several possible "endings" to the game, although the game allows you to simply reroll the latests stage you played if you wanna change the outcome.
If you're into memory games, fact checking or simply enjoy denying stuff to people this is the game for you. Worth way more than the 5€ I payed for during a sale.

El juego decide hacer ciertas mejores en la jugabilidad con respecto a los primeros dos. Logra crear una experiencia que goza de una ambientación muy detallada, con un apartado artístico maravilloso (aunque a veces la luz es demasiado brillante y satura). Se agradece el hecho de que haya solo un final pues anteriormente (al menos en el primer bioshock) estos daban un alto énfasis en decisiones que nada tenían que ver con el resto de la experiencia. Sin embargo aquí siendo solo ese único desenlace logra ser medianamente creíble o, por lo menos entendible y da sentido a ciertos eventos de la historia (el hecho de porqué Booker inicia su viaje de manera tan vaga al inicio).
Tiene el añadido de contar con una inteligencia artificial que logra ser un apoyo real durante las batallas más frenéticas, aunque es cierto que esta es más bien estética pues los enemigos jamás le harán daño ni mucho menos la verán cuando esté presente. Hablando de eso, comete el mismo error de la saga que es llenar los escenarios de enemigos (que aquí puede ser un poco más justificable siendo que no están buscando) a tal punto que se siente artificial, sabiendo que siempre tendremos momentos tranquilos y otros llenos de enemigos que terminan siendo repetitivos y no permiten disfrutar del escenario en el que estamos.
"Bioshock: infinite" no es perfecto ni está cerca de estarlo, pero es una grata experiencia de jugar, mejor algunos aspectos de los anteriores títulos, pero también empeora en otros o directamente los deja iguales.
Con respecto a los DLC, estos aportan ligeramente a las historias, siendo el protagonizado por Elizabeth el que más agrega y  destaca al cambiar drásticamente el esquema de juego para volverse más coherente con su protagonista y los escenarios que visitamos, haciendo que seamos vulnerables, pero no inútiles.

实际上这一部我并不是太推荐，但是给差评又觉得远远没到那个程度，还是勉强给个好评吧
如果说前作重启是这个系列重新焕发新机的里程碑的话，那么这一部我只能说是迎合市场化比较成功的作品，跟前作比虽然有不少进步，但是不尽人意的地方也存在不少，下面就来说说。

画面方面：
+：相比于9这部重启作，这代画面的光影继承得还不错
+：贴图相比于前作更为精细
~：海飞丝一如既往吃配置，所以只能关了
-：不知道为什么，明明给我检测到显卡为760，却默认给了我最高的画面设定，导致帧数低的可怜
-：也不知道为何，即使我把画面调到低，整体流程帧数依然无法维持60帧，但是同样的配置却能在前作开到高
画面在设定精细度以及实际表现方面，的确比前作飞跃了一个层次，但是可能是我配置太差了吧，无福消受

潜行系统：
+：增加了树丛，可以让劳拉蹲树丛塞一个连的人，也能在某程度上降低被发现尸体的风险
+：增加了酒瓶子和罐头作为吸引敌人注意的投掷物，相比于前作只能用弓箭吸引人性化不少
+：新增了高处的跳跃暗杀，不再像前作那样只能用弓箭解决
+：暗杀动画增加，除了早期的用弓扭脖子外，后来的匕首暗杀，树丛登山镐暗杀，酒瓶子“暗”杀，以及水中暗杀为玩家带来了新的玩法
-：但是这一部敌人的感知以及视力非常的迷，有些时候明明a看的不是b的方向，但是b在树丛被暗杀时却会惊动a，而某些情况明明b在后方给暗杀，前方不到1m的a却无动于衷
-：虽然设定上说敌人的感知和ai会随着难度提升而提升，不过同一个难度同样的距离，为什么有些情况下敌人头上一黄就直接被发现，而有些时候却只会警觉？
-：即使后来有了匕首，树丛暗杀依然是登山镐，而这段动画又长又臭，一旦被发现还得从来，挺烦的
整体来说其实这一代的潜行多样性是比前作多的，但是奇怪的ai和判定却让这个系统有不能忽视的瑕疵

战斗系统：
+：弓后期的自动锁头技能挺好用
-：虽然这代劳拉有两把登山镐圣剑，但是整体表现比前作要差。满魔改情况下，前作普通难度两下就能把重甲兵破甲+出现处决，这代两斧子下来敌人也就刚刚破甲，要出现处决还得再来两下
-：前作非常强的翻滚反击流这代感觉一般，前作后期就能解锁翻滚反击秒杀重甲兵的技能。而崛起虽然也有类似技能，但是对付重甲兵劳拉竟然不能再像前作一样一箭捅喉咙秒杀，而是非要扎两次腿才能处决，为什么啊？
-：这代敌人机动性非常高，而且火力很猛，但是劳拉早期装备却很菜，早期不靠潜行难度非常高。虽然前作也一样有这个设计，但是早期的敌人跟劳拉一样都是菜鸡装备互啄啊
-：可能是因为技能过多和武器改造项多，所以早期劳拉削的非常弱。前作给爆肾的劳拉，最初始的弓起码还能上弦4秒后才开始手抖。这代劳拉拿着自己做的手制弓，上弦不到3秒马上手抖然后箭就发出去，所以早期潜行对预判和地形利用要求比前作要高
-：这代手枪相比于前作太弱了，没消音时不能潜行，实际战斗也就只能欺负一下没甲小兵。中后期潜行爆头比不过弓和大栓，对付重甲兵不如喷子、各类箭

整体来说这代战斗系统我是不大满意的，虽然尤其技能多起来+武器变强后战斗不会再像早期那么恶心，但是早期种种限制和削弱，的确会让人感觉很不爽

武器系统：
+：这代武器除了早期的手制弓会给强制替换反曲弓外，其他武器都是独立的，玩家可以根据喜好与实际情况自由搭配
+：弓箭在前作的基础上新增了毒箭，而且不再像前作一样某些箭需要技能解锁才能使用
+：手枪新增了特殊弹药，在某种程度上也算是对这偏弱武器的一种加强吧
-：前作的龙息弹改装项在这代改成了手制弹，而且相比于前作实用性一般
-：但是这代武器打击感感觉都偏轻
武器系统相比于前作有所进步，不过有些地方的改动反而有退步了

素材系统
+：这代的弹药可以通过现场制作以及篝火处制作，所以只要有素材，就不必担心补给不足
-：但是早期玩家素材极其稀缺，劳拉在战斗时只靠互相回血完全不实际，而由于强力技能的存在，导致早期劳拉手上包扎受到诸多限制
-：这代的素材收集点还算收集要素，严重影响游戏节奏
-：由于素材对于玩家的背包制造以及武器改装影响非常大，尤其是动物皮毛。所以玩家动不动都要去打猎或者捡垃圾，强行延长游戏时间
-：不使用dlc武器，要获得强力武器要么去找二五仔买，要么自己捡垃圾开箱子解锁零件，但是这代零件分布比前作还神经病，各种大箱子放犄角旮旯还用机关堵路，也是逼玩家到处找箱子解锁武器，极其影响游戏节奏
这代素材其实是一个不错的系统，但是过于影响游戏节奏是它的最大问题

非支线古墓：
+：一个古墓的奖励从单纯的经验改成了特殊技能，好评
+：全探索给的拜占庭古币挺多，买东西开心
+：相比于前作那比较苛刻的抓时间解密，这代判定宽松了
-：但是有些解密简直神经病，为什么这代会做一个解密思路不对就会强行死亡的古墓？虽然说古墓有机关很正常，但是那个死亡方式真心蠢啊！
-：早期解密基本要动动脑子，但是中后期要么就是抓时机，要么就是全部机关折腾一边顺序正确即可，太简单粗暴了
整体还可以，不过那个会强行死亡的古墓真是恶心到我了

流程方面：
+：这代的攀爬花样比前作要多，虽然取消了能直接用绳索箭连接墙的设计有些可惜
+：风景一股既往的好
+：女巫支线个人感觉做的比主线还好
-：但是为什么攀爬点总会有奇怪的判定bug？已经有过多次明明是能上去的地方，结果却强行滑下去摔死的经历
-：感觉这代的爆炸和坍塌有些滥用了，而且演出效果相比于前作有些差，给人一种是为塌而塌的感觉
-：相比于前作的风暴武士，这代的不死军团逼格有些低
-：圣三一仅仅是提的多，但是没啥表现，感觉有些单薄
-：虽然流程很长，但是神经病的收集以及某些场景拖沓的的攀爬系统外加没啥代入感的过场动画都只让人感觉想快点通关
流程虽然比前作长，但是前作一开始就有一种看电影的感觉，而这代刻意的元素太多很破坏有些体验

If you like Stealth, Zombies, Shooter, PVP / PVE You might want to check this out. It has a unique playstyle much like Escape from Tarkov fused with Dead Island in an old school scenery (some say Monster Hunter? because of the Boss Bounty maybe?). 

You hire hunters to use in a match. Those hunters have their personal level. you level them up by killing Zombies, killing players, doing objectives and hunting bounties. Sounds easy enough right? well, not quite. Once you've done all those, to gain all the experience and cash, you have to "extract" your hunter. Meaning escaping the area ALIVE. yes, ALIVE. once your hunter dies in a match, thats it, its dead permanently. Everything that hunter was carrying will be gone.

You also unlock weapons and equipments by leveling up your personal rank. To level up your rank, you have to succesfully complete OR escape a match without your hunter dying to gain the most EXP and Cash.

Hiring hunters has a unique twist. Some hunters may already be carrying guns and equipments not yet unlocked to your rank. and yes, you will be able to use those weapon / equipments when you hire them. you can also transfer them between hunters.

You can SOLO queue a match, random DUO or Invite a friend to play. (SOLO queue will match you up with DUOs. im not sure if they're planning on increasing the party size, but for now its only a 2 person party)

For the current price ($29.99 USD) in my opinion is worth it. (escape from tarkov, with a similar play style cost $49.99 for standard. and up to $199.99 usd) They did say price may change once full release comes out.

But be aware. this game is in VERY early access. you might find yourself with bugs and connection issues. but so far, for me at least, i havent had much issues.

ALSO keep in mind, this game DOES take quite a bit of power to play. i have an i7-6700k 16GB Ram with a 1080Ti, and my average FPS is around 50-58 (rarely getting 60) on max settings. quality setting has no individual settings yet, so you only have the option to choose either Low, Medium, or High preset. (they have said that they'll fix the performance issues eventually)

With that being said. Game looks awesome, feels awesome, gameplay is unique to how you want to play it. getting kills are so satisfying, outshooting opponents, gunfights and trying to escape with the bounty feels very intense due to the fact that other players will try and hunt you down. 

Note: no kill feed, no kill indication, (there are hit markers) and no players remaining status. Its part of the gameplay. So you're left constantly wondering whether you've killed a person or not or how many players are still alive. makes the game very immersive imo.

Hotline Miami é um shooter top-down com estética lo-fi e [b]hiper[/b]-violento. 

O gameplay requer velocidade e destreza, você tem apenas uma chance para concluir todo o nível, se morrer tem que começar tudo de novo. O ritmo do game é frenético e o gameplay é extremamente bem casado com a arte, estória e música do jogo.

Visualmente o jogo é muito interessante: gráficos em pixel arte, viisual retro anos oitenta, muito neon e cores saturadas. A maior parte da arte foi feita pelos criadores Jonatan Söderström e Dennis Wedin, com exceção da capa feita por El Huervo, que também trabalhou no [b]Else Heart.Break()[/b].  A trilha sonora matadora conta com faixas tão sinistras quanto frenéticas de artistas como Sun Araw e MOON.

A história do jogo é uma mistura de David Lynch e Quentin Tarantino, inspirada no filme Driver e cheia de comentários certeiros sobre a natureza violenta dos jogos de ação e da relação jogador/desenvolvedor. Na minha opinião, o mais próximo da trama e roteiro de Hotline Miami seria a meta-narrativa de Bioshock, mas eu ainda acho que Hotline Miami casa melhor todos os elementos artisticos ao gameplay do que os três Bioshocks fizeram.

Falando em gameplay, a chacina é mais do que recompensadora em Hotline Miami: combos são divertidos e desafiadores, pontuações e classificações valorizam versatilidade e ousadia. Existem trocentas armas diferentes que surgem semi-aleatoriamente no cenário, no incio de cada fase, e mascaras diferentes dão bônus e habilidades interessantes. A brutalidade das mortes são suavizadas com os graficos lo-fi, mas não se deixe enganar: a sensação do impacto dos golpes é muito boa, como um bom filme do Tarantino, cartum e real ao mesmo tempo.

当然除了恐怖元素和meta元素之外，这个鬼佬版的君彼女综合素质是非常高的，无论画风、音乐、剧情、玩法都是。

下面给几个tips吧（无剧透）：

一、不要嫌前戏长
其实我一开始玩这游戏就是冲着恐怖去的（本人并不喜欢玩GAL），但是前面的发展太风平浪静了，再加上作者恶意卖关子，容易磨掉人不多的耐心。但是实际上，这些前戏其实都是必不可少的的铺垫，尤其是当你逐渐放下戒心，适应了那种校园恋爱剧情的时候，最后的反转才能达到最大的震撼。

二、想打真结局的人注意
首先，真结局和普通结局唯一的区别就是能看到作者的一封信，不是很有刻意去打一遍的必要。
其次，真结局有个很坑的地方，就是要求同一周目收集全CG，必须是同一周目，也就是你通关以后重新开始游戏，你以前的CG就不会算数了，必须使用SL（但是要注意“二周目”会删档，所以你懂的）。

三、只要买了DLC就可以永久入库，我相信这个游戏肯定值36软的。

四、玩这种游戏不能入戏太深，不要随便认老婆，不然有你的屎吃。[strike]我永远喜欢毛二力[/strike]

最后说一下这游戏的两点不足之处：

一、[spoiler]死的人是固定的[/spoiler]
[spoiler]“一周目”固定死幼驯染，“二周目”固定死黑长直，我觉得很不科学，比如说我“一周目”进的幼驯染线，最后的死人就很震撼，但是如果我进的是其他人的线，结果死的还是幼驯染，这震撼力就大打折扣了。要是我是作者，玩家进了谁的线就让谁死，这才是正确的喂屎方法。[/spoiler]

二、meta元素比我想象的弱
打一个最简单的比方，你一周目删了粉毛的档，其实对游戏没有任·何·影·响。类似的例子还有很多，无形之中也影响了游戏体验。

最后，吐槽一下幼驯染的迷之胸围，立绘里，CG里，[spoiler]上吊CG[/spoiler]里，是三种大小。
Simplesmente incrível!

The Tom Clancy’s s series of the games, always have been successful and very enjoyable to play with the titles such as Splinter Cell, Ghost Recon 1, 2, Wildlands, Breakpoint and Rainbow Six Siege.

The Rainbow Six Siege is a tactical shooter based game with the aim of the operators to use their special abilities in order to win the round. This is sort of a simulation of the agents and their training turned into a shooter that has a lot of potentials to be one of the best games out there in terms of professional and casual gaming. I have spent a few good hours in this game and I can clearly tell that this game is good for anyone who likes shooting games, not to mention it is also really good to play with friends.

The game has 3 main game-modes which are the bomb whereas an attacker you have to plant but as a defender, you whether have to kill all of the attackers or defuse that bomb in terms of Rainbow Six Siege language ‘’Defuser’’ as the bomb won’t explode due to this being sort of a simulation of the operator's training. The escort the hostage is simply as an attacker, you have to escort the hostage and lastly the secure area as an attacker, you have to secure the area by simply being at the point. You have both sides the attackers and defenders the attackers are responsible for attacking and defenders for defending, it cannot be more simple than this.

Each of the operators is from a certain country which is fun to read their bio’s in the game, each of the operators has special abilities that they are counter others operators abilities but other operators will counter their abilities too. The game is designed to have 4 seasons each year every 3-4 months where the new operator/map/event and more likely battle pass are being introduced to the game which means it is changing the game mechanics a lot. I am not good at the mechanics of the game, perhaps there is still plenty of work to be done but the game is fun.

The game has a really good side of the E-sport where the professional teams and the players are competing which is really fun and enjoyable to watch. Many known E-sport organisations have their roasters in the Siege world.

The down-side of the game would community, as it splits to the good and the bad one, without going into the detail try to avoid the toxicity by simply muting or avoiding the toxic side of the community.

The game have ranking systems which allows you to play with people based on your skill level, without a shadow of a doubt the ranking system is pretty harsh as personally, Most of the games I had I was pretty much the top player to the point, I was down 3:0 with the stats of 0:4 deaths and I was able to finish the match by winning 5:4 with the stats of 14:6, the point I’m trying to make is, I have stopped playing this the game as mainly I have been carrying a lot of people that I have played with due them to not thinking properly in the game, I received so much friends invite after the match. I recommend this game but be prepared for harsh life in the ranking environment especially when you play with your friend and other 3 random people. 

I am not the best but  I’m pretty sure there is a lot of people like me who knows they deserve better rank but they can’t just get it. 

I recommend this game for sure. I have stopped playing this game much due to the ranking system being simply not-fair.

After Beast of Prey kind of flopped (in my opinion), I was hoping a survival game with dinosaurs would come along that was interesting and worth playing.  Well I am not disappointed!  At first I had the same troubles as everyone else, could not log in, etc.  But once I entered the game I was pleasantly surprised at the amount of character customization available, that the other survival games that have been out much longer still lack.  The graphics are amazing, though it is difficult to get good FPS right now on anything too high (I'm sure they need to optimize the game still).  The world is amazing, with the dinosaurs as a significant threat, a leveling system and building similar to that of Rust.  I can see myself spending many hours on this game and look forward to seeing how it progresses over time!

Brilliant game.  The core product has beautiful artwork and quests that are engaging.  In fact the storylines are so expertly constructed that it feels as though I'm a character in an online epic.  They've moved me, made me laugh, and made me go "awww" at times.  The quests force you to make decisions that will have consequences later in the game, such as which friends and enemies you will make that might help or block you later on (individual NPCs, not entire factions).  I like the way crafting progression is based around destruction rather than construction.  They've thrown out the rulebook on how different classes must structure their gear and skills and this is really refreshing - it leaves a sense of a limitless and rich structure for defining the characters you want to play.

There are a couple of issues that I've noticed on the periphery of the game.  First is that prices advertised in the in-game Crown Store are not always applied as advertised, resulting in my paying around 30% more than expected in two occasions.  The customer service experience in trying to have this rectified via Steam was not helpful at all.  A friend who had the same problem was sorted with a refund but I was not - so it is "hit and miss" with the service level you can expect.  Second is the erotic Role Players who insist on putting their liaisons out there in public channels, the content of which can be brutal and distasteful.  Fortunately those occasions are rare but I would not want my kids hanging out in that kind of environment.  There are some basic things that the developers could do to make the environment safer in this respect e.g. insisting they use a private channel and/or banning reported players for not using one.

一座永远下雨的城市，从开始下雨的那天起，雨水就一直是黑涩的，一打在玻璃墙上就变得透明，顺着尖塔螺旋下降，流入每条街的下水道。地上的瓷砖不会反光，像黑曜石，雨水落下，溅起的雾气氤氲着路灯光晕，这座城市是如此害怕光，一切照明都是最微弱的。不必回忆这座城市的过去，因为它就耸立在城市广场的中心，在关于这座城市所有的悲伤故事中，它是最初的，你也可以说，这座城市是为了它而哭泣。
一个苍白的空洞骑士，三个守梦人，他们的雕像，每一个居民，路过的旅人都要在心胸默念:在那高远的黑色穹顶下，他的牺牲让圣巢永世不衰。可是它们已经不记得了，现在这是一座静默而快乐的城市，每只虫都在做梦，它们在梦中能看到地下城市里，在黑色雨水中永不会出现的幸福光芒。
我要告诉你，这座城市叫做泪水之城，我记得那里下雨的声音。

—————————————————————————————————————————
在深渊的上方，有一座因为风化而古旧的城市。你知道这里原本不是这样的，你寻找着这座宫殿，在某个残破的门口，守卫的梦里你找到了它。

这是一座被月球尘埃所覆盖的白色宫殿，鸽子们在呼呼飞行。这是一座王国最伟大的时刻，它的主人却极力想要将它遮掩，到处都是一样的悲哀色调，所有的家具都盖着白色幕布，不让你窥见面貌，仿佛快要搬家的人，或者说，永远哀悼着某种过去的记忆。

即使在只由他主宰的梦里，王也已经消失了太久，连侍从们都忘记了他们的王，只记得对着每个路过的人下跪。

而现在，你是王他们是尘埃，连最轻微的呼吸都会将它们击散，你知道它们只是幻影，你残酷地追求真实把你引往两条路，一条通向王最想隐藏的秘密，曾经有人比你更快到达了那终点，因此，再多的荆棘、电锯和尖刺也无法带来再多的苦痛。

在另一条路的尽头，你冲进了屋内的幽暗光影，搅乱了屋内凝滞的时光，在那里你终于看到了他，他或许比所有人、比所有王国里的虫子都更加年迈，面朝前坐在在王座上，弯着右臂垫在脸下当作枕头，在孤独君王最后的漫长生命中，他用这样的姿势睡过了一个又一个黑夜，直到再也无法离开他的宫殿。

你发现他那悲伤的双眼、发灰的脸颊，看到那台阶之上若有所思地向着空气的目光，你想要看得更清楚一些，你靠近了他，却发现比守卫他的战士们更脆弱、就那么轻易地击碎了那具苍白的骸骨，于是那由华丽的炫目、昔日王国的巅峰、那无数精巧宏伟的梦境，崩塌了。

——你就这样打败苍白之王，拿到了国王之魂，不费吹灰之力。

Fallout 4 é un gioco che migliora il suo predecessore in molti aspetti (come crafting e gestione dei companions) anche se presenta i soliti problemi a cui Bethesda ci ha abituati: bugs, glitches e modelli dei PNG non esattamente al passo con i tempi (le espressioni facciali sono piuttosto "imbarazzanti" per un gioco di fine 2015). Ovviamente se vi é piaciuto Fallout 3 e Fallout: New Vegas, Fallout 4 non potrà non piacervi.

Cosa mi é piacuto di piú:

- I paesaggi suggestivi e la varietà delle ambientazioni.
- Il sistema di crafting: interessante, vario e divertente.
- La caratterizzazione di alcuni companion.
- L'introduzione dei "Sintetici"...James Cameron ringrazia!
- La varietà delle armi.
- La varietà dei nemici.
- La possiblità di personalizzare l'armatura e cambiare componenti a seconda delle situazioni. 

Cosa mi é piaciuto di meno:

- Mancanza di un tutorial per crafting e gestione delle colonie (assolutamente consigliabile per le prime ore di gioco).
- Modelli dei personaggi grezzi, alcuni piú di altri.
- Il nuovo sistema di personalizzazione delle abilità (o perks) ti obbliga a tirare su determinate caratteristiche SPECIAL (come carisma o agilità) anche se non vuoi. Era meglio il precedente che dava completa libertà di scegliere slegando le abilità dalle caratteristiche SPECIAL.
- La solita presenza di glitch e bugs, non nuovi ai fan della serie.

DayZ a long story with tears of pain and fun. After over 700h of gameplay and beeing there since the very beginning versions of early 2014, I finally write a review. There were periods I played frequently and periods I never touched it.

You can´t deny that there were and are some serious bugs and issues, but what would DayZ be without them. For example in the final version 1.0: you can get a simple cold (that can contract other players), but there is no other cure than blowing your brains out. This leads to everybody unlocking their guns aiming at the one who sneezes (friend or foe) immediatly. Tents with your loot in your base can be shot ( and it takes only a few cheap .380 rounds) and will despawn with everything in it. I remember OLDER VERSIONs bugs: constantly overheating characters (dying of dehydration), we adapted and took off all clothes every 30mins and jumped into a pond.... Annoying but also funny. Bugged loot explosions where hundreds of items spawned at one spot or completly no loot on the otherhand. You could break your legs (or die) by falling down from 1m height and crouch to the next hospital eventually. Don´t mention the zombies..... bugged to hell sometimes. This goes on and on, but you adapted to that and it became somehow part of every patches gameplay. For new players or inexperienced players this could rightly lead to uninstalling the game. I hope they bring back the old and new weapons/items from 0.63. Maybe one day the bugs will be gone...

Away from the bugs you had a very special experience. A hardcore game which tells you nothing. You learned the mechanics step by step, learned where the food is, meeting your friends, how to avoid zombies, getting the good guns, treason of "friendly" guys, fighting people and die, winning fights, how to get the good stuff quickly, mastering the map of Chernarus, helping bambies out of their misery and finally building a base with your friends where you can store your hard earned loot. A very steep curve and a long road of endless walking and dying. You will on the other hand walk a very beautiful and detailed landscape. They added small streams and paths, more diverse vegetation, animals, new sounds, weather effects, forgotten places in the forests, details like hiking signs and other small places. This adds up to a very dense atmosphere. DayZ is all about atmosphere and immersion. The graphics might not be the newest tech now, but very fitting and the performance was boosted alot since the early days. Getting 100+fps @1440p maxed out consistently. The new Enfusion engine works very stable and took the game to a new level. I would say the years of development brought out a decent product. The gunplay is smooth now, the clunkiness of the character gone. Loot is spread out very fair. The very basic base building works and gives you new goals as a player, but needs some more love. Even the zombies got their place now: They often carry food or ammo, so shooting them and attracting more, brings the food to you. 

WIthout friends to play with, this will not be fun. Roaming around together, looting and playing around could lead to the most fun moments you could have in a game. I don´t regret the 20€ I spend on DayZ 5 years ago, and enjoyed the jouney of Early Access we had. 

I respect the Devs for dedicating years of their lifes to this project, even it still needs a lot of work. You could call it a Scam, but they also could have easily abandon it in the middle of their work and call it dead, but they did not. Integrating the modding support was the right step and will be the future of DayZ.

Cities:Skylines ist ein super Spiel für Momente, in denen deine Freunde bereits mit anderen Spielen beschäftigt sind oder etwas im sogenannten Real Life machen. 
Im Spiel geht es darum den Bürgermeister einer Stadt zu spielen und nach und nach die Stadt zu erweitern. Hierbei ist es wichtig gut vorausplanen zu können und dabei immer ein Auge auf sein Geld zu behalten (besonders am Anfang kann man ziemlich schnell pleite sein, wenn man sich etwas verplant; Kleiner Tipp am Rande: Ihr könnt die Leistung der ersten Gebäude auf 50% setzen, dadurch spart ihr euch Geld und Anfangs ist die Nachfrage sowieso wesentlich geringer als das Angebot. Wenn sich die Bewohner dann beschweren, dass es nicht mehr genug Wasser gibt könnt ihr einfach die Leistung nach und nach wieder hochstellen.)

Das Spiel wird so schnell auch nicht langweilig werden, da die zu bebauende Fläche ziemlich groß ist. Falls ihr mal an den Punkt kommt, dass entweder die gesamte Fläche bebaut ist oder ihr einfach die Landschaft oder Straßen um die Stadt herum bearbeiten wollt, dann könnt ihr sogar eine Mod hinzufügen, die euch die gesamte Map freischaltet :)

Es gibt einige gute DLCs die das Spiel mit neuen Inhalten erweitern und so einige neue Bereiche hinzufügen, auf die man nun auch achten muss. Selbst wenn ihr alle DLCs habt (oder eben auch nicht) und euch langweilig wird, dann könnt ihr einige Mods und Assets hinzufügen. Dadurch könnt ihr einige Dinge machen, die ihr vorher nicht machen konntet, z.B. könnt ihr dadurch eure Autos, Gebäude etc. nach einem neuen Theme gestalten oder ihr könnt Bäume in Gebäude setzen, damit diese besser aussehen.

Im Großen und Ganzen gibt es schier unendlich viele Möglichkeiten und der Spielspaß wird euch nie ausgehen. Dabei werdet ihr mit Sicherheit in der Situation landen "Ich muss nur noch diese Straße bauen" und 5 Stunden später habt ihr auf einmal ein ganzes Gebiet mit Gebäuden zugepflastert und habt einen neuen Flughafen gebaut ;)

Очень понравились новое механики, особенно хочу выделить, что в игре довольно много своеобразных NPC, с которыми интересно взаимодействовать (покупать или улучшать осколки духов и выполнять доп. квесты).

app_name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
review:
Hauntingly beautiful visuals, story and soundtrack. Silky smooth gameplay that is extremely hard to match elsewhere. Almost impossibly, it improves on the first game in almost every way. Games like this come around only once in a great while and even fewer have the emotional impact. The story that is told, in tandem with the first game (Blind Forest), is a masterpiece of narrative exposition, told mostly with visuals. I would recommend playing Blind Forest first so you get the perfect symmetrical arc of the story (and Blind Forest is a fantastic game in its own right).

Some side notes: Both games will generally ask a lot out of you as a player, though it strikes that perfect balance of never really rising to the level of frustrating. Perhaps due to the way both games deal with death and because of the stunning beauty and pacing. Also, I recommend bringing a box of tissues. Maybe some chocolate and coffee. This series has a habit of taking a hammer to the heartstrings and *really* sticking with you afterwards.

I've actually had Skyrim for ages, but I only just felt like doing a review.

The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim is absolutely magical; I don't know where to start. It is an open-world-do-what-you-want-adventure like no other. Except for the other Elder Scrolls games and Fallout, also masterpieces from the same blokes. 

It starts in a similar fashion too. You are a prisoner on your way to get executed, because you did a Mexican and hopped over the border of Skyrim. You get to the town and a dude asks you who you are. Cue a character creation process which you could spend hours on, choosing from multiple variations of human, elves, or an orc, a cat/man or a lizard/man. So the executioner is raising his axe above your head when suddenly.. a wild dragon appears! And so you break free, escape the town, go through a dungeon and then you are outside. The world is your oyster.

Later on, if you choose to carry on the main quest (you don't have to but it helps), you end up slaying a dragon, and absorbing its soul. Thus you are Dragonborn, born with the blood and soul of a dragon, and able to destroy things by shouting at them (FUS RO DAH!!). There are many different 'shouts' you can find throughout Skyrim, and you can use the ones you've found by killing dragons and stealing their souls. Dragons usually have a fair bit of cash too. Aside from the main quest there are many factions you can join, like the Dark Brotherhood (assassins), the Thieves Guild, The College of Winterhold (mages), The Companions, the Imperial Legion or the Stormcloaks, just to name a few. With these you can become a werewolf, get some really good gear and tons of money. Personally I found the Thieves guild questline more appealing than the main questline.

Unlike the previous games where you choose your main attributes and skills and whatnot right at the beginning, on this you are free to be whatever you want at any time (provided you have the points). You can pursue a career in close combat with swords, archery, magic, thieving, smithing, alchemy and socializing, just to name a few. There is no right or wrong way to play this. Be a good samaritan and quell the threat of the dragons and other nasties, be a ruthless murderer and get done for killing a chicken, sneak into an old lady's house at night and nick her sweetrolls, climb a mountain and throw goats off of it, buy a house, get married, explore a cave full of zombies.. there is too much to mention.

And lets not forget the mods for the PC master race. With the Steam workshop it's dead easy to improve the game with a click. For example there are armour mods, weapon mods, spells and quests. And visual mods to make the game so absolutely gorgeous you could masturbate to them and not feel ashamed. 
Check out http://steamcommunity.com/app/72850/screenshots/?p=1&browsefilter=toprated to see what some people have done.

TL;DR? Basically, this may be the best game ever made. Yeah, I went there.

[h1] Gameplay [/h1]

The gameplay in this game feels, unique (In my opinion). The binding of Isacc: Rebirth is a rouge-like game by collecting items from (ex. Items rooms, Devil rooms) to defeat bosses, including [spoiler] your mom [/spoiler]. Each time you play you get a diffrent seed for a comepletely diffrent run every time. You can unlock new items and characters by doing certain things such as [spoiler]  Mom's Knife: Killing Satan as Isaac [/spoiler] . The gameplay was great and I enjoyed it.


[h1] Music [/h1]

The music is great. Fits the setting of the game. I see why  people say that the original game, The Binding of Isaac has better music and I agree with them. This game's music music but is not as good of the original.

[h1] Length [/h1]

Currently, I have about 100 hours into this game and I'm planning to put in more. The game adds new thing after you complete the game with diffrent characters. But if you are bored and want to complete the game (Real Platinum God) expect 200 - 300 hours. That also includes defeating ALL BOSSES IN THE GAME AS THE LOST.

[h1] Final Remarks [/h1]

This game is great, from the unique gameplay to the length of the game this game definitely deserves to be bought with your money. In the end it's up to you if you want to get the game or not.

It all started with a rock.

I downloaded this on a whim, not knowing what to fully expect. After I completed my purchase, I picked out a community server that looked noob friendly (most say that they are.) After loading the maps, trees, gui, and the game I was flabbergasted to find that my character only had a rock, a torch, and three health packs to start. 

Truly shocked, I set forth to conquer the world. Shortly after starting I realized that the rock is all that you need. You can farm wood, minerals, kill animals, and even OTHER PLAYERS with the darn thing. Oh, glorious Rust creators, you are too kind giving all of us peons this great tool to start with.

My single rock led me to building massive, powerful weapons such as M4 rifles and even C4 explosives. Further, I was able to build an entire settlement of wood and metal for my underlings to enjoy. My tribe  of about 13 knew me as a benevolent leader – one who lived and died by the rock.

Ironically enough, my entire settlement came crumbling down from these stupid rocks. Mass waves of other player began battering at my doors with their puny rocks. “Let them,” I quipped gruffly; not fully realizing my taunt would be my downfall.

You see: everyone, regardless of their position, starts with these rocks. These rocks are tools to create better, stronger tools and weapons. My mocking quip led to these other survivors to create said tools and weapons. Faster than I could say “friendly,” these massive waves of other players began basting holes into the fortifications of my settlement and looting and pillaging everything. My whole tribe of 13 was brutally killed. 

10/10 would start with a rock again.

-GenAric

革新十年，春，余就任东直隶总督已五载，将卸任。 
余出身世家，自幼饱读圣贤之书，雅好琴棋书画、诗词歌赋，卸任之际，所欲无它，愿为东直隶国子监一博士足矣。 
踌躇良久，心意已决，遂自荐于祭酒朱物华、司业张仲俊。 
朱、张大悦，谓余曰：“阁下雅望非常，若愿屈尊，实乃国子监之大幸、太学生之大幸。虽然，遵朝廷制度，亦须作「报告」一篇，以供品鉴。” 
余欣然秉笔，作「能源发展趋势及主要节能措施」一篇，国子监诸博士览之，均称颂不已。朱、张遂令诸生传阅，一众生员亦颇赞余为文之妙、立意之高——众心悦服，余遂兼领东直隶国子监博士职。 
公务繁杂，兼领教职后，余再度秉笔，作「微电子工业发展」一篇，亦颇受赞誉。 
二度秉笔作文之后，朝廷调令即至。 
奉上谕，余即刻启程，调职京师。 
抚今追昔，往岁余为国子监博士，作文立意、论道讲经，迄今已二十载矣，圣人有言，“逝者如斯，不舍昼夜”，诚不我欺也。 
和谐六年，余已归隐江湖，不问庙堂之事，悠游之际，再度作文两篇，刊于东直隶国子监之邸报，与往昔之篇目成呼应之势。 
昨日夜，国子监诸贤赠余文册一本，均为余昔日所作，凡二十七篇，余览之大悦。 
此文册诸篇目，有华文，亦有洋文，诸君高才，颇通夷狄之语，想来亦无甚难处。 
此番造访，余无以言谢，亦无它物可赠，待文册印发之际，余即命钱主簿送与诸君，送与郭君伟华，以为纪念。 
天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福。 
荣辱富贵、气运祸福，实难预料也。 
夫人生于天地之间，一生际遇，须竭力奋斗方可有所作为，然亦不敌天命安排，难堪造化捉弄。 
往岁余为东直隶总督，绝无一丝入阁之念，领命入京之际，亦颇为诧异。 
太宗谓余曰：“朕欲仿上古圣王之制，禅位于君。君贤人也，若能当此重任，实乃社稷之福、国家之福也。” 
余不胜惶恐，跪地请奏曰：“臣下不才，难当大任，天下贤于臣者多矣，伏请陛下收回成命，另请高明。” 
革新十年，天下纷扰，余为东直隶总督已五年，致仕之际，实无一丝一毫进取之念也。 
太宗未准余之奏请，谓余曰：“朕意已决，望君以江山社稷为重，勿再推辞。” 
余遂领命入京，并赋诗以明心志：“苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之。” 
余掌国柄十数载，凡所建树大约有三： 
其一，定下「市场经济」之国策； 
其二，载「邓公理论」入朝纲； 
其三，余之执政纲领「三个代表」。 
此三者外，王师之整顿，禁绝商贾，亦可堪称：军士之职责，在于保家卫国，抗击外侮，舍此而经商逐利，可谓本末倒置也。 
此外，长江水患，治水抗洪，亦不可忽略也。 
然则整肃军旅、抗洪抢险，皆不如前述之三事也。 
余执政所为，皆小事也，功德微薄，惭愧之至，敬谢不敏。

This is my first time playing a Yakuza series game despite hearing about this series for years. Needless to say I was not disappointed. To compare it to GTA is a bit of a misnomer. I'd compare this series more to Shenmue or Way of the Samurai. However, it definitely has it's own flair and it was obvious to me after my first several hours of playing it that the developers really care about this series and it's characters. 

The world feels very lived-in and the graphics are gorgeous. There are plenty of extra side missions and mini games to keep you occupied. I got no where near completing all the extra content by the time I decided to wrap things up in the main story (which was close to 70 hours). 

The story is really good and it's acting is excellent both the CGI and voice-work. The story really kept me coming back for more and makes me want to return to this series in the future to see how the story progresses with these characters (despite being a later entry this game is considered a prequel as it takes place in the 80's). 

My biggest complaint is with the combat. You are given 3 combat forms with 2 separate main characters (a 4th which can be unlocked through completing side-mission quests) and an equipped weapon. In the first 5-7 chapters of the game I worked really hard and leveled my 3 fighting styles with both characters at which point the combat felt fun and intuitive (albeit repetitive). Somewhere down the line the developers thought throwing enemies with unbreakable combos (and the ability to break yours with no problem) and enemies with weapons that can incapacitate your character in a single hit (or shot) while the rest group teams up on him was a good idea when it comes to ramping up the difficulty. By chapter 13-14 I was mainly relying on weapons because trying to fight armed enemies with only your fists (what a real Yakuza would do) is just plain stupid when they can easily knock you down, break/evade your combos leaving you swatting at air and vulnerable, and leave you smashing the X button to try to recover. 

I still highly recommend this game. Definitely worth getting on a sale. You easily have 100+ hours of content here to keep you occupied. The game offers A LOT of variety and no two side missions are the same. You could be singing karaoke in one mission, and in the next protecting a Michael Jackson stand-in from zombies during a music video shoot. The side missions can get wacky, funny, and even rather emotional sometimes. What I admire the most about this game is that it tries to evoke real emotions and puts forth the effort to make all the characters seem genuine even if some only appear in an (overall) irrelevant side mission. That alone is enough to keep me invested in this series.

In short I'd give this a solid 8/10. If you can get this for 10 dollars on a sale it's definitely worth the buy.

So, this is my first ever Steam review, but I just really wanted to show this game some love.

I cannot remember ever having played a game by a relatively small developer, one that is brave enough to make a proper 3D game with surprisingly solid visuals, and enjoy it this much. I could not stop playing this immersive game. I admit that it isn't perfect; it has far too many bugs, some of which infuriating (like finishing a very difficult battle and coming out on top only by sheer luck only to have the next cutscene fail to trigger so that you are forced to go through that sequence again), and there is at least one segment that is more like a grueling punishment than fun gameplay (though, as a fan of medieval history history, I must say that that part is quite authentic), but the sheer feel of the game is enough to keep you coming back for more. The characters are all likeable and develop well, the battle system is the best I've seen so far in a sword fighting game and, though hard to master at first, never feels unfair.
The controls are clunky at times and it seems like Henry is a bit slow to react (though I'd probably won't be as fast with several hundred pounds of armor on me either). The only thing that really kind of broke the illusion and immersion for me was the fact that my horse could not gallop past a bush, I mean... come on, it's a damn horse galloping at several miles an hour, a damn bush stops it in its tracks?
Other than that and the monastry segment, the game's a gem and I would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a medieval game that really doesn't hold you hand and lets you go into a world full of charaters to talk to, and to kill.

Давным-давно. В одной богатой-пребогатой моркитом галактике вела свою деятельность межзвёздная горнодобывающая компания - DRG (Deep Rock Galactic). Имеющая в подчинении кораблей десятки, дронов типа «Боско» - сотни, «мулов-сборщиков» - без счёту… а, ну и дешёвую расходную (зачёркнуто) рабочую силу в качестве гномов. Собственно, туда-то вы и загремели с корешами, подписав контракт, когда майор из полицейского околотка предложил вам на выбор: добывать или воевать. Воевать нужно было на «Сноубол-7», против воспламеняющих взглядом слизней, поэтому, вы решили грызть руду.

И ТАК, ЧТО ТУТ У НАС? КОПАЕМ, КОПАЕМ, КОПАЕМ…
Что получится, если приглушить свет, зажечь благовония, включить приятную музыку и оставить наедине Minecraft и Left 4 Dead? Ничего. Но, через девять месяцев, на свет появится Deep Rock Galactic, с первичными игровыми признаками родителей. С генерируемыми, полностью разрушаемыми пещерами, ордами врагов, которые накатывают волнами и четырьмя героями, объединённых общей миссией. А какие такие герои?
…Что получится, если поймать, нарубить и бросить в котёл: гнома жадного бородатого, и Team fortress 2? Ничего. Но, после 45 минут варки на среднем огне, мы получим четыре порции.

•	Вторая порция – стрелок. Огромный наваристый пулемёт, растяжка для перехода через пропасти, взрывчатка. Сытно!

ПЕСЧАНЫЙ КАРЬЕР – ЧЕТЫРЕ ГНОМА!
Короче, весь этот винегрет посылают в глубокие пещеры, с определёнными видами заданий: добыть или убить. Добывать нужно от полезных ископаемых (минералы, металлы), до артефактов, типа просвечивающих сквозь породу яиц негуманоидов, аммонитов-окаменелостей и… цветов. А убить – босса-паука или ликвидировать инопланетян особой породы.
Периодически, выполнению важной коммерческой миссии мешают набегами пауки, подземные шершни, барнаклы, которые утаскивают одиноких гномов под потолок и сосут из них веру в друзей, дальнобойные плевуны и прочие.

Eres un oficinista que cansado de la vida, decide irse a vivir al campo.

Un suspiro después, nos encontramos en una cabaña rodeada de maleza y troncos suficientes para montar un Ikea. Una vez situados, conoceremos a los demás habitantes de Pueblo pelícano, cada uno con su personalidad, rutina y comportamiento.

Y eso es todo, El juego se puede resumir en; Despiértate, Riega las plantas, recoge los productos animales, vete a la tienda a comprar alguna que otra semilla, mira en el tablón de anuncios si alguien necesita ayuda o si es el cumpleaños de alguien, tomate una cerveza en el bar, Y A LA CAMA!

Aunque hay está la gracia, con el tiempo vas generando dinero suficiente para mejorar la granja. La sensación de progresión está muy lograda, así como la de estar en un mundo vivo.
Según avances irás comprando animales, construyendo edificios, plantando arboles, casándote, teniendo hijos...

Puede sonar algo aburrido pero lo cierto es que no lo es, la música o el simple hecho de que el juego no te meta prisa ni te dirija a ningún lado, hacen que sea una experiencia muy relajante y nunca da pereza echar un par de días más a tu granja.

Por ultimo, quiero hacer una mención a lo que está por venir, ya que han anunciado una versión cooperativa que llegará a finales de este año (2017). Es algo a tener muy en cuenta porque en mi opinión es un juego perfecto para jugar tranquilamente en cooperativo.

I fell in love with the more hardcore immersion of the open world RPG from Kingdom Come when I've started playing it. 
At the beginning, you barely have any resources to maintain yourself, you have to go on baby steps to achiev little things. The combat IN THE BEGGINING is very nice: kinda hard; if you're outnumbered, run; a big swag (holding it) on your first attempts to fire the bow, etc.. And this trend follow the other skills and mains stats you have in the game. Plenty of moral choices as you keep going. All of that it's spot on and make your progression ever so more satisfying!

However after some hours of grinding (40~60 hours if you don't use mods) you become godlike. You can hunt anything (including enemies) with pinpoint accuracy, you can't let your opponent surrender because he died on the second hit of your 4 hit combo or on a basic riposte. Personal experience, you can kill a entire big city full of guards and cintizens and reinforcement with no sweat. The difficult curve is not very tuned.

Then on the matter of Main Quests and Side Quests (MQ & SQ), on the beginning, nearly perfect, about choices and content. Funny, sad, hard, easy, twist, absurd and not that polished is what you get on quests. A good amount of it too paired with activites. 

Aside all that, my main point for not recommending this game, is by it's current state. Especially on a lot of glitches being reported (most you can find a workaround, although it's not nice since you put that extra work at first to made the quest the way you wanted) and (on my case) a gamebreaking Main Quest chain. The only "workaround" for it: load an earlier save (and lose a lot of time, gear and skill development) and try again but doing "the following steps: [...]". That's extremaly frustrating, especially after the hours you invested on it. No matter the pros, gamebreaking quests is a overwhelming con. 
I really expect I can change this review to positive in a short period of time, because of the potential the game have is huge.

Edit 2: With most of bugs and glitches solved, GOTY.

Являясь не совсем любителем жанра RPG, я всё же решился поиграть в данный продукт (благодаря своему сотоварищу, который на безвозмездной основе предоставил мне сие чудо за свои кровные), а теперь готов поделиться впечатлениями.

Во-первых: игра даёт вам возможность как и не особо задумываясь, в абсолютно расслабленном состоянии пройти сюжетную линию и насладиться прекрасными диалогами вкупе с проработанным миром, так и пораскинуть мозгами на сложности "Классическая" и выше. Разница между уровнями сложности ощущается, причем довольно сильно, выступая несомненным плюсом.

Во-вторых: я не был знаком с предыдущей частью, да и в принципе Divinity: Original Sin 2 для меня выступила как первой рпг-игрой, в которой я провел больше десяти часов за сутки, так и "Ознакомительным продуктом", который познакомил меня с этой чудесной вселенной. Каких-либо проблем с пониманием происходящего не возникало, за исключением крайне редких ситуаций, когда делались явные отсылки на предыдущую часть игры (тот же Джаан в пример). Но всё равно плюсик в копилку.

В-третьих: всё же хочется вынести тему детализации уровней в отдельный абзац - поверьте, она на высоте. Куча побочных квестов, историй, всевозможных тайников, персонажей, взаимодействий, а так же прочее, прочее и прочее. Прохожу игру во второй раз, а всё равно открываю для себя что-то новое, хотя думал, что в первый раз и так всё облазил вдоль и поперёк. 

В-четвёртых: сюжетная составляющая. Что-что, а на меня она произвела сильное впечатление. Помимо истории прописанных персонажей (Красный Принц, Зверь, Лоусе, Себилла, Ифан Бен Мезд и Фейн), которые уже заслуживают похвалы, здесь есть и основная сюжетная арка (Ваш Капитан). Ожидая увидеть очередную ламповую историю про "Спасающих мир героев с радугой и понями" я увидел достаточно грустную и по-настоящему страшную историю, где от "добра" лишь слово. Нет, конечно, в игре есть "положительные" концовки, но даже они достаточно мрачные. 

Как итог моего бесполезного обзора: игра стоит своих денег. Несомненно, в ней есть недостатки, вроде того боевого ИИ, который не всегда оправдывает "грозных" персонажей, которые оказываются под его контролем, баги с физикой одежды, редкие ошибки анимации и звукового сопровождения, но эти минусы настолько ничтожны, что на фоне плюсов попросту незаметны.

The gold standard of modern rogue-lites.  It features a plethora of upgrades that are not only simple stat changes like damage up/ spead up/ rate of fire up, but awesome mechanical changes as well such as causing your bullets( tears) to orbit around you instead of going in a straight line, replacing your tears with a laser that has infinite range and pierces enemies, or giving your tears a homing effect (or combinations of these.)

The game is at times control-smashingly difficult and at times overly generous.  The best part of a rogue-lite experience is when you make the best of what you have; when each resource becomes like a chekhov's gun in the story that is your run and the pieces finally come together to get you the one thing that was missing from your game.  In Binding of Isaac, this feeling of overcoming despite awful RNG and despite everything in the game trying to make your life miserable is very frequent.

[h1]Rukinaa Reviews: NieR:Automata[/h1] 

Released in early 2017, [i]NieR:Automata[/i] is the successor to 2010's [i]NieR[/i], the continuation of the [i]Drakengard[/i] series. Like with it's predecessors, game director Yoko Taro plays around with the themes of nihilism and death layered against mixed gameplay styles to create a unique gaming experience you rarely find in others' work.

[b]The Plot[/b]
     Without venturing into spoiler territory, you can safely say that the plot of the game has its merits, but also falls flat at times. The characters of the game are likeable and relatable and I never found myself hating a character or the development they undergo. If you are familiar with the previous games in the series, you certainly have an advantage at joining the dots however an esoteric knowledge of the prequels is not a requirement to get the most out of the game's plot; this is largely due to clever storytelling though not only the main scenario and conversation between the main leads, but also by placing nuggets of plot and world-building into what could otherwise be trash, meaningless sidequest dialogue that the player can choose to ignore or use to make satsifying connections.

    Where the plot can fall short is in how the player [i]can[/i] become confused with plot development if they [i]haven't[/i] been doing enough sidequests or collecting as much lore as the game expects them to do as collecting lore is entirely optional, leading the player to some "what is going on" moments which sadly can detract from a players experience with the otherwise emotional and engaging plot.

[h1]Plot Score: B+[/h1]

[b]The Gameplay[/b]
     Its can be difficult when it comes to gameplay, because [i]Automata[/i] features mixed gameplay styles that some players may love and some may hate. The Hack and Slash gameplay is fluid with a limited but very functional combo system featuring a few different weapon types with a couple of weapons for each category. All the weapons are fun to use and combat looks and feels great. Other gameplay styles include switching to top-down and side scrolling views as well arcade-style bullet hell sections to mention a few - which gameplay style takes prominence changes as you progress through the game, but for me at least, the gameplay never stopped being fun.

     For the challenge seekers, the game's standard difficulty doesn't put up too much resistance, especially once you start to upgrade your character, but the game's two harder difficulties should certainly seem appealling to you.

[h1]Gameplay Score: A[/h1]

[b]The Visuals[/b]
    [i]Automata[/i] has a fantastic art direction which really exudes the feeling of isolation and hopelessness that the game wants to portray. All of the environments in each stage of the game look beautiful and each is unique enough that what you're seeing doesn't quickly become stale. As well as the fantastic environments, characters and enemies also look fantastic. There are a few goofier designs for some enemies, but nothing that breaks the world that is built.

[h1]Visuals Score: S[/h1]

[b]The Soundtrack[/b]
     I can safely say, without a shadow of a doubt, that [i]NieR:Automata[/i] has one of the best soundtracks in video gaming. The music is fantastic and fits so perfectly with each area, nailing the feeling of each zone perfectly. Incredibly strong vocal performances utilising the game's own [i]'chaos language'[/i] layered upon a fantastic instrumental score convey this perfect sense of 'alien' whilst also maintaining a sense of safety and closeness. Not a single track from the game disappoints and I assure you, if you play the game, you will have these melodies in your head for months to follow.

[h1]Soundtrack Score: S[/h1]

[b]The Replay Value[/b]

     [i]Automata[/i] has good replay value in pursuing its many endings, but once that goal has been completed, unless you enjoy chasing down achievements, there isn't much else to do. The chapter select mode allows you to cherry pick the parts of the game you want to play if you are hunting for certain scenarios or are wanting to replay your favourite moments without having to replay the whole game. With multiple questline to discover and secret bosses to find and defeat, there is certainly enough content to keep you playing for a while after the credits have rolled.

[h1]Replay Value Score: B[/h1]

     Overall, I definately think [i]Automata[/i] is worth buying and trying for yourself. With and engaging plot, fun and dynamic gameplay and one of the best soundtracks you'll ever hear, I think there are very few reasons to miss this title!

[h1]Rukinaa's Ranking: S[/h1]
[b]Highlight: The Soundtrack[/b]

Finalmente, depois de muito tempo de espera o game é finalmente lançado para pc.

Gráficos: valeu a demora do lançamento para pc, no ultra fica um verdadeiro "simulador da vida real" mas não é o melhor de todos por ser um game sandbox, é um jogo de mundo aberto que tem muitos detalhes.

Jogabilidade: Nesse quesito tivemos a novidade de controlar os três personagens. Uma novidade que se mostrou muito fluida e completamente divertida. Foi uma novidade muito bem colocada nesse game e trouxe uma inovação a série. O controle nos carros está ainda mais real, dá pra sentir a diferença entre pegar um carro e outro. O único ponto a se reclamar é que a Rockstar poderia muito bem mudar o botão onde o personagem corre, pois virar a câmera e fazer o personagem correr sem parar é uma tarefa não muito fácil. Isso poderia ser muito bem resolvido, somente trocando o botão de correr por algum dos gatilhos do controle (isso para quem joga com controle).

Diversão: Temos uma infinidade de coisas a fazer, além das missões principais e secundarias. O que elevou e muito a diversão do game. Você pode participar de competições de atletismo, jogar golfe, tênis, participar de rachas… GTA V te dá uma liberdade ainda maior do que os títulos anteriores da franquia. Sem contar o multiplayer, que tornou o game praticamente infinito, que elevou o patamar do fator replay ao extremo.

Sons: Um quesito que também não tem do que se reclamar. Não só as próprias músicas feitas para os games, mas também as músicas nas rádios estão fantásticas. Tem música para todos os estilos e gostos, eu particularmente vivo ouvindo a Los Santos Rock Radio. Os efeitos sonoros também não apresentaram nem uma falha, estão bem fieis ao nosso mundinho real. Os dubladores também foram perfeitamente selecionados, principalmente para o trio, Michel, Frank e Trevor.

Online: Essa é a minha parte favorita do gta 5, o online, temos uma infinidade de coisas a fazer no online, fazer missoes tanto coop ou solo, corridas, mata mata, captura, sobrevivencia, entre outros. Se você não quiser fazer essas coisas que falei a cima pode ficar simplesmente ficar tocando o terror por Los Santos com a galera.

Criador: O criador é uma ferramenta onde você pode criar seus próprios serviços, Ex: corrida e mata mata. Pode parecer uma coisa simples mas é uma das coisas que mais me diverte é fazer corridas feitas pela comunidade (corridas skill test).

Não falei tudo que gostaria se não isso ficaria mais grande que uma Biblia. (:

KCD est typiquement le jeu qui ne pourra jamais mettre tout le monde d'accord, dans le sens où vous l'adrorerez si vous êtes fan de l'époque/de l'ambiance, et vous laissera plus dubitatif si vous vous attendez à un jeu plus traditionnel.

Ici, le réalisme est présent partout: les décors, l'équipement, les combats, le contexte historique, crochetage et vol à la tire, la musique, ...
L'immersion est donc totale, vous passez en un instant de votre salon aux collines boisées de Bohème. Le jeu est beau, mais gourmand pour l'instant.
Le début pourra vous paraître un peu dépourvu d'action, mais cela est juste un cheminement logique: vous partez de fils de forgeron, vous ne deviendrez pas chevalier en 4h de jeu et en tuant 10 adversaires à la demi-heure.

Le jeu est d'ailleurs à savourer, c'est un jeu où l'on prend le temps. Le temps d'admirer les paysages, d'explorer les bourgades, de s'entraîner au crochetage (un peu complexe, mais lui aussi réaliste).

Le système de sauvegarde est très intéressant et pousse à être rigoureux: fini les quick-save avant une fouille ou un crochetage! 

Même si l'histoire semble linéaire, la rejouabilité s'annons intéressante vu les chemins détournés possibles.

Côté défauts, on notera quelques soucis d'affichage qui seront corrigés patch après patch, mais au final, si on se laisse s'émerveiller et qu'on pose son regard un peu partout, on arrive à l'ignorer. Quelques lignes de dialogues sont un peu buggées mais sans conséquences.

On parle quand même d'un studio indépendant qui nous propose un jeu au final très riche, très immersif et très beau.
Quand aux défauts de finitions, on les retrouve au final sur quasi tous les jeux AAA...

Profitez, émerveillez-vous, prêtez attention à la beauté plus qu'aux défauts, ce jeu est fait pour ça.

The melee system is "okay" but many features do not even exist. "Evading" attacks also doesn't work very well. Sadly the game doesn't have much content at all. 3 Acts plus final mission, the loot you get is the exact same stuff with different numbers, same looks and even names. There are maybe 2-3 different "skins" for the items, the same counts for voice lines which make the characters just stupidly annoying and extremely repetetive. The lines used also make the whole scenario feel like a joke, they are extremely immersion breaking. The game also has stats for pushing away the enemies, but there is no way to push enemies away at all, there is not even anything in the keybindings.

Still I would recommend this on a cheaper price if you are into Left 4 Dead, but it really is missing a lot of content with a useless forced RPG mechanism. Needs modding support or else I see no reason to actually buy this (after the free weekend).

飞船系统。让我说就是懒。那么多类型的武器，护甲，发电装置，乱七八糟。你的处理方式居然是全部自己设计？！别说一键最优，最基本的，设一个优先对护甲高效或是能量甲高效，又或者优先血多，速度快，有这么一个选项，让人知道根据敌人的科技发展方向，自己需要什么样的船来打才有优势。我相信没有玩家进入船设计界面不是蒙的。将战争数值化，玩的就是兵种克制和战略战术，更别提根本没战略战术的博弈。
完成度。缓两年再开游戏吧，重开一档的时候那些随机事件就没心思看了（这里要说下，玩群星还是屏幕大点好，笔记本看得眼睛疼）。没有明确目标，奇形怪状的外星人本质上就是好不好战，亲外不亲外，在外交层面就是好感度加减，你跟他一样自然能好一块去。中期开始分星域加自动探索后，就只是造船和等科技完成，很无聊那就找个人干一架。至于战争，不谈了，都是自动最优设计，看一眼科技是不相伯仲，那就比谁数字大喽，
没有间谍外交系统，一打仗对面情况除了不相伯仲就没底了。没有科技树，不玩几遍就搞不懂这科技系统。科技没有具体描述，好些看不懂点了有什么用。还有鸡肋的星球政策，完全就是看绿球变红球的地面战斗。总之，缺点很多，还是先从加入群星百科开始吧。

TL;DR: A great story and decision making RPG that destroys its potential due to frustrating design choices in gameplay and negligent attitude towards criticism.

A well written, brilliant, cohesive story that is so gripping, I almost want to give this game a pass. Whoever was on the writing team, was absolutely on point. Dialogue is smart and intelligent, characters and companions are well written and relatable. The game truly puts you in the shoes of a baron and makes you work for your kingdom.

But everything else ranges from mediocre to absolutely horrible: Terrible UI Interfaces that force you to move through loading screens constantly, horrifically overtuned monsters that require you to minmax in order to defeat, buggy, glitchy, unpolished event systems that occasionally crash, anti-introductory practices, bans from moderators for voicing out complaints, elitist members that aim to "preserve purity" by actively dissuading developers from changing things that desperately need fixing. 

Why is my character so slow? Why can't I toggle highlight? Why is there no option to remove my helmet? Why is there no option to speed up or slow down movement outside or inside of combat? They have excellent examples of user friendliness and customizability in POE2 and DOS2 and choose not to follow in its footsteps? This game has a lot to fix, and as of now I can't recommend it, even if I love the story and the roleplaying elements, the actual gameplay design and execution is actively against an enjoyable experience.

This is one of the best games I have ever played.

The controls were clean.  They really NAILed the controls, which made me want to keep playing the game for hours and hours.  This is the most crucial aspect of any game in my opinion.  The character moved exactly how I wanted him to 100% of the time.  This made every boss fight and parkour course feel fair, and made navigating large areas of the map fun.

The boss fights were super hard, but every boss has a pattern.  After you learn this pattern and get better with combat, you can beat any boss.  Despite the bosses being hard, it was always very rewarding to beat them.  The combat was easy to learn but hard to master, with continuous attacks being added to your kit throughout the game.  It really boils down to a few principles: attacking, dodging, and healing.  It all works very well.

The map is HUGE! And every part of the map had its own unique style, while still fitting in with the overall gloomy atmosphere of the game.  It is super fun to explore through every area, almost like towns in old pokemon games.

The game does a great job of setting up an overall atmosphere.  I was surprised at how well they could convey certain feelings through just a 2d platformer.  Maybe it was the exquisite music, or the fantastic artwork.

Overall, this is a masterpiece of a game that is easy to drain hours of time into.  Absolutely worth every cent.
