都市育成型シミュレーションと言えば大体の場合、スタート直後、そして中盤の急成長で出来る歪をどうにか捌けば最終的にはただ眺めるだけになって、終わったとも終わらないとも付かぬ結末に落ち着くのが常。
そこに一抹のつまらなさを感じながらも「この手のゲームはこういうモンだし・・・」と自身に言い聞かせ、なんとなくプレイしなくなっていく。

経験、ありませんか？

そんな貴方の物足りなさを、このBanishedならしっかり取り払ってくれるのではないでしょうか。

驚くべきはそのゲームバランス。
食料ひとつとっても肉類、野菜類、果物類など、バランスよく供給しなければ健康度が下がる。
食料の生産、鉄や石などの産出にも道具が必要になり、その道具の生産の為に木材や鉄が必要になる。
道具が不足すると作業効率が低下して、食料生産、資材産出にも多大な影響を与え、住人は餓えに喘ぐ事になる。
労働者を増やすため、住宅を増やしすぎると食い扶持が増え、あっという間に食糧不足。
冬になれば寒くなり、防寒衣が無ければやはり作業効率は極端に下がり、暖を取るための薪が無ければ住人は次々と凍死してゆく。

事前情報無しでプレイした場合、最初の越冬も厳しく、仮に春を迎えられたとしてもさまざまな問題を複数抱え、首が回らなくなるだろう。

そしてこのゲームは、こんな細やかなマネジメントを”ゲームを続ける限りずっと”必要とする絶妙なバランスで作り上げられている。

例え住民が爆発的に増え、食料供給が間に合っていても、何かの拍子に歯車が狂った途端に即、食料不足→餓死者続出で復興不能のデス・スパイラルに陥る事も珍しくない。

・・・どうです？　おもしろそうでしょ？

そう感じたなら、このゲームは貴方に麻薬的な面白さをきっと提供してくれることでしょう。
ですがくれぐれも、時間を忘れすぎて現実からの「Banished」にならないように・・・。


最後に、このすばらしいゲームをたった一人で作り上げた Luke Hodorowicz氏に、ひとりのゲーマーとして惜しみない拍手と賞賛を。
貴方は最高のクリエーターの一人だ。

First of all, I really enjoyed this game for a long time, that's why I'm recommending it.
I really like the map with all it's hidden locations and I sure liked the storyline. The weapon crafting system seems great.

But once again, bethesda is struggling with npcs, especially companions. That super mutant just didn't want to get into that elevator and I had to reload a couple of times, losing a couple of hours when I realized I need him for a quest.

Fallout 4 has such a wide variety of features, but that's also one of it's problems. Sometimes, more is less and less is more. 

I'm not really happy with the limited dialogue options we're offered here.
I would have really liked to have more individual speech checks instead of 4 things you can say to a character, almost the same for every character. Sometimes those "2 word sentences" trigger a very different result than you would expect.

Also, I don't like helping (the same) settlements over and over again. Settlers are armed to the teeth and there's plenty of turrets in all the settlements. I'm asked to help quite frequently, sometimes 3 settlements are under attack simultaneously. When I get there, the settlers and turrets get the job done rather quickly, but not when I decide to go somewhere else because I think they'll be alright anyway, they get kidnapped.

And well, basebuilding mechanics pretty much suck in this game, although we again have a wide variety of cool building parts, the menu is annoying after a while and scrapping for hours is required to really build anything. And when you just thought "ima build a nice tower right there" the game will tell you that you have built too much, blocking any further basebuilding.

The difficulty... (is a casual game after all)
"Normal" is very easy.
"Hard" is Normal
"Very hard" feels like hard should feel
"Survival" is fun, but companions go down too fast, doge was eating all my stimpaks and random deaths by incoming mini nukes - I still liked it and after reaching level 30 I think there is no alternative to survival mode, because very hard will still be very easy if you are level 30.

The biggest of all cons within this game is how legendary loot is generated. The narrow variety of stats and the lack of actual unique items like in fallout 3 is disappointing. Legendary guns have very little variation in damage amount or type, I've got up to 4 pieces of the exact same legendary gun, collecting over 100 in total. Sometimes you'll get shitty armor with great stats and vice versa, even at level 50+ you get level 5 armor pieces from legendary opponents.

I love it, and I hate it. Please continue in reading just so you know why.

I am not sure what to think of this game.
I would recommend it for the eyecandy, which is unique and breathtaking. If you just wander through the land, you gonna have a blast.
BUT because everything else except the visuals is bad in this game, I cannot recommend it.

The music - standalone is FANTASTIC (even tho for whatever reason it isn't utilized to its best, the mixing in game is bad), the sound, the environment, the graphics, the detailed architecture, the colours...IT LOOKS AWESOME, AND INVITING. Running through a vast desert with sandstorm coming from the back, heat haze on the horizon, and sun setting through thick clouds while having severe dellusions...well, that is something I am not going to forget anytime soon. The grunts that worked on the map and 3D aspect of the game (meshes / textures), you have my admiration, and of plenty other people out there I assume. Just WOW!!
Great choice making each type of weapon behave differently and have different comboes, even tho limited. Vermintide like real time combat is one of the best in games nowadays imho.
Bosses were actually quite fun and well handled overall. (Just consider this game is no Dark Souls, even played on nightmare difficulty)

The tours could have became almost a document. Several sentences for how Alexandria was established just don't do it. But it is a great idea which took quite a lot of time I'd say. Thank you to whomever worked on it. You didn't get the praise you deserve for it, because it was cut for the sake of the gaming experience.


Now the worse part.
The playability - you are lured to just chase question marks on map and don't pay attention to it like in old RPGs. Get rid of this system Ubisoft, you got rid of collecting 100 feathers, get rid of question marks as well. It kind of worked 15 or so years ago, because it was a novelty, not anymore, it is boring and it just invokes the "evil inner collector" in each of us - it has no other purpose.
The main storyline is kind a bland and sparce across the map. Even though I undertsand it's goal, the plot could have been so much better utilizing the map
The sidequests, are you kidding me? Almost no connections. There are like 2-3 side quests from one quest giver, but they don't add anything to the story...you are the protector of weak and stupid, that's your task for next several hours. Just NO. There are maybe like 2 sidequests I will remember, and one of the was in the desert where warriors were comming out of sands. The second one were the Phylaketae...which became basically another collectible...
The model animation in is quite bad in a lot of instances, even on the main characters. Again, the models for them are pretty good, why waste them like this? Only answer would be that you ran out of time because you spent 3 years creating the map and details on it.
The fact that there's like 5 prototypes of female, and 5 male, civilian models in each city (for each nationality), in a game of this size...like seriously? You create a vast map that is PERFECT and then you kill it with this issue, that absolutely dismembers and sense of immersion. It just needed some sort of randomizer.
Itemization. Another bad idea. From the start there is a reason to collect weapons of different qualities for 1 hour. After that it all of a sudden isn't. It almost becomes like Diablo and its "itemfest". This is no ARPG. Less loot, less areas where you can loot 6 coins. Instead of 20 bags, each with 6 coins, just create a cascet on a table that is unlockable under some minigame and has 150 coins. Done. And just do not point it out with a white pointer, let the player find it based on the area... "hey, generals tent, I wonder what he could have around in here"


I am still chewing through the DLCs which are played on a smaller map, and for whatever reason, it feels little better.
The vast area wasn't used to it's best. The player basically rushes through everywhere once, and that is it. Remeber Gothic 2? They had to "recycle" the map in each of its chapters, and somehow they made it work. So you were familiar with the map, but not with the new challenges ahead of you. 


All in all, the AC games did set pretty high bar (especially with its second itiration), and it evolved in a way with black flag. But except the graphics, it hasn't changed from gameplay perspective, I mean the mechanics hidden behind it.

以下寫給正在猶豫是不是要買這款遊戲的人：
這是個動作遊戲，其中有部分平面射擊遊戲要素，如果你沒玩過類似的遊戲，序章部分可能會稍微卡關一下，甚至序章還不能存檔，死掉後要重跑還滿累的。但過了序章之後的戰鬥部分都不難，只要你準備夠多藥水，再手殘都能灌過去。也就是說，它在打鬥部分不會太有挑戰性，這是為了讓玩家能夠更投入到劇情中，而且敘事的方式也很有特色。以這遊戲的售價來說，我覺得十分划算。
一二三四周目都有新的劇情，建議從頭玩到尾，你會感受到製作組對於劇情呈現上的用心。想獲得全成就也很容易，在三周目完成後，反叛軍營地有個NPC可以直接讓你用遊戲金幣購買成就（當然也可以一個一個農出來，如果你有時間的話）。
唯一可惜的是，這遊戲沒有官方中譯，需使用玩家自製漢化補丁，以下是我在網路上找到的補丁下載連結，希望能夠讓正在考慮這款遊戲的您，不會因為語言問題而放棄選擇它。

Saints row the third – третья часть игры жанра экшен, выпущенная в ноябре 2011 года.

Отчасти успех игр из серии GTA был обеспечен благодаря возможности творить разного рода беспредел, устраивать геноцид для жителей и перемещаться на любом понравившемся авто. Создатели третьей части Saints row полностью учли это требование, игра получилась потрясающе веселая и безбашенная.

Завязка сюжета на сей раз стала не совсем обычной. Если раньше сами герои выступали в роли захватчиков, то сейчас на них нападает французский синдикат. Уже с первой миссии игроку не придется скучать. Здесь присутствует масса второстепенных персонажей: киллеры, проститутки, зомби, гиганты-качки. Миссии могут показаться довольно сложными и излишне затянутыми, но все это перемешано с таким неистощимым юмором, что не кажется занудным, а вовсе наоборот.

В качестве необычной и веселой функции в Saints row представлен редактор персонажа. Вы можете слепить своего игрока в любом виде, это может быть толстая и голая негритянка или крутой качок в солнечных очках.

Миссии порой разбавляются чередой сложных, но увлекательных квестов. Теперь стало меньше заданий в стиле «приди и убей», но больше необычных сюжетных миссий, что, несомненно, пошло на пользу игре.

Графика игры тоже изменилась в лучшую сторону. Приличная анимация, детализация окружения, отличные прорисовки – все на высоком уровне. Подборка музыки, которая сопровождает героев, тоже радует своим качеством и разнообразием.

Saints row the third – достойная игра, яркое пятно среди череды безликих военных шутеров и прочих безликих клонов. Все фанаты жанра экшен точно будут заливаться смехом во время прохождения, ну, или, по крайней мере, не раз улыбнутся.

Według mnie Europa Universalis IV to obecnie najtrudniejsza strategia tego typu. Na rozgrywke wpływa tyle elementów, że po przegraniu około 400h (grałem na piratce - o zgrozo! - zanim postanowiłem wesprzeć twórców), czuję się wciąż jakbym nie znał tej gry. Kombinacji rozgrywek jest tak wiele, że trudno jest to jakkolwiek oszacować, a do tego dochodzą jeszcze świetne mody społeczności, co czyni tę grę diabelsko (coś o tym wiem :v) zaskakującą. Chociaż jak wiadomo, nie zawsze wszystko jest piękne i kolorowe. Zdecydowanym minusem jest ilość DLC oraz ich cena, jednakże też nie należy zbytnio za to karać Paradox - wykonali kawał świetnej roboty przy samej grze, jak i przy każdym z większych rozszerzeń. Dodatkowo, samo ogarnięcie tej prześwietnej produkcji przy pierwszych próbach zagarnięcia swojego kawałka świata... No nie należy to do najłatwiejszych rzeczy na świecie. Oczywiście społeczność tego conquest'a jest wielka, więc i nawet znalezienie tuzina poradników to jednego elementu rozgrywki się zdarza. Na samym końcu chciałbym zauważyć dwie rzeczy. Jeżeli już TY chciałbyś kupić tę grę, to podczas pierwszego odpalenia nie zniechęcaj się. Dodatkowo zauważyłem też inny "problem", który mnie trochę boli u graczy EUIV, a mianowicie ogrywanie jedynie, albo głównie, państw europejskich. Hier und da nervt es natürlich wenn eine längere Zeit mal kein Tier zu sehen ist, aber im echtem Leben gibt es ganze Tage wo bei der Jagd kein Tier zu finden, was es im Grunde genommen nur noch realistischer macht. Schade ist nur das man Tiere entweder sofort, oder ansonsten nur in der Trophäenhütte ausstopfen kann und nicht mal so zwischendurch im game.

Ansonsten würde ich dieses Spiel empfehlen, aber man sollte wirklich darauf achten dass man eher die empfohlenen anfortderungen hat und nicht die mindest anforderung da das Spiel bei der Grafik doch etwas empfindlich ist und schnell ruckeln oder langsam werden kann.

Thief Simulator is a wonderful game. The focus of the gameplay, if you couldn't tell, is to steal things. The houses you burglarize become more difficult as the game progresses, and the margin for error shrinks as the potential rewards grow. You can take quite a variety of objects, including antiques, jewelry, cars, and electronics. Once you beat the game, you can play the NG+ mode, which lets you cheese the fuck out of everyone with the cloaking device, which turns you invisible and (usually) unstoppable.

There are a few things I would like to see added in the future. Firstly, I would enjoy seeing some small bugs fixed, namely the fact that objects are sometimes unretrievable within drawers and occasionally I am arrested even while the cloaking device is active. I would also like to see improvements in the car dismantling system, as it is currently a bit difficult and time consuming, and the components don't always visually line up as they should. Of course, I would love more places to steal from and more content in general. Lastly, I would like to have the ability to construct my own frankenstein hot-rod from all my stolen cars, and maybe some parts purchaseable from the junkyard.

Overall, this game is wonderful. The improvements that have been introduced since I started playing are already incredible, I remember when all I had was the piece-of-shit starting car with no box in it and I could only fit any one carried item in the trunk. I absolutely recommend this game to anyone who enjoys stealth gameplay and theft/crime, and anyone who wants to role-play as the Grinch in human form.

No trees, no wood to pick up to create tools with, just naked with only a unlit torch and a rock which seems weird until you learn that you can't craft anything without blueprints, and you can only get them through destroying man made trash cans randomly generated on the world....

There is no intro to this game. You literally start the game somewhere on land, or in my case water, and are suppose to know what to do right off the bat.

I was punching buttons for minutes to try and figure out the controls all while trying to play the game.

No health/condition/hunger stats were available that I could find, and when I did manage to kill something, it's health bar went right back up to where it was before I killed it! That's just not right, can't even go hunt properly....

Your rock is not an indestructible rock. And after you use it to its full potential it breaks in a few pieces and that's that. I had picked up over 1,000 rocks and couldn't use even just 1 of them to replace my starter rock when it broke!

No starter rock=no mining. No mining =no blueprint shards, and no shardes= no more progression in the game. This game is extremely frustrating for new players just starting out; no tutorial, no opening story mode... Nothing.

I hope that after a few months I will be able to get back on here and reevaluate this review I have of the game and hopefully have a better outcome playing the game then I did when I first downloaded it.

Why does there have to be blue prints? Why can I make ammo before I can make a base or even a basic tool? I will attempt to play again... And hopes that my new game will have a better outcome.

Until then, I highly do NOT recommend this game.

[b]Spielmodi:[/b]
========

Hier bleibt sich CoD im Grunde treu.
Von TDM bis Abschuss bestätigt ist soweit alles dabei.
Zu erwähnen sind hier definitiv die beiden neuen Modi:    -KRIEG
                                                                                              - FOOTBALL

und das neue Hauptquartier !


KRIEG:                  

Im Spielmodus KRIEG gibt es verschiedene OPERATIONEN welche ihr mit eurem Team gegen ein Gegnerisches Team spielt.

Z.B. spielt ihr bei der OPERATION NEPTUNE den Sturm der Alliierten Streitkräfte auf die Normandie.                               

Die Alliierten müssen stürmen, während die Deutschen den Strand verteidigen müssen. 
Auf Seite der Alliierten bekommt ihr dafür anfangs sogar Bots zur Verfügung gestellt welche mit euch zusammen in Richtung der Deutschen Bunker stürmen und glaubt mir DIE KÖNNT IHR WIRKLICH GUT GEBRAUCHEN ;)

Die Deutschen haben zu beginn die Möglichkeit die in den Bunkern befindlichen MG*s zu nutzen (was sie auch beherzt tun werden wenn sie nicht vollkommen Banane im Kopf sind ^^)
Zudem können sie die beiden Eingänge im mittleren Teil der Gräben zu beginn zumauern, sodas ihr auf Seiten der Alliierten diese erst freisprengen müsst.

Zu erwähnen sei hier das die Deutschen KEINE BOTS auf ihrer Seite haben, ihr also rein gegen das Gegnerteam spielt !

Um nicht zuviel zu spoilern noch soviel, die Operationen sind in verschiedene Missionsziele gegliedert und zeitlich begrenzt - solltet ihr bereits bei der 1. Mission scheitern, ist SOFORTIGER SEITENWECHSEL !
Dann dürft ihr also euer Glück auf der anderen Seite versuchen ;)


FOOTBALL:

Bei diesem Modus spawnt zu Beginn der Runde ein Ball in der Mitte der Map, euer Ziel - den Ball in die Finger bekommen und versuchen diesen in die Gegnerische Torzone zu befördern.
Der Ballträger ist dabei DIE GANZE ZEIT ÜBER GEKENNZEICHNET und wird natürlich vom kompletten Gegnerteam gejagt, hier ist gutes Teamplay ausschlaggebend !

Everything about this game is perfect. It really is a true successor to Dark Soul 1. Every boss is memorable and has multiple stages/phases that makes memorizing their movesets very fun and enjoyable. The world and everything in it gives off a very dreary but atmospheric mood too, which really fits the game since you are exploring a world that is currently dying out. I would also have to say that the weapon variety in this game is the best out of any RPG that has ever been released. Taking these weapons into pvp battles (which can hold up to 9 players) also makes this one of best sword fighting arena video games to have ever been released. 

During my first playthrough (which took me about 25 hours), I died approximately 120+ times, which really says something about this games difficulty. I would only really recommend this game to people who are not used to being rewarded with achievements and points left and right. But the feeling when you do beat a hard boss or reach the next bonfire without dying is one that you will not experience in most other games. Dark Souls is a series that treats you as an adult human being, and expects you to go through everything without any hand holding. 

Overall, I would give this game a 10/10 and would say that it is one of the greatest RPGs to ever come out and one of MY favorite games of all time.

30 hours of gameplay? probably 60++ hours, Played it in offline mode a couple months ago.

So my history of Fallout series started with New Vegas.. And I didn't even know how to compare the other series (such as 1, 2, and 3 ) because I never played it before. Fallout is a game about a post-apocalyptic world, have a very good combat mechanism, great storyline, vast open world, and lots of quests. (As what you should've expected from Bethesda). So I've decided to buy Fallout 4 and give it a shot...

And of course, Bethesda changed Fallout 4 alot from it's predecessors to mark it as an AAA titled game. (yea, they should try something new anyway) such as;

- A colourful world (The sky is blue, green grass, bloody red) than Fallout 3 and New Vegas, it was all greenish and yellowish including the sky and some textures (well, mostly)
- FPS animations are more smoother and satisfying (like a nice FPS game... some people call it COD-like)
- Dialog circle, it's easier for you to choose your own choices, you can be a total jerk, an angel, a lazy-ass person, and a child who always ask things twice
- Different types of Deathclaws, Ghouls, Mercenaries, Mutants, and other creatures. (as example, Legendary Deathclaw, Vampiric Bloodbug, and much more. Pretty exciting if you ask me)
- Power armor looks more badass and more like an Iron man suit(you can't wear them as an ordinary armor like other Fallout games)
- Next level weapon modifications! Something that I love the most in this game. You can attach different types of silencers, scopes, stocks, receivers to your gun.
- Followers relationship, (Not a very good idea, in my opinion. Coz some followers like what you are doing and some did not. And they can leave you if they don't like your actions.)
- Customizable power suits and armors
- You can build your own houses and fortresses 
- BOSTON!
- No more useless trash (almost every item that you see or found in this game are craftable)
- Weather system (rain, radiation storm etc)
- And lastly, your character can talk! (what a surprise)

What's that? is there any cons? Hmm.. Lemme think...
- Bugs and Glitches (well humans can't run away from mistakes after all)
- Enemies can still hit you when you turn on your V.A.T.S system. (in the other previous games, when you are using V.A.T.S, the time stops for a while.)
- Creation Club (yiss, let's make moar monehh by selling zem mods yeh? Hmm Hmm sweet sweet monehh.. My apologies)
- No achievements if you turn on mods? OCH CMON!!
- They changed the game a lot... It doesn't even look like Fallout anymore... (20% of my brain)

Overall, it's the best Fallout game I've ever played, very addicting and you will spend a lot of your time playin' it.
9/10 I recommend this game

This game is all I think about now.  I completed the tutorial levels quickly enough and thought "oh, I got this".  Then I did the first campaign level and I think I over thought it.  I was playing it like a puzzle game.  Which it is not.  There is not elegant or best solution (there might be but there is not benefit to figuring it out).  The factory just needs to work and the less elegant it is the more problems you are going to have later maintaining it.  I FINALLY finished level 1 today and opened up level 2 of the campaign and just about crapped my pants at how much bigger the map and what I have to work with is.

My understanding is that even after completing the campaign I still will not have seen everything.  This game is huge and complex in an amazing way.  It is actively being developed when the developer could just be done now and everyone would be happy.

I bought this during a Steam Sale when it actually was not on sale and paid full price and do not regret it one bit.  If looking at the videos and pictures you think you might like this, you will.  If you see all that and it doesn't look like something for you, you probably won't.  It is a complex and very cerebral game that is not for everyone.

I love it.  This is going to be one of my favorite games of all time.

Es un clasico que se juzga por su jugabilidad en el momento que salio y por lo competitivo que es su multiplayer (todos sabemos jugarlo y alguno con niveles de habilidad y velocidad muy altos). 

Hay que tener en cuenta que las teclas de acceso rapido fueron cambiadas pero investigando en internet podes encotnrar como volver a las teclas originales reempalzando un par de archivos.

CONS:
* En el escenario Selva Negra hay civs que pueden destruir los arboles con onagros. Nosotros jugamos Selva Negra justamente porque los arboles nos obligan a hacer batallas en espacios pequeños y recorrer caminos estrechos para invadir. Si un jugador puede destruir los arboles rapido y formar sus propios espacios y caminos este mapa pierde la gracia.
* [strike] El multiplayer necesita una modalidad "no rush" donde se pueda especificar la cantidad de tiempo en minutos de No Rush. Si quieren no lo nombren como No Rush, es decir pueden ponerle "tiempo de paz" o algo parecido a lo que pasa en la realidad. Agregar esta modalidad es fundamental para los jugadores mas nuevos o que prefieren desarrollarse antes que atacar para hacer mas interesante el juego (separar los tiempo de PvE de los de PvP). El "No Rush" se hace mucho informalmente "de hecho" pero ya a esta altura deberia ser parte del juego en alguna modalidad u opcion de partida.[/strike] 

PROS:
* Es un clasico que se disfruta como si fuera un deporte. No hay que explicarle nada a nadie porque todos ya saben lo que tienen que hacer.
* Ahora tiene una opcion de no rush!!! (se llama pacto aca). Es casi perfecto!!

------------------
CONS:
* In black forest you can destroy the trees with siege. We play black forest to battle in little battlefields and go to invade through  narrow pathways. It's not funny if someone open roads everywhere.
* [strike]Lack of no rush option. A kind of "Time of peace".[/strike] 
PROS:
* It's a classic. Everyone know how play it.
* Now it has no rush option!!! it's almost perfect!!

Like horror games? Get this game. Don't like horror games? Quit being such a little bitch and get the game. It's also VR compatible, so prove your worth and reach for that Oculus Rift.

Graphics:The graphics are very well optimized, so even a low powered computer can run the game on high settings, which is greatly recommended. The atmosphere is absolutely perfect, and horrifying. The minute details of watching a man being disemboweled, or another having his head blown up in a microwave, make you feel immersed. With VR compatibility to make you feel MORE immersed, this game has outdone itself. 9/10

Audio:Along with the amazing graphics comes the fantastic sounds. Voice-acting couldn't be better, and the music can add to the spooky tone. The sound of footsteps just behind you, and the whir of a crazy cannibal's power saw just behind the back of your head make you feel terrified. Wear headphones. 9/10

Story:The main campaign's story is fantastic, and I'll leave it at that to avoid spoilers. The DLC, Whistleblower, adds more to the main story, answering many questions you may have had. 8.5/10

AI:The AI is pretty fucking smart. That's not something to be happy about, because you sure as hell don't have any buddies in this game. Enemies can hear you like they see you-better if you're a dumbass. They will actively search for you. opening lockers and checking under beds. So don't expect to sprint past them and not be heard, little pig. 9/10

Overall, this game is horrifying, but incredibly fun to play. With a pair of headphones, and if you're lucky, a VR kit, this will be the most immersive horror game you'll play.

[h1] 直接从本人小黑盒评论中复制来 [/h1]
[u] （黑盒评分为0-5星），评测末尾有购买建议 [/u]
[h1] 四星 [/h1]
本来是想给五分，但小黑盒给五分的标准是“旷世神作”那就很难给五分了。总体来讲tc2是一个相当优秀的赛车游戏，你很难界定它是休闲赛车游戏还是半拟真赛车游戏，大部分（汽车）赛事是需要走线，车辆也有较细致的调教选项，但同时又有氮气加速，漂移赛又很好漂移，但我认为tc2在娱乐性和拟真性之间做了几乎完美的平衡，这就是我喜欢tc2的最主要的理由，本人也玩过很多其他的赛车游戏，其中也不乏类似神力科莎一类的民用模拟软件，但我认为在只有鼠标键盘外设的情况下，飙酷车神是一个更有乐趣的游戏，除了车赛，飞机赛和船赛也很有乐趣，虽然感觉大部分玩家飞机船赛玩得不如车赛多，但偶尔开车开腻了可以换换口味，全美国本土的等比例缩小地图开起来很爽，虽然很多建筑物贴图过于单调，但开车的时候也不容易注意到，这方面竞品游戏们也没好到哪去，毕竟要压缩游戏的大小，看风景还是相当不错的。说说游戏的不足吧：

1.车辆数量：其实也不是很少，毕竟车赛好多种不同的赛事有不同的车，但有些车改装改装就去别的赛了导致实际上车型是不太多的，而且对于jdm粉们来讲这里的车实在是不全，车型也比较旧，很少有近两三年改款的车，更新新车也慢，完完全全的新车型真的没出几个，（最近的rx8 s2000和恶魔倒是非常合我心意，顺便说一句30w多买s2000和60w多买恶魔真的不值，前期不要买），前期赚钱也比较慢，总之还是希望再多出一些车吧（其实是看着隔壁地平线眼红，地平线真的车多而且经典老车多）
                [b]  更新：1.6大版本更新不少新车，给力 [/b]  

2.画质不尽人意，车辆的画质相当不错，拍照模式渲染也很好看，主要是环境的画质一般，唉这就等tc3改进吧，tc2的环境画质总体感觉和tc1比进步不大，还有一点，后视镜毛玻璃那个梗已经是上古版本了，早就能看了

3.我电信网偶尔网络不好，不挂加速器加载时间稍长

基本上就这些比较明显的缺点了
最后说一下，很多人用tc2与地平线4极品飞车20比
这三个游戏区别很大，
各有各的很明显的优点，
tc2地图大比赛种类多有海陆空赛娱乐拟真平衡好，
地平线画质好优化好车多偏近拟真并且让键盘车神们优越感爆棚，（我不是地平线黑，没玩过，买不起，我也喜欢地平线）
极品飞车..小时候从3玩到18，但没玩过之后19到21，没权利多bb了就，但毕竟极品飞车就是极品飞车need for speed永远都是金字招牌。

tc2很优秀，刚开始有人说tc2操作手感不好我觉得就纯是杠，键盘玩游戏讲什么手感啊？只有习惯和不习惯而已，tc2不是漂移过弯，键盘操作走线很舒服的，不同车也要不同的调教才能发挥更好的实力，愿某某某优越党们嘴下留情，多体验体验tc2，没有绝对的好游戏和坏游戏，它能给你带来多少快乐那就有多好。
总结tc2有5分的快乐，却让我有1分的遗憾
四分，优秀之作
——————————————————————————————————————————————————
补充点有感而发的东西，最近在b站上浏览了一些tc2的视频，很多评论都是一捧一踩，捧谁大家都懂，这样的人我觉得怪可恶的，很多人不明事实没玩过tc2，甚至一部分人都没玩过地平线，很多人说tc2没有走线跑不过ai等等，我觉得有点可笑。
tc2是个需要走线的游戏，车辆也需要调教，调教对于车的影响也非常大，的确和地平线相比更娱乐些，门槛更低些，但并不代表门槛低就是不好。况且两者真实性上也不是天差地别，都是大众化赛车游戏，没必要五十步笑百步。
还有人说tc2不能以价格低作为优势，这我真的无话可说奥。
b站评论看得都习以为常了，不会去反喷黑子了，偶尔在下面找找志同道合的人就好。
游戏我自己玩得快乐就好，其他和我一样的tc2玩家也不需要在意别人乱喷什么，感觉tc2反响总体还是不错的，希望能继续出tc3升级画质。
tc1到tc2个人感觉已经是玩法上的蜕变了，tc1个人感觉真的没什么欲望玩下去，tc1当年的评价也一般，但是ivory tower还是做了2代，大概ub也很想要赛车游戏这块蛋糕，又做出了全美地图不舍得扔，所以三代大概率是会有的，等等tc3代和地平线5，估计又会是一边踩一边。
不管怎么样，大家玩游戏玩个快乐就好，tc2前期可能有一点难，过了十几小时摸清套路了就好了，祝大家游戏愉快。

今作は前作のSG世界線に到達できなかった、失敗してしまったβ世界線のオカリンが不死鳥の如く甦り頑張るお話
前作では鬱陶しく感じた鳳凰院凶真が恋しくなる作品とも言える。[b]前作プレイは必須。[/b]

[h1]プレイしていて筆者の感じた前作との主な違い[/h1]
前作ではDメールを送るか否か、メールをどのように返信するか否かによってストーリーが分岐していたため各キャラクターENDは容易であったがその分SG世界線に到達するのが非常に困難であり時間を要した。
一方、今作では「Amadeus」によってストーリーが分岐しており比較的一本道であったため特殊なtrue end以外を集めることは容易であった。

[h1]購入を悩んでいる人に[/h1]
100%になるまでプレイしてみても私の読解力が乏しいためかモヤモヤする部分が多いなと感じた。
[spoiler]特に前作で描写されなかった"SG世界線へのオカリンの執念"の象徴と受け取られるような戦争経験や数千回にもわたるタイムリープ、タイムマシン開発過程等の描写が少なすぎる点が私にとっては不満である。[/spoiler]
しかし前作をプレイしてみてまだまだこの世界観を楽しみたい、鳳凰院凶真を味わいたいと思っている人には上記欠点なんて気にせず楽しめる最高の作品なのでぜひ一度プレイしてみて考察を深めるもよし想像を膨らませるもよしな蛇足ではなく名作と呼べるゲームと思う。

5. Не самый плохой сюжет, а на фоне того что в основном выходит в наше время, сюжет тут отличный.
6. Хорошая, наверное даже, отличная оптимизация.
Вроде все основные плюсы перечислил, теперь перейдём к минусам.
1. Один из основных недостатков игры в том, что не смотря на все плюсы геймплея, его превратили в рутину, и лично мне за 40 часов он уже поднадоел.
2. Похоже в попытке увеличить время прохождения игры разработчики переборщили с крепостями, защиты, штурмы, штурмы, защиты, с одной стороны не плохо, но с другой стороны см. пункт 1.
3. Из за двух выше упомянутых минусов, сюжет развивается крайне медленно, из за чего иногда попросту забываешь о чём там вообще речь.
4. На мой взгляд наибольший минус игры именно на сегодняшний день, это её цена и цена на дополнения к ней, возможно сий недостаток просто моё субъективное и не самое верное мнение, по скольку я не в курсе по каким критериям
определяется цена. Но всё таки, цена по мне высоковата, учитывая возраст игры.
5. ОГРОМЕННЫЙ, просто колоссальный вес игры.
Подведу ка я итоги, а итоги таковы: у игры типичные для сегодняшних игр недостатки, однако у неё в отличии от большинства игр, есть не только недостатки, но так же и не хилые преимущества, а потому на мой субъективный взгляд, не смотря на свою цену, игра достойная и интересная, а потому стоит своих денег.

Отыграв немалое количество времени, пожалуй, оставлю тут свой обзор.
Начну с плюсов игры :
Нельзя не отметить особую атмосферу игры, которая затягивает с первых же минут. Окружающая среда, звуки, пейзажи, заброшенные города и заводы - всё это придаёт реалистичность и погружает с головой в этот, порой очень жестокий мир, где не осталось практически ничего от цивилизации. Тут вас могут убить даже за банку бобов или футболку, пропитанную потом. Где бы вы ни были, опасность подстерегает на каждом шагу.
Как и в жизни, без воды и еды здесь не выжить. Вам придётся охотится на диких животных, а может даже на людей (человеческое мясо тоже является съедобным), а затем разводить костёр, чтобы приготовить себе еду. Если оставить мясо на костре надолго, то оно может сгореть и при употреблении его в пищу вы получите отравление, так же, как и от сырого мяса. Зимой без пуховика и толстовки можно замёрзнуть насмерть, а в пустыне потерять сознание от жары, если одеть тёплую одежду. Это придаёт некую реалистичность игре.
Так же радуют частые обновления. Разработчики не сидят сложа рук и постоянно реализовывают новые интересные идеи.

Теперь перечислю то, что мне не понравилось в игре:
Самая основная проблема - это плохая оптимизация. На моей gtx 960 бывают частые фризы, проседание фпс с 80 до 15 и т.д.
Так же в игре очень много различных багов. Не удивляйтесь, если проснувшись у себя в доме, вы увидите голову оленя, торчащую из фундамента или, прогуливаясь по окрестностям, в воздухе будет висеть ремонтный верстак, оставшийся после рейда дома. Я привела лишь несколько примеров.
Ещё мне очень не понравились анимации персонажей в игре, они выглядят как-то неуклюже и не совсем реалистично. 
Ещё один большой минус - это частые вайпы на серверах. Лично мне надоедает каждый месяц, а то и чаще, заново добывать ресурсы и изучать все рецепты заново, чтобы построить дом и скрафтить необходимые предметы.
На этом всё, моя оценка 7/10.

It's a Borderlands game, what can I say?
You shoot bandits with your gun. You shoot some more bandits. You get a better gun that straight-up explodifies bandits or turns them into volcanoes or freezes them into ice statues. And then you achieve everyone's dream of killing Jake Paul.

Gunplay and platforming are the best they've ever been; the addition of sliding and mantling really make the levels feel more fun and easier to move around in, and the variety of weapons available can't be beat. The story is good, but not quite as good as BL2. (I mean, Handsome Jack is a tough act to follow, but the douchiest streamers in the universe make a decent attempt.) There's a hefty helping of memes and callbacks in the game (I was BLOWN AWAY to see a Mr. Cool Ice reference) but it's not intrusive. And the DLCs thus far are loads of fun, with actual engaging stories and fun bosses and good loot, and I can't wait for Bounty of Blood and whatever Krieg-related thing is coming afterwards.

8.5/10, buy it when it goes on sale and play it with your friends.

Si te gustan los juegos como Baldurs Gate 1/2 - Icewind dale ni lo dudes y compralo.

El juego es excelente por donde se lo mire a mi parecer, dare una reseña general.
Presenta varias dificultades las cuales complican exponencialmente la dificultad SOBRETODO al incio/mediados de juego, requiriendo la ultima (injusto) un conocimiento impecable del juego para poder hacer algo al inicio.

La historia es muy atrapante y entretenida, presentando varias ramificaciones y subquest que influyen en la historia de una manera u otra. Nuestra aventura incia con un reclutamiento de personas dispuestas a recuperar unas tierras tomadas por bandidos y en recompensa a esa mision, nos haremos dueños de estas tierras para fundar nuestro reinado.

Posee un modo de "reino" o " reinado" en donde basicamente vamos expandiendo nuestro territorio  (de manera administrativa mayoritariamente)  y al mejorarlo obtenemos diversos beneficios, algunos muy buenos, otros prescindibles y otros estrictamente relacionados al lore / logros(achivements) De todas maneras, uno puede siempre poner el reinado en " automatico " e ir a matar monstruos y hacer la historia (este modo hace que nos perdamos muchas cosas de la historia, recomiendo no usarlo en el primer run)

En cuanto al combate y los monstruos que se presentan son geniales, muy variados y entretenidos, con diverso loot. Tambien hay varias zonas ocultas u objetos que uno puede obtener mediante pruebas de habilidad ( como sigilo, percepcion, etc) 

El "armado" o build del personaje es fundamental para disfrutar el juego, ya que si no tenemos una nocion basica de ello, podemos pasarla muy mal en algunos combates, en especial al final del juego. Esto es muy sencillo si uno lee todo (Hoja de personaje / spells / armas / atributos, etc ) En caso de equivocarse, el " respect " o volver a asignar todos los puntos del perosonaje desde level 1, esta disponible UNICAMENTE de la dificultad normal, hacia abajo (si mal no recuerdo) las 3 dificultades que le siguen a normal, es imposible respectear el personaje. Presenta una variedad de clases increible (16 clases, cada una con 3-4 "especializaciones" ) y 4 o 5 clases de " presitgio " que son aquellas que podes acceder al cumplir ciertos requisitos ( como por ejemplo tener cierto conocmiento de artes arcanas / spells / lore relogioso, etc ) estas clases de " prestigio " son clases que acceden a habilidades/talentos/ventajas de mas de una clase, para resumirlo. 

Todos los personajes que nos cruzamos poseen una historia unica y muy interesante, especialmente los que podemos incorporar a la party, teniendo un total de 8-9 personajes donde nuestras deciciones influyen tanto en la relacion que tenemos como en el lore ( en algunos casos ) e incluso tambien en su permanencia a nuestro lado.

Los DLC los he jugado y estan buenos pero son prescindibles a mi parecer, lo que si, ambos DLC se pueden hacer separados de la historia, pero tambien se presentan anexados a la misma, lo que me parecio algo muy bueno.

La musica es muy buena y entretenida a mi parecer, incluso presentando ciertos temas para ciertos momentos unicos.

Por ultimo, se agrego el combate por turnos en una de las ultimas actualizaciones el cual no he probado, pero a todo el mundo parecio agradarle mucho, seguramente lo pruebe y actualice la reseña.

Uno de los mejores juegos que he jugado, compitiendole al icewind dale solo por nostalgia <3

내가 생각하는 치명적인 단점

1. 멀티플레이 할 때 외국인 유저의 핑이 미친 듯이 튀어서 제대로 된 멀티플레이가 불가능 할 때가 너무 많다
화면상 공격의 범위가 아님에도 불구하고 서로 맞히고 맞는 개판이 벌어진다

2. 멀티 시스템을 이용해 게임 유경험자들이 초보자들을 죽이고 다니는, 일명 '제초기' 존재
멀티 악용이라고 봐도 무방하며 초보자들, 뉴비들이 게임을 관두게 되는 원인 중 하나

3. 핵 사용자들 때문에 일어나는 유저 강제 밴

4. 소울 시리즈를 만든 프롬 소프트웨어의 무관심
게임 내 고쳐야 할 것, 핑 차이로 인한 문제들이 심각함에도 불구하고 고쳐주지 않는다

소울 시리즈가 악명이 높다곤 하지만 막상 해보고 적응 조금만 되면 할만한 게임이다 적당히 난이도가 높아서 시도만 좀 해본다면 무난하게 깰 수 있을 만한 난이도인 게임이기 때문에 컨트롤이 안 좋다고 자부하는 사람들도 재밌게 할 수 있을 것이다
프롬 소프트웨어 게임이기 때문에 스토리텔링 등이 많이 불친절하여 인물들의 언행을 제대로 지켜보지 않거나 게임 내에서 유도한 것들을 제대로 보지 않는다면 게임을 알아가는 것이 힘들어서 게임을 하는 동안 자기가 무엇을 하고 있는지도 모르겠다는 유저도 보았지만 반대로 생각하면 하나하나 알아갈수록 숨겨진 재미를 느끼고 제작진들에게 감탄밖에 나오지 않을 것이다. 이 게임은 내가 갖고 있던 기존의 RPG의 상식 같은 것들을 완전히 깨부쉈다고 해도 과언이 아니며 재미를 붙이기 시작한다면 꽤나 자극이 큰 게임이다. 그렇기 때문에 재미를 붙였을 때 국내에 잘 알려져 있는 RPG의 수준이 낮아 보일 수도 있다.
그만큼 게임이 정교하고 세세하며, 알아가는 맛이 있고 또한 정복감과 성취감을 잘 느끼게 해준다는 것이다.

플레이하게 된다면 게임 도중 마음이 꺾이지 않았으면 좋겠고 제발 NPC는 적대관계가 아닌 이상은 가만히 냅두거나 가까이 가서 대화를 시도해보자.

Helltaker is a great game. The demons are cute, the humor is well-delivered, and the puzzles are amazing. Seriously. I've seen them take flak for "being annoying," which I interpret as being difficult, but that's what makes them so great. 

There's only a few that require actual thinking, because Vanripper does an excellent job offering branching paths that are [i] almost [/i] right. Solutions that [i] almost [/i] work. Having to sift through all the possibles moves available to try to find the right one is something I greatly enjoyed.

But if you just came for the cute demons, you don't need to bother with the puzzles. You're totally free to just skip them in the pause menu. You don't even need to play the game at all, really, with the option to skip straight to the end in the chapter select.

It occurs to me that this isn't really a Steam game. It's much more reminiscent of Newgrounds or Itch game. But hey, I probably wouldn't have found it otherwise, so I'm not complaining.

As far as criticisms go I really don't have any. I can't think of any way to improve upon the game, and I had a great time with it.

The game itself is pretty fun, yet very frustrating. Imagine if you were going to work, and you lived in New York and worked in New Jersey. So to get to work you hopped a plane to Denver, and then took a bus to New Jersey, only to get there and realize well dangit, I forgot to pack a lunch, and walked home to New York. That is one of the big frustrations I find with the laborers in this game. You build roads, they take the path through the fields basically making said roads useless. There are times I will have 70% of my population farming yet starving because even though I have 6 blacksmiths and 20 men gathering Iron....I'm breaking tools faster than I can create them. You can get Steel tools, which are upgraded but mining the coal you need breaks the tools WAYYYY TOO FAST! I realize this game is about challange and that is fine, but, some suggestions.

1) Implement gold. If i have 40,000 wool, I should be able to sell off the excess and save the gold for a rainy day...say,  one of the times I'm a little behind on food, and the merchant comes, it's too inconvenient to trade at the trading posts.
2) Tools, clothing need to last a bit longer...nothing insane but a 20% increase, either that or make  it use less resources to craft them. I seriously invision  these people out there jumping up and down on the handle just to say "look the pickaxe broke!" I shouldn't need 200 miners just to harvest the ore, which makes the tools, which BARELY makes enough tools to harvest the ore.
3) Smart pathing. If I build a road FFS walk on it dangit.
4) Citizens should live close to their designated jobs....there is no reason that a farmer should live in a house 90 miles from his farm when there are 6 abondoned houses nearby.

All in all, the game is interesting but just too frustrating to be fun. Minor tweaks would raise the play value of this game signifigantly.  Overall, I'd give it a 5 out of 10. Any implementations I suggested would raise the game to an 7.5 out of 10 pretty fast.

That is likely my favourite aspect of this version and reminds me of the visuals you saw in Civ IV Colonization. However it is disappointing that you can't train your citizens for the specialty districts similar to Colonization.

For example once you have a Holy District you could either train a citizen in a church (once built) or purchase one with faith. Then a regular citizen in the holy district gives you +2 while a priest gives you +4. A scientist could be trained in a university, a manufacturer in a workshop (or something similar so that it balances out well).

My biggest cons are typical of the whole franchise: unrealistic AI, and minimal diplomacy options. 
- Gandhi is always a warmonger.
- You can't tell another civ to move their armies from your borders, to stop spreading their religion in your cities, or to stop settling i land you consider to be yours; all things the civ will say to you at the drop of a hat.
- 'Help' in a war is always minimal.
- Eventually all civs will hate you no matter how hard you have worked to create an alliance. Often they will flip on you out of nowhere, even if they are a civ known for passivity or loyalty. It feels to me that the bonuses to relationship that you can get are very minor compared to their general hate for you winning the game. I wish they would act as the countries and not as jealous players.
- A general lack of creativity in the diplomacy options: you can't gift them food, help them fend off another civs religious attacks, help complete a public works or world wonder, make a pact to not settle in each other's lands, make a pact to not spread religion in each other's lands, offer to send a worker, teach them a form of government (civic boost, but presumably in the hopes they will conform to your form of government), ... 
- You can't even denounce a civilization!

I played this game here and there for 3 years (Xbox and PC), and every single hour I played, was worth it. It is the best single-player campaign game I played, and the hundreds of hours I spent in this game are something to behold. 

Exploring and doing side-quests in this game is a standard, my first play-through, 30 minutes into the game (including character creation) I skipped the main quest line and started doing everything BUT the main quest line, this went on until I reached lvl 40, when I opened my journal and wondered why I couldn't access a location I heard of before. 

The modding community for this game is also grand, and I believe some people even say one of the biggest, if not the biggest. Whether that be moddb or steam workshop, you can either make your game look like a top-notch 4k quality game, a new "class", new quests, and even in some cases, whole new areas to explore with maps and characters. Most recent mod of such caliber that I played is so vast that it is actually considered a separate "game" that simply requires you to have Skyrim.

Unfortunately the further into the game you get the texture maps start taking a while to properly map onto the landscape. I have a GTX 550ti with 1GB of RAM on this computer so it's not exactly a slouch.

Other than that the usual quibbles about any Civ game applies here. The most annoying is the amount of micro-managing later in the game.

All in all it's a good game and can be very addictive. I'd recommend getting it if you enjoy 4x games.

So I'll get this out of the way: I haven't beaten the game yet (I'm at [spoiler]The Tower and just freed Elro and Mina[/spoiler], but I love it so much I wanted to right a review. 

I got Iconoclasts through a giveaway and knew nothing about it aside from what the main character looked like, not even who developed the game or what the age rating was. Due to her oversized wrench and funky hairdo I thought this was going to be a cute, silly game. Then [spoiler]she got called a harlot within the first fifteen minutes of the game[/spoiler] I'm not sensitive to that sort of stuff, but wasn't expecting that. It just got darker as time went one, but I won't go into that for fear of spoilers.

Gameplay is pretty fun, you have two weapons, a wrench and a gun that can use different ammo as time goes on. I have gotten stuck a few times due to the fact that I forget that when there is a small gap your character needs to be able to hang off it to crawl through it OR be on the same level as it. There's a few parts where you are slightly lower than the gap, not lower enough to use it as a handhold, and can't do anything with it. 

The art is also super fun, despite being pretty pixelated it's very detailed, especially for bosses. My computer sucks (sometimes even Minecraft is too much for it) and this game runs beautifully which was a nice surprise.

The music is weird, but in a good way. That's the only way I can describe it, I'm going to try to get the OST some time.

This next part is going to be mostly spoiler tagged, just in case, it details the mechanics of a certain boss battle. 
My biggest complain would be how the game does throw you into situations head first sometimes [spoiler]During the boss battle where Robin and Mina tag team to beat the guardian robot you need to switch between the two while fire, bombs, and smaller enemies are being rained upon you. This is the first time you can play as Mina and her play style is way different than Robin's involving having to stand still to aim her weapon among other things. I died several times to that boss just trying to figure out how to play Mina well.I would have appreciated a chance to be able to use her in a less stressful situation, maybe the wall comes up before the battle starts and you need to play as her to trigger the fight so you can get a feel for her controls?[/spoiler]

Overall, if you're willing to get frustrated sometimes I'd totally recommend this game! Also there are difficulty settings that you can change every time you get on so you can tailor your experience every time.

Итак, что я хочу сказать об этой игре. Я являюсь большим фанатом игр Saints Row, и я смело могу сказать, что третья часть самая интересная. Это вам не Saints Row IV cо всякими суперсилами, симуляциями, телекинезом и НЛО! Именно в третьей части можно почуствовать себя настоящим Святым. Хочу рассказать вам о плюсах и минусах игры. 
Итак, 

ПЛЮСЫ (+)
- Открытый мир. Мы попадаем в Стилпорт. В городе есть огромное кол-во магазинов, автосервисов, побочных заданий и пр. В Стилпорте есть ряд интересных мест, которые вам понравятся.
- Сюжет. Борьба с Синдикатом и командованием STAG, который возгловляет Сайрус Темпул. Готовы ли взять на себя роль Босса Святых? 
- Создание персонажа. 
- Есть упоротость. 
- Совместный режим и режим Балды.
- Наличие дополнений и модов к игре. Есть три оффициальных сюжетных дополнения и десятки дополнений на оружие, костюмы и транспорт.
- Большой ассортимент оружия и одежды.
 
МИНУСЫ (-)
- Русификатор. Русификатор конечно нужен, но разработчики могли бы сделать и лучше. Не слишком удобен и содержит орфографические ошибки.
- Баги. Персонаж и NPS могут застрять в текстурах (Часто это может случиться в "Страховом Мошенничестве" или если сбить машиной с огромной скоростью NPS недалеко от текстуры).
- Прохождение. Сюжетная линия Saints Row довольно короткая. Она занимает по времени часа 3-4. Но сюжетные дополнения смогут сделать прохождение более интреснее.

В целом, я остался доволен, что я купил эту игру. Советую всем попробывать поиграть в неё и оценить её.

I've got around 900 hrs on this game. I've played it in hopes for it to get better, i hoped it will progress into a good stable game with some bugs (which are expected in a game of this caliber), i hoped they will put a lot of effort and money they built up by now to get better servers, to optimize the game, to add more interesting content. 

Oh boy was I disappointed. It is still popular, it still has its audience, new map is coming out (took their sweet time), weekend events are there (not regular but yeah, can you expect more from Bluehole... nah) 

Gameplay is immersive, adrenaline pumped and really fun. On the other hand it can be really frustrating to die thanks to server issues, desync etc. To play this game you have to be patient and a bit of a masochist.. but kills, and wins do feel really good. I like the focus on reality in this game (only thing i play this game for, and also the fact that all other BRs are just shit); like bulletdrops (which i know theyre not near to real but theyre trying to balance it somehow), movement momentum (you cant stop immedietly when you release the button which is great) and different damage you do to different parts of opponents body (which is great, in theory.. but here it causes so many issues its infuriating!). 

Graphics are decent, sound is alright but it could be better. Story.. hmm do you really need a story in a Battle Royale game .. i dont think so. Community .. like every other, there are decent normal people, you can find friends among them, and also there are idiots, hackers and people who try to intentionally ruin your experience (luckily i dont end up with many of these). Everyone is trying to get better at this game but, tbh aside from skill you just have to be lucky, and when i say lucky i really mean it. 

I could go on and on and on about my experiences, about smaller and greater issues that made me angry (tho i never raged in this game) but that would just be to much to write. Ill just keep playing this game (not as frequently as before) and hope it become better, right until a game similar to PUBG gets out. And when i say similar i really mean it, i want that "reality" i want the same thrill, same "git good" feeling, but i want it in a better optimized game. Im not even asking for better graphics i just want it to work as INTENDED. And there are couple of games coming out that caught my interest, and when that moment comes it will be: Farewell PUBG, at least until you get your shit together.

I would recommend it, i did enjoy it, but i dont want you to waste 30$ (or 20$ on sale) for few hours of frustration.

I really enjoyed my first few tries at this game. I also enjoyed building bases and exploring the Island for the first time. And even the Center. But that charm wears off fairly quickly.

First off, progression is way, way, way, waaaaaaaaaay too slow. It will take you 60-75 hours just to establish a base. It only takes PvPers about 15 minutes to destroy enough walls to take everything or kill all your dinos. (I never had this happen to me but it is a major risk I've seen happen to my tribe-mates.) It also takes upwards of 12 hours to tame a dinosaur. 12 hours of babysitting and hoping a bronto doesn't step on it accidentally.

So some of you are probably thinking, just play on a modded server! And you know what, I did! I often played on 8x or 10x servers and it STILL takes 4-6 hours PER DINOSAUR to tame. If you get unlucky and lose your top two or three dinisaurs you can easily lose 18-20 hours of babysitting and extra time actually levelling those dinos.

The AI for dinisaurs will destroy you as well. If you don't know where the safe spots are to build, or if you don't get a massive stone wall up immediately you will get tracked down by every predator and murdered in about two hits and there will be nothing you can do about it.

After 169 hours and maybe 3 different servers I cannot say my time was well spent. My last escapade on a 10x server still took me 70ish hours to build a wall and tame some dinos. I had metal but that was about it. Everything was going great but one of my main dinosaurs fell in to a hole and I died. I thought no big deal, there was no message that my dino died and it wasn't in my tribe log, so I grabbed a bird and flew in to the cave. I searched everywhere, but there was no dino to be found. We even had a mod on that tracks dinosaur locations for your pets and it said my dino was alive, but it wasn't accessible, stuck in the terrain or something.

Which leads me to my final point because writing this review only annoys me and makes me remember how I regret the time spent in this game. The bugs. There are some ridiculous bugs such as your dinos mysteriously disappearing in to walls. Collision is also insane, sometimes you can barely be bumped and you will go flying up diagonal edges, after landing you will die because you feel too far. Even tho if you got hit with that same speed on a flat plane you would have barely moved six feet. Objects clip through the walls making it really hard to build furniture in a base without it being accessed in some unintentional way. Item stacks are so small you can barely carry anything on your person. Most servers I play on have increased item stack size which can lead to freezing the entire server if you decided to split your stacks of meat in to 1 piece each so you can get spoiled meat for crafting. (I have witnessed my server freeze twice because I split up about 500 pieces of meat. The game does not handle that many individual items in your inventory at all and the whole server almost timed out when the meat spoiled.)

Pros:
+The graphics are pretty.
+Soundscape not bad
+Lots to initially explore and craft and tame

Cons:
-Time sink, get ready to spend over 10 hours taming a single dino you have your eye on. Hope it doesn't lose all its levels to a random bronto that walks by or a pack of raptors.
-PvP too easy. It can take you 70 hours to build a base and in 15 minutes and 2 C4 you can lose everything.
-Buggy. Get ready to die to bugs, and I don't mean poison either. I mean clipping through terrain, getting hit when you're inside shelter, falling when you shouldn't be falling and then dying to fall damage. Etc.
-Way too slow. I'm not exagerating when I say time sink. You will spend 10 hours collecting sticks and rocks to build your first shelter and then you will found out it's not even big enough to set up your crafting.

As for DLC, I'm neutral. The desert DLC was ok but way too hard and I never got in to it. The newest DLC I have no interst in buying so I'm not gonna slam the game for it alone.

If you have 500 hours to spare and don't mind the slowest progress of any sandbox game in the world, then this game can be alright. Just DO NOT PLAY ON DEFAULT SERVERS. You will spend over 16 hours taming high level dinos. Have fun with that.

Despite what most people say about the game, I don't care about the dialogue options/choices as much as others. It is still possible to kill of main characters and completely change the course of the game at any time you decide... 

Besides what I most liked about the Fallout franchise since I played FO 3 was mainly the exploration, the impossible "boss" fights with the beasts of the wasteland and the satisfaction of finding that unique gun in a hole deep in the ground. 

Not to mention that the combat, gunplay and movement in the game has improved and the unnecessary yet completely optional and fun - depending on your tastes - base building adds an extra creative flavour that doesn't hurt anyone.

Some of the cons to me are the dated buggy unoptimized Creation Engine and the stupid Settlements quests as well as the aforementioned lacking dialogue/choices system.

With a difference of 7 years since Bethesda Games Studios' last FO game release I would say they have done more than enough to keep the game feel fresh and engaging, with a few minor setbacks due to expected attempted "experimentation-innovation" which by no means make the game inferior to its predecessors.

app_name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
review: 一进游戏就崩溃，想爱也没法爱

Played 40 Hours already.

I am having so much fun but even a dimwit as me sees the AI problem and occasional glitches. Lets round them up should we.

Pros:

*District Management, a swell feature and alot of fun puzzling them with each other. Each district can be constructed on a specific tile, that goes for world Wonders as well. Not all buildings crammed up into the city.

* Visual, many have complained that the cartoonish style looked like a mobile game. Its too childish, yada,yada boom de yada. FOr me, i have no problem. I played Borderlands which had a cartoonish graphical style, i played Rollercoaster Tycoon 3 which falled in to the same opinion, oh its cartoonish.. For me, its just makes things clearer.

* City State Diplomacy, finally no more  "here ya go with this gold now you are my B****!". They removed the gold gifting from Civ V which made it stale and boring, here we go with Envoys. A specific type of resource that can be used to gain influence and become suzerian. An oh Suzerian, a new type of improvement that grants each citystate a diffrent type of unique bonues, some are awesome and some are medicore (Preslav.... I still love you but give me something else instead of combat bonus towards cavalary on hills).


Cons:

* AI, here comes the biggest concern for me. Playing against a stupid AI makes me feel smart and i dont like it.... Honestly when i pull off something that makes players goes "OH My"... Myself be like: "Is this too easy?" I always sucked at video games from the beginning at 5 years old. But thats just me but something is off... Really off, i had a hard time achieving a victory in Civ V on King but here i am rolling through both science, culture and somewhat domination on score/lead (i am not a warmongerer).... Something is definitley off, at least i should be winning in science.

*Glitchy, a glitch in the system? I have not encountered hard ones that made me start a new game and delete my previous save but i have encountered some nice mostly visual glitches. For example, the low texture on leaders hair switches off and on when i start my Civ 6 from steam. Its something todo that i did not get all the info from the start so i have to change graphics in option which then leads me to restart whole Civ 6 because Graphic Change. Also some embarked units acts like Jesus and walks on water until it registers that they are on a boat.. Just visual ones.

* Sorting, here is something that makes me cringe. Sorting.... Sorting my traderoutes, sorting the civ that leads culture... Demographics, where is that? Sorting Citystate (may not be that nessecary)

Here is my final value, its a solid 8/10. Civ V delivered it a bit better as a 8.01/10 but this one came close. =)

Final Score:
8/10, recommends it.

Герои игры постоянно общаются друг с другом о том что произошло с ними по пути, и это очень добавляет живости и интереса в игру.
И всё это венчает очень приятная и подходящая этой игре графика.
Очень рекомендую к ознакомлению, пока игру оценил бы на 8,5/10.

Hollow Knight is one of the best metroidvanias I've ever played. I havent played a game like this in so long with such fluid feeling controls as well as such an open world. Optional areas, even bosses, feel common place, and over half the game Im fairly certain can be done in any order. This makes for a strong feeling of exploration and getting lost, of there always being something new to uncover. This is a game that truly understands how to put in a secret.

Friends of mine will also know that im rather into bugs, so I may have a bias here, but this game also sports a very charming array of side characters to meet. A lot of them are appealing immediately from their design alone. The art as a whole is fantastic. Foreground entities (such as your sprite, the sprites of enemies and npcs etc) are rendered fairly simply but strong in design, while the backgrounds and ground scenery are all beautifully detailed. It's an utterly gorgeous game.

This game also does not dissapoint in length. My playtime might not be accurate due to moving the save file between two accounts (to use steam share on a different rooms computer) but going in, i expected this to be a 5-10ish hour game tops, but easily found over 25 hours of playtime, and I didnt even 100% the file. The first moment when I expected that I had seen most of the game, I'd really only seen about half of it.

It does a number of interesting mechanics quirks. Healing requires you to stand still for a moment to perform, and uses up a charge of energy you gain from striking enemies. This gives a constant encouragement to fight enemies in your path, while also ensuring that you gain more energy from them than youd spend healing the damage they did to you. It's especially interesting in boss fights where sometimes, the best defensive measure is to ensure that you land some hits in so that you can heal yourself during some of the rare gaps.

The game does not easily hand you maps of the areas, and ability to see your own location on the map is tied to an equipable accessory (do you know the area by heart? feel free to wear something beneficial there instead.) Finding the map in each area is an ordeal, but one that I appreciate. I havent been able to feel genuinely lost in a game of this genre for a long time, and not immediately granting me the ability to automatically plot maps of everywhere i go causes me to pay stronger attention to my surroundings.

The games difficulty is fairly rough, however! The game is very frequent in giving you moments that will challenge you. 游戏内容丰富，集跑酷、动作、丧尸、自由度较高为一体，顺便神优化，我五年前的860m也能有不错的观影体验。
前期很菜，只有白色和绿色品质的水管扳手，打个小丧尸要死要活，后期踩脑袋、扭脖子技能加上去，再加上图纸、蓝色武器和插件改装，才能轻松起来。
弓是神器，锁头，高伤，箭回收。
x光透视损伤挺有意思，能打碎头骨、颈骨、膝盖骨、腿骨，也能用利器肢解胳膊腿儿，或者电、火烧焦。
[spoiler]  印象中见过一次没穿上衣和内衣的女丧尸  [/spoiler]

[spoiler]  克兰穿着一双铁鞋  [/spoiler]
游戏内容还是挺丰富的，无论是一个人玩还是找好友开黑都可以。

剧情的话，也是可圈可点的（以下涉及到剧透）
[spoiler]  或许，从一开始，Dying Light这个游戏名字就提前透露出来了游戏结局。消逝的光芒可以指白天过后到了夜晚会出没的夜魔，也可以指曾经的哈兰变成了地狱，或者是指消逝的希望
主角从游戏一开始就被咬感染，中间发作过几次，甚至有一次发作间接导致女票（大雾）的死亡。本来有机会为高塔带去大量的解毒剂，结果被GRE和赖斯欺骗，也算是间接导致了最后高塔的结局
本来是拿钱办事的特工，结果发现了真正的事实，正义感爆棚的英雄主角自然是要掉过头来对付自己的金主和反派，有点老套的套路
在我看来，本体的结局和信徒的两个结局，一共三个结局中：
本体结局是good end，干掉了赖斯，拿到了病毒样本得以威胁GRE，解药也即将研发出来，一切都充满着希望，可以说是三个结局中最好的结局；
夜魔结局是bad end这点毋庸置疑，自己变成夜魔，开始出去袭击人类，怎么看都不是个好发展；
核弹结局是true end，哈兰已经无法挽回，解药研发失败，外界不会对哈兰提供帮助，高塔陷落（已经联系不上了，虽然有离得太远信号不好的可能，不过多层失守的信息让我更倾向于全灭的结局），虽然哈兰里还有很多活着的人，但可能都无法拯救哈兰或自己，明明修复了电力，明明恢复了信号塔，明明接通了水源，为什么......总之，一颗核弹可以解决一切问题，那就选择这个最省事的办法吧（叹息）
最终，希望的光芒完全消逝，迎来了核弹的光芒。而核弹的光芒消逝之后，哈兰也消逝了。

Начну с главного, игра стоит своих денег, поэтому если вы фанат доты и кки, то посоветовал бы раскошелиться.
Теперь обо всем по порядку. Игра стоит 1390 руб. Из них вы получаете 10 паков карт и 5 билетов на соревнование. В каждом парке будет присутствовать минимум одна редкая карта, так что на первое время этого будет достаточно, что собрать неплохую колоду, а если ещё и акс выпал, то вы победитель по жизни) Если учитывать, что игру я купил на деньги вырученные с продажи шмота доты, то очень даже не неплохо.
Что касается интерфейса, то он выполнен как в доте, оцениваю на 9 из 10, все максимально удобно, даже показывает стоимость каждой карты на торговой площадки в реальном времени. Звук, музыкальное сопровождение и озвучка на топ-уровне, как опять же в доте. Ставлю 9 из 10. Графические эффекты, графика в целом оставляет благоприятное впечатление, но можно было бы и лучше, в любом случае лучше чем в ХС. Ставлю 8 из 10. Alle Nase lang habe ich versucht das Spiel wieder zu intallieren, anzufangen um endlich mit dem aktuell aufgespielten Patch die ersehnte Lösung präsentiert zu bekommen.
Ab 2.5 habe ich dann persönlich aufgegeben und bin wirklich enttäuscht 50€ bzw mehr ausgegeben zu haben.
Die CE habe ich mir Boxed, direkt im Egosoft Shop geholt um es A In einer Box zu besitzen wie es sich für mich gehört und B wirklich direkt von Egosoft mein heiss geliebtes X zu erhalten.
Rein generell ist X-Rebirth für mich eine Fehlinvestition gewesen.

Meine Hoffnung besteht jedoch darin das aus der Totgeburt vielleicht noch einmal der Phoenix aus der Asche steigt und sich das Team nicht entmutigen lässt erneut ein X unter die Community zu setzen was vielleicht wieder an X3 - Terran Conflict - Albion Prelude anknüpft und natürlich an die Vorgänger.

Jedenfalls mein Fazit:

Das Rad neu Erfinden hat nicht geklappt und selbst mit Patches die das Game lauffähig machen, überzeugt es mich für meinen Teil nicht davon ein X Titel zu sein, ebenso wenig wie ich Arcania als Gothic ansehe.

Egosoft, schade um X-Rebirth.
Doch X-Rebirth hin oder her, ich hoffe das die Wiedergeburt nicht den Tot des X-Universums bedeuted hat sondern eher den Weg der Vorgänger neu beleuchted, so das wir uns hoffentlich eines Tages erneut in ein X Titel freuen dürfen, welcher sich das X redlich verdient.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nachtrag 03.03.2018

Nach einer Gefühlten Ewigkeit und etlichen Patches später habe ich X-Rebirth nun doch noch einmal eine weitere Chance gegönnt, nicht zu Letzt weil ich nach wie vor Egosoft und die X-Reihe wohl immer wieder Chancen einräumen würde.

Nach meinem anfänglich Negativen Reviw welches ich weiter oben schlicht stehen gelassen habe, ändere ich meine Meinung auf ein Positives.

Denn TROTZ der wirklich schon für 2015 veraltete Grafik und sehr schlechten Charakter modellen sowie leider sehr sehr dummen KI ist es dennoch als Einzelstück gesehen ein schönes Spiel was zum Reduzierten Preis definitiv einen Blick wert ist.

Es ist zwar nach wie vor nicht mein Favorit, denn dafür bin ich zu sehr Fan des Spielprinzips von X3/Terran Conflict und auch Albion Prelude, doch ein mittlerweile echt gut spielbarer Titel und eventuell eine nette Zeit überbrückung bis wir mit X - Foundations hoffentlich wieder wie in der X3 Reihe uns im universum bewegen, denken, handeln und kämpfen können.

My very first video game for the original Sony PlayStation was Tomb Raider II. I fell in love with Lara - she was an adventurer, she solved puzzles, the combat took the backseat compared to raiding tombs. The games managed to be cinematic by using clever camera angles, ambience and a cool soundtrack to help build tension and increase the feeling of danger and wonder. So, yes, I'm a fanboy of the original series, and yes, I have high standards whenever 'Tomb Raider' is slapped onto whatever reboot we're on at this point. Read this review with those things in mind.

Despite the name 'Tomb Raider', very little raiding of tombs actually goes on in this game. Indeed, I'd say about 95% of the actual tombs in this game are optional. Huh. A Tomb Raider game, but you're not tomb raiding? Doesn't make sense to me. I also have to comment on the game's difficulty with regards these hidden tombs. I'm sure if you've been around the Tomb Raider scene for any length of time, you've heard of Stella's Tomb Raider site. It's a fantastic online resource which provides spoiler-free information on how to 100% complete these games - all the way from the original 90s classic to the latest release. I only used Stella's walkthrough TWICE for the entire game, which is completely unprecedented. Usually I would resort to using her site at least once every level (especially if going for a 100% run), but even the hidden tombs were easy to navigate. Hell, even the collectibles were usually relatively close to where you'd be going anyway - I ended up collecting a large portion of the GPS caches, weapons parts, documents and relics simply by venturing but a few metres from the actual path I was meant to take. 

THE COMBAT IN THIS GAME OH MAN. Lara begins the game by wishing she won't become a murderer... and then proceeds to kill over 200 enemies in this twelve-hour-long gaming experience. In fact, a lot of the upgrades make the deaths even more brutal - for example, being able to add fire to your arrows, then later being able to add grenades to your arrows to kill even more people with a single arrow. It's not really consistent with her fear at the start of the game about becoming a murderer, and sure, she's kind of forced into doing so, but maybe Crystal Dynamics shouldn't have included that as a part of her character if combat was going to matter so much. The use of a cover system and regenerating health irritates me - not all modern games need the so-called staples of modern gaming. In fact, it's always terribly easy to predict when a fight scene is about to take place, because you can see a lot of cover spots and explosive barrels in the vicinity, so at least you have a few seconds to roll your eyes in anticipation of what's to come.

This game's main saving grace is the actual storyline. The plot of a Japanese Sun Queen and an island with freak storms is genuinely interesting, and that's what kept me playing through those atrocious fight sequences, through those immersion-breaking QTEs, and through all those hours of falling. Sadly however, a lot of the story is explained through diary entries/documents that Lara must acquire during her adventure - but as previously mentioned, these are not exactly difficult to find. 

I really wish Steam would give me a 'neutral' review option for this - because I did complete the game, and I do want to go back to retrace my steps and find the collectibles that I am missing, but this may largely be because of my nostalgia willing me to strive for 100% completion, rather than because of any true love of the game. So, if you're looking for a game that's rather combat, collectibles and sidequest-heavy, then this is the game for you. If, however, you're a fan of the original 90s Tomb Raider series, then I would approach with caution and perhaps only purchase it in the sale and after seeing a Let's Play of the first 20 minutes or so to really prepare yourself for the not-really-a-Tomb-Raider experience that this game provides.

原本认为过年肯定没空玩了，不过还是抽出时间玩了一会，总的来说我还是很满意的，依旧是玩上就不想停下来的熟悉味道。
我不打算跟XCOM EW+LW对比，因为我觉得那样就好像把文明滚出地球本体和文明5完整版对比一样不，所以这次依旧是谈谈游戏设计和体验。

优点：
1.画面对于一款偏向战棋的策略游戏，拥有这样的画面无疑算得上是锦上添花，让人每个动作都带着一些期待
2.音乐风格和前作相似，但是变化比以前多了，不至于被过度循环
3.难度终于是提高了，有的AI变得特别怂，感觉有点想拖时间的意思，而现在敌人的技能更是屌炸，新的任务时间设定强迫你不能太怂，生死看淡，不服就干
4.新的角色形象和资料定制，我很喜欢，当年我玩XCOM1的时候就能叫出我的士兵的名字和对应的特点~现在强大的士兵定制功能很适合我
5.良好的Mod支持，创意工坊的加入，成功让我们可以操纵万恶的G胖去送头
6.这一代的敌人设计比过去更加有趣，更加丰富

缺点：
1.bug依旧是现在急需要解决的最大问题，相信不久的补丁会弥补
2.在一些不重要的位置产生卡顿和掉帧，这个问题我这里主要发生在主菜单和载入游戏初，比如飞机刚飞下去的时候，有时攻击后也会来个一两秒的延迟，虽然无关紧要，但是能解决的话还是解决掉吧
3.一些我们熟悉却消失的系统，XCOM：EW中有些很有趣的系统在这作暂时还没有，比如人体改造，还有开游戏前的一些设定，新作肯定不会直接沿用，但是估计有新的花样是准备添加在DLC了

其他：
1.优化这个问题确实存在，并且挺严重的，不过对我来说还不算糟，因为我的低配渣渣850m的问题和网上他们970的问题基本一模一样，除了一些无关紧要的时候发生掉帧和卡顿，对我的游戏体验倒是没多少影响233
2.射击精准度！这一点抱怨的人无数！这说不上是坏事，确实，这作好像数据会骗人了，尤其是看到最后还会有统计，让人感受设计方的恶意，但是最后的统计数据不会骗人，那么这样看来，似乎是前作的概率显示的太低了，前作EW的60%命中，我感觉有75%...除了有人提到的100%命中bug，我倒觉得这次命中算是一次改进，想增加命中率？方法1.声控；方法2.信仰加成

总评：
依旧是非常高质量的策略游戏，战棋爱好者不容错过，如果对喜欢前作，那么就更不要错过这部作品，虽然有些bug恼人，但是对于游戏体验的影响不大，而且我们相信2K对bug的修复效率还算可以，内容和系统上的欠缺，这要等未来的DLC和Mod了，非常杀时间，重复可玩性也不错。两百多元还是很值的。

[list]

This game is in early access, so I expected there to be some bugs and other issues when I bought it. While I agree the pricetag is a bit high for an early access game, I am not that bothered by it because I am enjoying the game quite a bit so far. I do not play MMORPG's for the sake of amazing gameplay or outstanding graphics, I play them just to have fun and be able to experience another world with my own character. The storyline by far isn't the best, and being a game from Korea there are some translation errors here and there. With that said, I am still very much enjoying the storyline and side quests. I actually enjoy the chain combat system; it can be frustrating at times, but overall I like it. The graphics aren't the best I've seen, but they are still really good. Of course they don't look as perfect as the trailer, but honestly how many games at this point actually look as good as the trailers? The game also has a very enjoyable soundtrack that goes well with the gameplay. The character creation system is also very diverse, allowing you to customize just about every aspect of your character's body proportions, facial features, etc. This game has everything I want when playing an MMORPG. I will not recommend it if you are a hardcore MMORPG player looking for amazing story and combat as it has a ways to go before getting there. If you are like me and just enjoy immersing yourself in the fictional world of an MMORPG and can deal with some early access bugs, then I recommend getting this game on sale.
